osaka_ohlala_w_osaka.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information on the menu. Tabelog lists allergy information as available. Lunch and dinner centre on all-you-can-eat bread, pasta, steak frites and desserts (official menu).
osaka_ohlala_w_osaka.vegan_detail: Some vegan options: the à la carte menu has a vegan section — vegan burger, vegetable pasta, minestrone, green salad with vegan chicken, sautéed seasonal vegetables (official menu). Tabelog also lists vegetarian options. Courses are not vegan.
osaka_ohlala_w_osaka.hours_raw: Daily breakfast 7:00–11:00 (last order 10:45, buffet), lunch 12:00–15:00 (last order 14:00; lunch bookings limited to 90 minutes), dinner 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:00) (official site; Tabelog lists lunch and dinner). Reservations taken; no seat requests; seat selection unavailable at weekends and holidays (Tabelog). Tabelog says Marriott Bonvoy benefits and discounts do not apply; an October 2026 hotel guest says a Marriott member discount was given. À la carte unavailable on 19, 20, 24, 25 and 31 December 2026 (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and transport IC and other e-money; no QR. 160 seats; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; kids menu; smart casual (Tabelog; official site).
osaka_ohlala_w_osaka.notes: [French · Minamisemba, W Osaka's brasserie on Midosuji] The all-day French brasserie on the third floor of W Osaka, opened March 2021, with big windows over the tree-lined Midosuji and a white, black and blue room with polka-dot touches. Lunch is the popular buy: courses with unlimited bread brought to the table and unlimited desserts. Most 2026 diners loved the bread and the lasagna; some found the single pasta choice limiting, the salad salty or the desserts samey. Dinner centres on steak frites, cooked rare and served with butter or sauce, against the night view. One October 2026 diner writes that the menu was developed with Chef Yusuke Takada of La Cime and the W Osaka chefs. The menu has a vegan section.

roles: Hotel kitchen team unnamed; breads and desserts by the W Osaka pastry and bakery chefs (Tabelog)
chef_bio.background: A restaurant of W Osaka, opened 16 March 2021 (Tabelog). The official site describes traditional French cooking fused with Japanese ingredients and a modern sensibility, and playful presentation; the name is what the French say when surprised or excited. An October 2026 diner writes that the menu is developed by Chef Yusuke Takada of the two-Michelin-star La Cime together with the W Osaka executive chef team; no other source checked here says so.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Traditional French fused with Japanese ingredients and a modern sensibility" (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Steak frites; all-you-can-eat bread and desserts.

anecdotes.text: "The staff regularly came around with fresh bread, and for dessert, we could order from the menu without having to move at all, which was a nice touch." — October 2026, weekday lunch.
"The main dish is only a daily pasta special, so I would have been happier if there were a few more options." — September 2026.
"In the evening, you can enjoy the beautiful night view of Osaka through the large windows, adding a special touch to the hotel dining experience." — October 2026, steak frites course.
"As a Marriott member, I also received a discount." — October 2026, hotel guest (Tabelog says Marriott Bonvoy discounts do not apply).

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (日本語): W大阪の Oh.lala...、朝食からランチ、ディナーまで、御堂筋の並木道が見える窓、白・黒・青のモダンな内装に水玉のアクセント、朝食はブッフェ、3F・160席、朝7:00〜11:00 (L.O.10:45)、ランチ12:00〜15:00 (L.O.14:00)、ディナー17:30〜22:00 (L.O.21:00)、伝統的なフレンチに日本の食材とモダンな感性、誕生日の方1名にステーキフリット4品コース無料 (2名以上)、ブーランジェリーディナー、ワインブッフェ、キッズ無料、住所は南船場4-1-3 (英語版のメニューページは「4-3-1 Minami Semba」と表記)。食べログ (店舗会員、英語版): 2021年3月16日オープン、ランチは90分制、席の指定不可、Marriott Bonvoy の特典・割引は対象外、2026年12月の一部日程はアラカルトなし、アレルギー表示あり、ベジタリアン対応、駐車場1時間1,500円 (利用額で無料時間)。口コミ (2026年9月〜10月): パンとデザートの食べ放題、ラザニア、ステーキフリット、夜景、パスタの選択肢が1つ、サラダが塩辛い、デザートの味が似ている、Marriott 会員割引を受けたという声も、La Cime の Yusuke Takada シェフと共同開発という声も。

cultural_comfort.note: A W hotel restaurant whose official site and menu are also in English. No evidence on English-speaking staff in the sources.

existence.note: Official site (W Osaka) and shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing with December 2026 notices; reviews dated through October 2026. The English menu page gives the address as 4-3-1 Minami Semba; the Japanese site and Tabelog give 南船場4-1-3.

osaka_ura_namba_sakana_ebisu.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Nigiri with red-vinegar rice and sashimi with soy and ponzu, plus fried shrimp, tempura, natto rolls and shumai; nothing is described as gluten-free.
osaka_ura_namba_sakana_ebisu.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood and sushi izakaya; the miso soup is aosa seaweed in a fish stock.
osaka_ura_namba_sakana_ebisu.hours_raw: Mon–Fri and the day before a holiday 16:00–23:30; Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–23:30; last food order 23:00 (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; two-hour limit when busy; walk-ins at 18:30 on a Saturday were told to wait until about 20:00 (Tabelog; July 2026). Happy hour early in the evening (2026 reviews). Appetiser ¥399 (August 2026). Cards (VISA, Master) and PayPay (Tabelog). 35 seats with counter, sofas and a terrace; e-cigarettes only (Tabelog). The entrance is easy to miss (September 2026).
osaka_ura_namba_sakana_ebisu.notes: [Sushi izakaya · Ura-Namba, cheap nigiri and seafood plates] A lively sushi izakaya in Ura-Namba, the bar-and-small-plates sister of the Sushi Ebisu sushi shops in Tokyo and Kobe, with red-vinegar nigiri from ¥99 and long lists of seafood dishes under ¥1,000. Order the five-kind sashimi platter, the "Shrimp and Crab Battle" served on a crab shell, the sesame wasabi squid and a few nigiri, with sake from ¥399 a half-go. It fills up: come at the 16:00 opening (12:00 at weekends) for happy hour, or book. Expect ¥3,000–6,000 a head in 2026.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop text: the popular sister restaurant of Sushi Ebisu in Ebisu, Tokyo and Sannomiya, Kobe, opened in Ura-Namba; Edomae nigiri made with red vinegar in the Edo-period way, from ¥99; sake from ¥399 a half-go. Search results date the opening to January 2022 (not opened).
chef_bio.specialty: Red-vinegar nigiri; "Shrimp and Crab Battle".

anecdotes.text: "I overheard that guests without reservations arriving after us were told they would have to wait until around 8 PM." — July 2026, a Saturday at 6:30 PM.
"Under the crab shell in the shrimp and crab battle, I found yuzu pepper rolls" — September 2026, a first visit.
"The entrance was a bit hard to find, and we walked past it a couple of steps..." — September 2026, a daytime drink.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 裏なんばサカナエビス 難波千日前、居酒屋・寿司・魚介、大阪市中央区難波千日前14-17 川西第1ビル 1F、なんば駅から徒歩3分、月〜金・祝前日16:00〜23:30、土・日・祝12:00〜23:30 (料理 L.O. 23:00)、予約可、混雑時は2時間制、カード (VISA・Master)・PayPay 可、35席、電子タバコのみ可、Tokyo の Ebisu と Kobe の Sannomiya の Sushi Ebisuの姉妹店、赤酢の江戸前握りが99円から、日本酒は半合399円から、名物「Shrimp and Crab Battle」、飲み放題つきの宴会コース5,000円。口コミ(2026年7月〜10月): お通し399円、刺身5種盛り1,319円、ポテトサラダ549円、甘えびの海苔塩揚げ549円、Shrimp and Crab Battle989円、鯛ちり439円、あおさの赤だし329円、ウニといくらのユッケ、馬肉ユッケ、ヤリイカのごまわさび、ごまカンパチ、生牡蠣、あさりの酒蒸し、ハッピーアワー、土曜の夜は予約なしだと20時まで待ちも、入口がわかりにくい。

cultural_comfort.note: A long à la carte list of small seafood plates; book or come at opening (2026). No English evidence found.

osaka_tsuchi_namba.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The menu is French toast, open sandwiches, mille-feuille and parfaits, with brunch plates of vegetables and chicken in sauce served with bread; the acai bowl and smoothies are the items without obvious wheat, but nothing is stated about them.
osaka_tsuchi_namba.vegan_detail: Ask. No vegan information. There is soy milk for lattes (August 2026) and an acai bowl and fruit smoothies; the French toast, parfaits and plates use dairy, eggs or chicken.
osaka_tsuchi_namba.hours_raw: Daily 9:00–17:00, last order food 16:00, drinks 16:30; closed irregularly (Tabelog). Reservations accepted for tables; a booking needs one food item and one drink per person, no seat-only or drinks-only bookings; nine or more by phone (Tabelog). 90-minute limit (August 2026). Order and pay by QR code at the table; cash also accepted (September–October 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), transport IC, iD, QUICPay and PayPay (Tabelog). 36 seats inside and 30 on a terrace; non-smoking (Tabelog).
osaka_tsuchi_namba.notes: [Café · Namba, brunch in a hotel] A high-ceilinged brunch café on the ground floor of Hotel Royal Classic Osaka, beside Osaka-Namba Station, built on the Australian café model: specialty coffee, vegetable-heavy brunch plates and homemade French toast, served all day. The seasonal fruit is the draw: peaches in summer and figs in autumn 2026, in parfaits, French toast, mille-feuille and sodas. Order by QR code; a booking needs a food and a drink each, and stays are 90 minutes. Expect ¥2,000–3,000 a head; reserve at weekend lunch.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop text: "Bringing you a farm to table lifestyle from Tsuchi"; the new Tsuchi embraces Australian café culture, with high-quality coffee and meals in a comfortable space, brunch plates and sweets all day. An October 2026 regular notes the menu is gradually expanding and a pasta set has gone.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Farm to table" (Tabelog shop text).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal fruit French toast and parfaits; vegetable brunch plates.

anecdotes.text: "The seasonal mille-feuille always uses delicious fruits, and the figs were perfectly ripe and incredibly tasty." — October 2026.
"It's a prepay system, so I ordered and paid through a QR code while seated." — September 2026, the fig fair.
"for online reservations, it was mandatory to order both a drink and a dessert per person." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): Tsuchi、カフェ・スイーツ・コーヒースタンド、大阪市中央区難波4-3-3 ホテルロイヤルクラシック大阪 1F、大阪難波駅から徒歩1分、毎日9:00〜17:00 (L.O. 料理16:00、ドリンク16:30)、不定休、予約可 (テーブル席のみ、1人1フード1ドリンク、席のみやドリンクのみは不可、9名以上は電話)、カード・交通系IC・iD・QUICPay・PayPay 可、36席とテラス30席、禁煙、Farm to Table、オーストラリアのカフェ文化、スペシャルティコーヒー、野菜たっぷりのブランチプレート、自家製のフレンチトースト、季節のスイーツ。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): きのことタプナードのクリームソースの鶏のプレート、アボカドのオープンサンド、桃のフレンチトースト、いちじくとサーモンのフレンチトースト、桃のパフェとスムージー、いちじくとほうじ茶のパフェ、いちじくのミルフィーユ、アサイーボウル、アフォガート、豆乳ラテ、QR コードで注文と会計、90分制、海外の客も多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Order and pay by QR code; many overseas visitors (October 2026). No English menu evidence found.

osaka_wa_french_baru_sonjuku_shinmachi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Dishes such as beef sirloin in puff pastry, pizza, penne, quiche and baguette sit beside dashi omelette, skewers and foie gras; nothing is described as gluten-free.
osaka_wa_french_baru_sonjuku_shinmachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a meat-led menu of beef, pork, foie gras and seafood, with a dashi omelette; bagna cauda vegetables are the main plant dish mentioned.
osaka_wa_french_baru_sonjuku_shinmachi.hours_raw: Daily 17:30–3:00, last order 2:30; open through Golden Week and Obon; lunch suspended; open all year, New Year to be confirmed (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, advisable as it is often busy; seat type not guaranteed (Tabelog; September 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money, PayPay and Rakuten Pay (Tabelog). 37 seats: 13 at the counter, 24 at tables; heated tobacco only indoors until 23:00, smoking on the terrace (Tabelog).
osaka_wa_french_baru_sonjuku_shinmachi.notes: [French-Japanese bar · Shinmachi, until 3 a.m.] A late-night bistro bar by Yotsubashi Station where a chef from a long-established Kyoto hotel mixes Kyoto and French cooking, in a room styled like a late-Edo townhouse. Order the beef sirloin wrapped in puff pastry (¥990 in June 2026) that regulars insist on, the dashi omelette, foie gras and an eight-item appetiser plate, with an inexpensive glass of wine. Open every night until 3 a.m.; a ¥4,980 course with drinks suits groups. A sister of イタリアン チャイナバル村塾 in Namba, different concept.

roles: Chef formerly of a long-established Kyoto hotel, unnamed (Tabelog shop text)
chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop text: authentic Kyoto cuisine and French dishes by a former chef of a long-established Kyoto hotel; the interior was designed by the makers of the TV show "Gekiteki Before After", inspired by the machiya of the late Edo period, and the name nods to the "Matsushita Village School" and its pupils (Tabelog shop text). A July 2026 regular was glad to see the cheerful owner again.
chef_bio.specialty: Beef sirloin in puff pastry; dashi omelette; foie gras.

anecdotes.text: "Definitely Order the Sirloin Wrapped in Pastry, a Strong Ally for Late-Night Dining." — July 2026.
"I was so happy to see the cheerful owner again!" — July 2026, red wine, prosciutto and penne arrabbiata.
"It's great that I could enjoy a glass of rosé sparkling wine for just one coin." — August 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 和フレンチバル村塾、バル・イタリアン・フレンチ、大阪市西区新町1-7-5 YOTSUBASHI GTC BLDG1F、四ツ橋駅から徒歩2分、心斎橋駅から徒歩4分、毎日17:30〜翌3:00 (L.O. 2:30)、GW・お盆も休まず、ランチは休止中、年中無休 (年末年始は要確認)、予約可、カード・電子マネー・PayPay・楽天ペイ可、37席 (カウンター13、テーブル24)、23時までは加熱式たばこのみ、テラスは喫煙可、京都の老舗ホテル出身の料理人の京料理とフレンチ、幕末の町家をイメージした店内。口コミ(2026年6月〜10月): 前菜8種盛り1,590円、牛サーロインのパイ包み990円、牛サーロインの串390円、ウニのクリームご飯1,390円、京風だし巻き、鶏と卵のガトー、キッシュとパテとバゲット、エビとアボカドのタルタルとモナカ、フォアグラ、ポークソテー、キーマカレー、ペンネアラビアータ、生ハム、2時間飲み放題つきのコース4,980円、ワンコインのロゼのスパークリング、明るいオーナー、いつも混んでいるので予約を。

cultural_comfort.note: À la carte or a drinks course; open late (2026). No English evidence found.

osaka_table_36_swissotel.gf_detail: Ask when booking; the listing says allergy information is available. The buffet has carved meats, salads and around 30 desserts alongside pizza, risotto, gratin and curries; nothing is described as gluten-free.
osaka_table_36_swissotel.vegan_detail: Ask. No vegan information. The buffet includes seasonal vegetable salads and fruit, but most dishes are built on meat, seafood or dairy.
osaka_table_36_swissotel.hours_raw: Breakfast daily 6:30–10:30 (last order 10:00); lunch Mon–Fri 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:30), Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–15:30 (last order 15:00); dinner 18:00–23:30 (last order 22:45), on Fri and Sat until 24:30 (last order 23:45) (Tabelog). Reservations accepted online 24 hours a day (Tabelog). Live music on Friday, Saturday and Sunday (Tabelog; July 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay) (Tabelog). 150 seats, window seats over the city, a private room for 8–12; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; hotel parking free for 2 hours with ¥6,000 spent (Tabelog). Reach it via the 6F hotel lobby (August 2026).
osaka_table_36_swissotel.notes: [Buffet and steak · Namba, 36 floors up] The restaurant of Swissotel Nankai Osaka on the 36th floor, straight above Nankai Namba Station, known for its lunch buffet and the view over the city from 147 m. The weekday buffet (¥5,900 in autumn 2026) runs from international dishes and a live kitchen of carved meats to some 30 desserts that diners return to again and again; breakfast and steak dinners with live music at weekends are the other draws. Book a window table; take the lift to the 6F lobby, then on to 36F. One October 2026 diner found the floor short of staff.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop text: a lunch buffet and dinner with views from 147 m above ground, directly connected to Namba Station, an open kitchen, American-style à la carte and premium steaks at dinner, live performances on Friday to Sunday. A July 2026 breakfast diner notes the hotel belongs to the Accor group.
chef_bio.specialty: Lunch buffet with live kitchen and desserts; wagyu and tomahawk steaks.

anecdotes.text: "I ended up ordering the egg tart, canelé, and chocolate fondue three times!" — July 2026, a window seat at lunch.
"I wasn't sure how to get to the 36th floor, so I first went to the lobby on the 6th floor and then took the elevator to the 36th floor." — August 2026, the lunch buffet.
"They offer a variety of distinctive ingredients such as cilantro, salsa, century egg, and hummus." — July 2026, breakfast at 6:30.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): テーブル36、イタリアン・ダイニングバー・洋菓子、大阪市中央区難波5-1-60 スイスホテル南海大阪 36F、南海なんば駅直結、地上147mの眺め、朝食6:30〜10:30、ランチ平日11:30〜15:00・土日祝11:00〜15:30、ディナー18:00〜23:30 (金・土は24:30まで)、ネット予約は24時間、カード可、150席、8〜12名の個室、禁煙、車いす可、駐車場 (6,000円で2時間無料)、オープンキッチン、平日のインターナショナルランチビュッフェ5,900円 (2026年秋はポルチーニのリゾット、さつまいもと栗のグラタン、フィリピンのポークアドボ、タイのグリーンカレー、平日はラムのランプ、週末はリブロース、栗・さつまいも・かぼちゃのデザート)、約30種のスイーツ、夜はアメリカンなアラカルトと和牛やトマホークのステーキ、金・土・日はライブ、アレルギー表示あり。口コミ(2026年7月〜10月): 窓からの眺め、エッグタルト、カヌレ、チョコレートフォンデュ、ブルーベリーマフィン、目の前で切るローストビーフ、朝食にパクチー、サルサ、ピータン、フムス、果物、フリーフロー4,400円、6階のロビーからエレベーター、スタッフが足りないと感じた口コミも。

cultural_comfort.note: A buffet where you serve yourself, in an international hotel with many overseas guests (July 2026). No English menu evidence found.

osaka_kitashinchi_kuroneko.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The courses include a hot pie, a zeppole that tastes like takoyaki, bread with butter and a black tantanmen as one meat choice; fish, meat and dessert are chosen from several options.
osaka_kitashinchi_kuroneko.vegan_detail: Not vegan: set courses of fish, meat (duck, wagyu, foie gras, pork) and dessert; the soup is a potage; no vegetarian course is mentioned.
osaka_kitashinchi_kuroneko.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:30 and dinner 18:00–22:00, Mon, Tue and Thu–Sun; closed Wednesdays and the first and third Tuesday of the month (reservations can be made for closed days) (Tabelog). One drink per person required; no service charge (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 14 seats: a counter of 9 and a private L-shaped counter room for 3–5; whole-shop hire up to 20; non-smoking; wheelchair users asked to call ahead; children welcome (Tabelog). A queue had formed before the 12:00 opening (September 2026).
osaka_kitashinchi_kuroneko.notes: [French · Kitashinchi, a creative course with a cat theme] A basement counter in Kitashinchi full of black-cat figurines, where the chef cooks a free-style French course that also borrows from Italian, Japanese and Chinese cooking. Each course opens with a pumpkin potage you scatter with homemade popcorn, then a 'palette' of small, intricate starters, among them a zeppole that tastes like takoyaki, before you pick a fish, a meat (the Hungarian duck with glazed apples is the favourite, foie gras extra) and a dessert such as the autumn parfait. Lunch from about ¥5,300, dinner ¥6,900. Anniversaries are a speciality: message plates and a black-cat whole cake. In October 2026 two men did all the cooking and serving. Its first shop is in Fukushima.

roles: Chef-owner (unnamed) and one other staff member

osaka_yakitori_sumiemon_kitashinchi.notes: [Yakitori · Kitashinchi, Kyoto chicken at a U-shaped counter] A 20-seat yakitori counter in Kitashinchi, open since April 2025, that grills only Kyoto's long-raised 'Bihaku' white chicken. Most diners take the course of ten skewers and two vegetable skewers, about ¥5,300 in October 2026 (¥6,280 on the listing now), served one at a time with salt or sauce: deboned wings, crisp 'giza kawa' skin, a tender breast and fluffy tsukune are the ones diners name. Add chicken sashimi or yukhoe before, and finish with the tsukune rice bowl 'Donemon' or a light chicken ramen and the house pudding. It fills within minutes on weekdays, so book; walk-ins are welcome. One diner in October 2026 found the flavours mild and the portions of sashimi small.

osaka_tolah_umeda_doyama.notes: [Italian · east of Umeda, drink-inclusive courses and a terrace] A large Italian dining bar on the fourth floor of a new building on the Higashi-Nakadori shopping street east of Umeda, dressed as a resort, with a terrace and sofa-lined private rooms that take birthday groups and company parties. At lunch about ¥1,900 buys a starter platter, a pasta and all the warm focaccia you want; at night the draw is the ¥5,000 course with two hours of drinks, wine included, that starts with ten colourful starters before a wagyu-and-cheese pasta, fries with whipped butter and grilled chicken. Diners in 2026 praise the portions and the price; several found the service slow when it was busy, and one October 2026 group had dessert ten minutes before its time was up.

osaka_yakitori_matsuri_dojima.notes: [Yakitori · Dojima, a Hinai-chicken course] A refined, dim 12-seat yakitori counter in Dojima, on Tabelog's Yakitori WEST 100 list in 2023, 2024 and 2025, whose chef trained at Ichimatsu in Kitashinchi, the shop credited with the yakitori course. Every skewer is Hinai chicken from Akita, seasoned with chicken fat, snow salt or a sweet soy sauce and timed to each diner's pace, and the 16-dish course weaves in grilled grapes, aged chicken prosciutto, a chicken shumai and a seasonal rice. The olive-oil daikon between skewers is refillable; one diner heard of a guest who ate 33 plates (September 2026). Course ¥13,200, or ¥17,800 with four drinks; two-hour seatings, the first at 15:30 on Fridays and Saturdays. English menu and English-speaking staff.

osaka_dotonbori_craft_beer_namba_city.notes: [Izakaya · Namba, the brewery's own kushikatsu bar] The house izakaya of Dotonbori Brewery, a craft brewer in the basement of the Shochikuza theatre, in a big, calm room on the ground floor of Namba CITY South a minute from Nankai Namba. Every Dotonbori Beer is on tap, Osaka Kölsch, Porter and Alt among them, beside kushikatsu, fried chicken and giant gyoza. Lunch is good value: sets were ¥890 and ¥990 in August 2026 with free miso soup refills, and a lunch drinking set brings edamame, five kushikatsu and a pint. Private rooms and tatami halls make it a party venue, with all-you-can-drink that includes the craft beer. One August 2026 diner found the beer list limited. Hours follow the mall.

osaka_kaniyoshi_west_dotonbori.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Crab and fugu sashimi come with dipping sauces, courses include crab tempura and hot pot, and the fin sake and crab sake are other things to ask about.
osaka_kaniyoshi_west_dotonbori.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a crab and fugu specialist; every course is seafood.
osaka_kaniyoshi_west_dotonbori.hours_raw: Daily 12:00–3:00 the next morning, food last order 1:00; open year-round (Tabelog). The same listing also says last order 2:00 and last entry 1:00, and its headline says "12 PM to midnight" (Tabelog). On weekday lunchtimes the sister shop 蟹吉PREMIUM, 30 seconds away, is open; groups may be moved between the three Namba shops (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; online bookings for 11 or more need a course (Tabelog). In season, a regular found only slots after 20:30 (October 2026); a 2-hour limit at an early sitting (November 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 70 seats, private rooms (one per floor) and sunken seating, parties up to 20 (Tabelog; November 2026). Smoking allowed throughout; non-smokers can ask for a room by an opening window (Tabelog; May 2026). Opened 21 August 2013 (Tabelog).
osaka_kaniyoshi_west_dotonbori.notes: [Crab and fugu · Dotonbori, courses until 3 a.m.] A crab and fugu house at the west end of Dotonbori, with a tank of fugu swimming out front and a private room on each floor, some by windows over the canal boats. It is one of three Kaniyoshi shops in Namba, and the courses do the work: snow crab from ¥12,100, crab and fugu together for ¥13,750 (April 2026), up to a three-crab feast. Crab sashimi with a dip of egg yolk and crab miso is the dish diners remember; staff grill crab and fugu on a charcoal shichirin at the table and finish with rice porridge. Two October 2026 diners judged the crab frozen, and one found the crab tempura the weak dish. Smoking is allowed throughout. Open daily to 3 a.m.

roles: Kitchen and room staff (unnamed); staff grill and cook at the table
chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained Tabelog listing: crab and fugu specialist two minutes from Namba Station, open noon to 3 a.m.; snow crab from the Sea of Okhotsk; grilled crab and fugu cooked on a shichirin in front of the diner; private rooms, one per floor; three Kaniyoshi locations near Namba (the listing also writes Kani Kichi and Kanikichi PREMIUM for the sister shops); opened 21 August 2013.
chef_bio.specialty: Crab and fugu courses.

anecdotes.text: "There was a tank in front of the restaurant with many fugu swimming around." — May 2026.
"The grilled fugu was cooked by a lovely lady on a shichirin (charcoal grill), and the aroma filled the air while it was being grilled." — July 2026.
"The crab was not live but frozen, yet it was packed with meat, fresh, and had a delightful sweetness." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): かに・ふぐ専門 蟹吉WEST なんば道頓堀、かに・ふぐ・日本料理、大阪市中央区道頓堀2-4-5、なんば駅25番出口から徒歩2分、毎日12:00〜27:00 (料理L.O.25:00)、年中無休、平日の昼は徒歩30秒の姉妹店 蟹吉PREMIUM が営業、なんばに3店あり予約時に別の店を案内することも、予約可、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、70席、個室は各階1室、掘りごたつ、全席喫煙可、2013年8月21日オープン、オホーツク海のずわいがに、目の前の七輪で焼くかにとふぐ。コース: ずわいがに12,100円、ずわいがにとふぐ13,750円、3大がに24,200円、ふぐ15,400円、白子つきの活ふぐ11,000円、ひれ酒とかに酒の飲み放題2,750円。口コミ(2026年3月〜11月): かに刺し、卵黄とかにみそのたれ、かにの甲羅に注ぐ日本酒、雑炊、焼き白子、店の前のふぐの水槽、窓から観光船が見える個室、たらばがにとずわいがにのランチのコース17,050円、冷凍のかにだったという声が2件、かにの天ぷらはいまひとつという声、シーズンは20時半以降しか空かないことも。

cultural_comfort.note: Set courses in private rooms; staff cook at the table. Overseas staff noted (November 2026). No English menu evidence found.

osaka_wa_tori_bar_honten.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The rock-salt grilled chicken is seasoned with salt; the kara-age is fried and the sashimi comes with soy sauce.
osaka_wa_tori_bar_honten.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken restaurant; even the side dishes include broccoli with cheese fondue.
osaka_wa_tori_bar_honten.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 17:00–3:00 the next morning (last order 2:00); Sun and holidays 17:00–24:00 (last order 23:00); may close early when supplies run out; irregular closing days, ask about Obon, New Year and Golden Week (Tabelog; official site). Reservations accepted; when busy a two-hour limit; if Tabelog shows no seats, try Google or phone (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and QR payments; no e-money (Tabelog). 30 seats: 9 at the counter on 1F, tables and sofas on 2F for groups up to 20–22; the stairs are steep and the toilet is on 1F (Tabelog; June and October 2026). Smoking allowed (Tabelog; September and October 2026). English menu (Tabelog).
osaka_wa_tori_bar_honten.notes: [Yakitori · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, a chicken bar down an alley] A small chicken bar hidden down a Higashi-Shinsaibashi back alley, with nine counter seats downstairs and sofa tables up a steep stair. The chicken is fresh Daisen bird, and the kitchen goes beyond skewers: pieces grilled on a hot rock-salt slab and served off the stick, chicken sashimi with foamed soy sauce, and the house kara-age of breast fried rare, eaten with grated daikon and ponzu. Broccoli with cheese fondue has its own fans, and a half oyakodon makes a good finish. Courses with all-you-can-drink run ¥4,400–5,500. Diners in 2026 praised the friendly staff and the owner's good humour. Smoking is allowed. Open to 3 a.m. except Sundays.

roles: Owner (unnamed; September 2026 review) and grill staff
chef_bio.background: Official site (watoribar.com): a hideaway yakitori izakaya in a back alley six minutes from Shinsaibashi Station exit 5, using fresh 大山産がいなどり for creative chicken dishes such as sashimi, "Mune Pon" kara-age fried rare to stay tender and juicy, and chicken grilled on heated rock salt; sofa seats on 2F; a second shop in Tenma and a sister restaurant 屋台CHU華 ジャスミン. Shop-maintained Tabelog listing: creative chicken dishes from freshly sourced local chicken, smoking allowed.
chef_bio.specialty: Rock-salt grilled chicken; rare "Mune Pon" kara-age; chicken sashimi.

anecdotes.text: "Here, the grilled chicken is served on a square rock salt plate, and the seasoning is just right—elegantly balanced." — October 2026.
"The rare chicken kara-age is truly amazing. There's no unpleasant odor, and it has a great texture!" — September 2026.
"The owner is also a fun person, which made the experience enjoyable." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (watoribar.com): 心斎橋駅5番出口から徒歩約6分の路地裏の隠れ家の焼き鳥居酒屋「WA鶏BAR (ワトリバー)」、新鮮な大山産がいなどりの創作鶏料理、お造り、レアに揚げた「ムネポン唐揚げ」、熱した岩塩の上で焼く「岩塩焼き」、季節の日本酒、ワイン、果実酒、2階はソファー席で20人まで、月〜土17時〜翌3時・日祝17時〜24時、不定休、天満店、姉妹店 屋台CHU華 ジャスミン。食べログ (店舗会員): WA鶏BAR 本店、焼き鳥・日本料理・バル、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-5-7、予約可 (混雑時は2時間制)、カード・QR 可、電子マネー不可、30席 (1階カウンター9席、2階テーブル)、喫煙可、英語のメニューあり、飲み放題つきのコース4,400円と5,500円。口コミ(2024年12月〜2026年10月): 岩塩の板で串なしで出る焼き鳥、レアの唐揚げと大根おろしとポン酢、泡の醤油の鶏刺し、骨つきの鶏、よだれ鶏、ハラミとせせり、ブロッコリーのチーズフォンデュ、ポテトサラダ、むねのジャーキー、かき揚げ、ハーフの親子丼、芋焼酎の Maho、2階への階段は急、スタッフも店主も楽しいという声。

osaka_fuyoen_nagahoribashi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Sichuan sauces and the noodle and dumpling dishes are the things to ask about; lunch sets come with kara-age.
osaka_fuyoen_nagahoribashi.vegan_detail: Ask. No vegan information. Mapo tofu is made with meat; stir-fried garlic and vegetables, stir-fried green beans and potatoes are the vegetable dishes reviewers name.
osaka_fuyoen_nagahoribashi.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); 1F seating until 22:00, 2F until 22:30; table bookings limited to 2 hours (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; for hot pot book the sister 芙蓉苑 火鍋城 (Tabelog). One-drink policy (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), transport IC cards and other e-money, and QR payments (Tabelog). 42 seats: 8 at the counter, 24 at tables, a 2F VIP room for 10 (2 hours free with a ¥30,000 minimum, ¥500 table charge per person) (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Order by QR code at the table (April and July 2026). Opened 29 December 2015 (Tabelog).
osaka_fuyoen_nagahoribashi.notes: [Sichuan · Nagahoribashi, mapo tofu by the station exit] A Sichuan restaurant right beside Nagahoribashi Station exit 3, with chefs and ingredients brought from the source (Tabelog) and Chinese staff, some speaking a little Japanese. Lunch is the bargain: a mapo tofu set with rice refills, kara-age and almond tofu was ¥1,000 in 2026, spice level your choice, ordered by QR code; at noon it was packed in December 2025 and quiet in July 2026. At dinner, try the stone-grilled mapo tofu finished at the table, twice-cooked pork, cumin lamb or saliva chicken, with Shaoxing wine. A regular notes that taste and portions shift when the chef changes, and that rice bowls had shrunk by April 2026. For hot pot, the sister Fuyo En Hot Pot Castle is the place. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained Tabelog listing: authentic Sichuan cuisine with chefs and ingredients gathered from the source, a minute from Nagahoribashi Station beside exit 3; opened 29 December 2015; hot pot at the sister shop 芙蓉苑 火鍋城 (Tabelog 27102144). Reviews in 2025–2026 describe Chinese staff, some speaking broken Japanese.
chef_bio.specialty: Mapo tofu; Sichuan set lunches.

anecdotes.text: "The staff prepared it in front of us, just like stone-grilled bibimbap" — December 2025, the stone-grilled mapo tofu ¥1,300.
"I ordered the Mapo Tofu Set Meal (JPY 1000). Credit card payments are accepted!" — April 2026.
"Sometimes the chef changes, which can lead to variations in taste and portion sizes, but I accept that as part of the experience." — April 2026.

osaka_eigyochu_higashimikuni.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: lunch sets come with kara-age, and Taiwanese ramen, mapo noodles, fried noodles and gyoza are wheat.
osaka_eigyochu_higashimikuni.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a Taiwanese-Chinese diner of pork, chicken and shrimp dishes; mapo tofu with minced meat.
osaka_eigyochu_higashimikuni.hours_raw: Daily including holidays 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30) (Tabelog). Lunch specials are cash or PayPay only; cards (VISA, Master) are accepted for à la carte and courses (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, also for lunch (2026). 82 seats on Tabelog, tables plus private and semi-private rooms, groups up to 100 (Tabelog); a 2026 diner counted about 48 at the tables. Smoking allowed at dinner, ask about lunch (Tabelog); smoke bothered an October 2026 diner. Self-service coffee after lunch (May and August 2026). Opened 22 March 2024 (Tabelog).
osaka_eigyochu_higashimikuni.notes: [Taiwanese-Chinese · Higashimikuni, a big diner at the station stairs] A large Taiwanese-style Chinese restaurant right at the foot of the Higashimikuni Station stairs, open since 2024 every day from 11:00 to 23:00, with tables, private rooms and courses for groups. Lunch is the bargain: a set around ¥950 of mapo tofu, Taiwanese ramen, fried noodles or fried rice with kara-age, unlimited rice and soup, and self-service coffee after (2026); it fills with office workers by 12:20. In the evening there is a ¥1,180 After Work Set of a drink, gyoza and a starter, all-you-can-drink for ¥3,580 and all-you-can-eat courses (2026). Portions are generous. Lunch specials are cash or PayPay only. Smoking is allowed at dinner.

chef_bio.background: No shop description on Tabelog beyond payment notes; opened 22 March 2024 (Tabelog). The osaka-kita crawl also lists 台湾料理 営業中 福島店.
chef_bio.specialty: Lunch sets with unlimited rice; mapo tofu; all-you-can-eat courses.

anecdotes.text: "They offer self-service coffee after the meal, with both hot and iced options available, which was a nice touch." — May 2026, the happosai set.
"For JPY 1,280, you get Mapo Tofu, stir-fried liver with garlic chives, soup, rice, and almond jelly!" — October 2026.
"A drink (like draft beer) + grilled gyoza + one appetizer for just JPY 1,180!" — September 2026, the After Work Set.

osaka_sichuan_ramen_nishinakajima.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat noodles in the tantanmen and mapo noodles; yurinchi is battered.
osaka_sichuan_ramen_nishinakajima.vegan_detail: Not vegan: tantanmen with braised pork, mapo tofu with minced meat.
osaka_sichuan_ramen_nishinakajima.hours_raw: Mon–Wed 11:30–14:30 and 18:30–02:00; Thu–Sat 11:30–14:30 and 18:30–03:00; Sun 11:30–14:30 and 18:30–01:00; open every day; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations; no cards or e-money; PayPay accepted (Tabelog). 28 seats at counter and tables; smoking allowed (Tabelog). About 60% full at 21:00 on a Wednesday (September 2026). Follow the shop on Instagram for free rice or frozen lychee (October 2026).
osaka_sichuan_ramen_nishinakajima.notes: [Sichuan noodles · Nishinakajima, tantanmen into the small hours] A dark-walled Sichuan noodle shop two minutes from Nishinakajima-Minamigata, open for lunch and again from 18:30 until 1 to 3 am every night, so it fills with late diners (September 2026). The tantanmen comes in an original, lighter version and a creamy-sesame "Sichuan street style", both with tender braised pork; the mapo noodles are the hotter choice, numbing with Sichuan pepper, with rice to drop into the last of the sauce (2026). A row of condiments, from chili oil and Sichuan pepper to lychee vinegar, lets you set the heat. Lunch can feel rushed (October 2026). Smoking is allowed. A fan from its old Hankyu Sanbangai days came back for it in October 2026.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog listing: authentic Sichuan dishes in a casual setting, the menu in Chinese characters with Japanese descriptions and flavours adjusted to local tastes. An October 2026 diner "used to frequent Sichuan Ramen when it had a location in Hankyu Sanbangai".
chef_bio.specialty: Tantanmen; mapo noodles.

anecdotes.text: "Located in the bustling area of Nishinakajima Minamikata, it stays open late, and even at this hour, the place was about 60% full." — September 2026, around 21:00 on a Wednesday.
"When I added the leftover rice to the Mapo soup, it turned into a delicious Mapo rice bowl, allowing me to savor every last drop." — August 2026, the mapo noodles for JPY 1,250.
"As a special for following on Instagram, I received frozen lychee, which was perfect for refreshing my palate after the spicy meal." — October 2026.

osaka_hortensia_bistro_higashimikuni.hours_raw: Tue, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–14:30 (last order 13:30; Fri food 13:00) and 17:30–22:30 (last food order 20:30, drinks 22:00); Wed dinner only, 17:30–22:30, booking by phone; closed Monday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; groups of five or more by phone; a booking lapses 30 minutes after the time without notice (Tabelog). Often fully booked at weekend and holiday lunches (March and May 2026). Preschool children welcome at lunch, not at dinner (Tabelog). One drink each, or a ¥1,000 seat charge (Tabelog's original text: ワンドリンク制にしております。ドリンク飲まれない方は席料1000円お願いしております。). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay (Tabelog). 20 seats: 8 on sofas, 8 at tables, 4 at the counter; an open terrace; non-smoking; wheelchair access; one parking space if free, by arrangement (Tabelog).
osaka_hortensia_bistro_higashimikuni.notes: [French · Higashimikuni, a bistro with game on the menu] A small, bright French bistro two minutes from Higashimikuni Station, with sofa seats and a little terrace, known for its game: Kagoshima badger with foie gras, Spanish mountain quail, rabbit wrapped around shrimp in the ¥8,800 Menu Hortensia (May and September 2026). Lunch is the easier way in, a ¥3,000 course of a generous appetiser platter, soup, a main such as the house hamburg steak or grilled pork, and a plate of small desserts, and it is often fully booked, so reserve (2026). Dishes are explained with care, and there is a good wine list; one drink each or a ¥1,000 seat charge. No preschool children at dinner. Closed Monday; Wednesday dinner only.

chef_bio.background: No shop description on Tabelog. Reviewers: "a French restaurant by a famous chef" (October 2023); "This bistro is known for its game meat" (December 2025); the manager and staff were friendly and warm (May 2026); dishes and drinks are explained thoroughly (September 2026). It also makes a French osechi for New Year (December 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Game courses; lunch course with hamburg steak.

anecdotes.text: "The Assorted Appetizers were so generous that I was completely satisfied just with that!" — March 2026, a course with the fish main.
"Kagoshima Prefecture Anaguma Royale with Foie Gras" (+JPY 2,200) — May 2026, the Menu Hortensia for JPY 8,800.
"I honestly didn't have high expectations for the desserts, but I was pleasantly surprised by the assortment of petite desserts!" — May 2026, the JPY 3,000 lunch course.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: Hortensia Bistro、ビストロ・フレンチ・ワインバー、大阪市淀川区東三国4-15-12 シオザキビル 1F、東三国駅5番出口から徒歩2分、新大阪から10分、火・木・金・土・日・祝11:30〜14:30、17:30〜22:30、水曜は夜だけ (電話で予約)、月曜休み、5名以上は電話で、連絡なく30分遅れるとキャンセル、未就学児は昼のみ、ワンドリンク制 (飲まない人は席料1,000円)、カード・PayPay 可、20席 (ソファ8、テーブル8、カウンター4)、オープンテラス、禁煙、車いす可。口コミ(2023年10月〜2026年9月): ジビエで知られるビストロ、昼のコース3,000円 (前菜の盛り合わせ、かぶやカリフラワーのスープ、ハンバーグ、豚ロース、鯛のフリット、鴨のコンフィ、デザートの盛り合わせ、コーヒー)、予約でカヌレのサービス、魚と肉の昼のコース5,500円 (Aomori の豚の低温調理)、「Menu Hortensia」8,800円 (トリュフのポテトサラダ、アスパラ・ソヴァージュとリエット、白アスパラと生ハムと温泉卵、鶏のコンソメ、鮎、Kagoshima のアナグマとフォアグラ、スペインの山うずら、米粉のカヌレ)、エビをうさぎで巻いた一皿、アールグレイのクレームブリュレ、ワイン、フレンチのおせち、週末の昼は予約でいっぱい、ていねいな説明。

cultural_comfort.note: Courses explained dish by dish; book ahead, by phone for five or more. No English evidence found.

osaka_shoginan_higashimikuni.vegan_detail: Not vegan: soba sauce and kayaku rice on dashi, beef tongue, fish and egg dishes.
osaka_shoginan_higashimikuni.hours_raw: Mon–Wed 11:00–14:00 and 17:30–23:00 (last order 22:30); Thu 17:30–23:00; Fri 11:00–14:00 and 17:30–24:00 (last order 23:30); Sat 11:00–14:30 and 17:30–23:00; Sun 11:00–15:00 and 17:30–22:00; holidays 11:00–22:30; until sold out; closing days not fixed (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Lines at weekday lunch (October 2026).
osaka_shoginan_higashimikuni.notes: [Soba · Higashimikuni, ju-wari soba in an old house] A soba restaurant in a renovated old house down a narrow lane two minutes from Higashimikuni Station, with an old carved ranma set into the wall and "Ju-wari Soba" on the front (April 2026). By day it serves all-buckwheat soba sets, cold or hot, with generous sides: a ¥1,300 daily set of soba, kayaku rice, freshly made dashimaki and a tenderloin cutlet with daikon ponzu (April 2026). By night it becomes a soba izakaya with thick-cut grilled beef tongue, tempura, dashimaki, seasonal fish and a sake list running to Juyondai, finished with soba (2026). One diner found prices high and the upstairs tables cramped (July 2026). Weekday lunch draws a line; order by QR code upstairs.

chef_bio.background: No shop description on Tabelog. Reviewers: a renovated traditional house with a carved ranma "originally from the home of the former owner of this traditional house" (April 2026); soba tea is served, a sign of pride in the soba to one June 2026 diner; compared with the nearby soba shop Atariya (July 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Ju-wari soba; thick-cut grilled beef tongue; dashimaki.

anecdotes.text: "I sprinkled some salt from the table onto the soba and enjoyed it. The soba was chilled to perfection and paired wonderfully with the salt." — April 2026, the daily set for ¥1,300.
"The thick-cut grilled beef tongue was tender and incredibly delicious." — May 2026, with Juyondai junmai daiginjo.
"My mother wanted to eat soba, so we went on Saturday around 12:30 PM." — August 2026, tempura, sushi and daily sets with zaru soba.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 松吟庵 東三国店、居酒屋・牛タン・そば、大阪市淀川区東三国1-33-21、Midosuji 線 東三国駅4番出口から徒歩2分、月〜水11:00〜14:00、17:30〜23:00、木曜17:30〜23:00、金11:00〜14:00、17:30〜24:00、土11:00〜14:30、17:30〜23:00、日11:00〜15:00、17:30〜22:00、祝11:00〜22:30、売り切れまで、不定休、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、20席、2階にテーブル2つ、8名以上は個室、禁煙。口コミ(2025年3月〜2026年10月): 古民家を改装、ranma、「Ju-wari Soba」の看板、昼はJu-wari そばの定食 (冷たいか温かいか)、日替わり定食1,300円 (かやくごはん、だし巻き、ヒレカツのおろしポン酢)、肉じゃがの日替わり、天ぷらとざるそば、巻き寿司とさば寿司とざるそば、とり天、夜は厚切りの牛タン、だし巻き、カツオのたたき、チキン南蛮、焼きなす、ニシンの甘露煮、舞茸の天ぷら、豚せいろ、鱧、カキフライ、里芋の揚げ物、Oni Oroshi Bukkake Soba、生ガキのポン酢、Juyondai の純米大吟醸、そば茶、QR コードで注文、平日の昼は行列、値段が高く2階は狭いという声も。

osaka_hillman_namba.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The paper chicken is marinated in a sauce sent from Singapore (August 2026), and the chili crab, black-pepper prawns, laksa and mantou all use sauces or wheat; steamed chicken and stir-fried greens are where to start asking.
osaka_hillman_namba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Singaporean and Chinese dishes of chicken, crab, prawns and pork; sambal kangkung (water spinach) is made with sambal, which is not described.
osaka_hillman_namba.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 16:30–23:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–14:30 and 16:30–23:00; last orders 14:00 and 22:30 (Tabelog). A weekend and holiday lunch course ¥2,200 (September 2026). Reservations; all-you-can-drink courses and discount deals (2026 reviews). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), IC cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 100 seats, sofas, private rooms for 6–8, private hire for over 50; non-smoking; children and strollers welcome; takeaway (Tabelog). The entrance is on the back street Sen’nichi Jizoson-dori, not the office-building side (August 2026). Opened 6 October 2014 (Tabelog).
osaka_hillman_namba.notes: [Singaporean · Ura Namba, Hillman's paper chicken in Osaka] The Osaka branch of Singapore's Hillman Restaurant, upstairs on an Ura Namba back street since 2014 (an older Kitashinchi branch has closed, a September 2026 diner notes). The dish to order is the paper chicken, marinated chicken cooked sealed in paper with paper and sauce sent from Singapore, one piece at a time for ¥290. Then chili crab with fried mantou to wipe up the sauce, black-pepper prawns, bak kut teh, laksa and sambal water spinach. The heat is gentler than some expect (October 2026). A roomy, stylish space for groups, with all-you-can-drink courses and a ¥2,200 weekend lunch course. Diners in 2026 were mostly pleased; one found the appetizer plate poor value. Find the entrance from Sen’nichi Jizoson-dori. Open evenings daily, plus weekend lunch.

chef_bio.background: Per 2026 reviews: the Osaka branch of Hillman Restaurant in Singapore, known there for paper chicken; the paper and the sauce for it are sent from the Singapore original (the manager, per an August 2026 diner); a former Kitashinchi branch has closed, leaving Namba and Singapore (September 2026). Opened 6 October 2014 (Tabelog). The official site carries little beyond the shop name and booking link.
chef_bio.specialty: Paper chicken; chili crab with mantou; bak kut teh.

anecdotes.text: "I also learned that the paper and sauce are sent from the original restaurant in Singapore." — August 2026, a second visit after first eating the paper chicken in Singapore seven years earlier.
"The mantou (fried bread) served with the chili crab was especially amazing!" — August 2026.
"The initial assortment of four appetizers was a bit disappointing for over JPY 1200." — September 2026, a diner who knew the old Kitashinchi branch.

osaka_micasadeco_cafe_namba.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Every pancake, toast and pasta is wheat-based; omelette rice, keema curry and salads are where to start asking.
osaka_micasadeco_cafe_namba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: ricotta pancakes, egg dishes and cream-topped seasonal pancakes; no vegan item is listed at this shop.
osaka_micasadeco_cafe_namba.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00 (last order 16:00); Sat, Sun and holidays 09:00–18:00 (last order 17:00); closed 31 December–3 January (official site; Tabelog). Morning menu 09:00–11:00 at this shop only; pancakes and food from 11:00 (official site). Hours may change; check Instagram (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Order from your phone (July and October 2026); free Wi-Fi; separate bills possible (July 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), IC cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 27 seats with sofas; non-smoking, ashtrays outside; children and strollers welcome; takeaway and delivery (Tabelog). Opened 16 September 2013 (Tabelog), the first shop of the brand (official site).
osaka_micasadeco_cafe_namba.notes: [Café · Namba, the original ricotta "dancing pancake"] The first Micasadeco&Cafe, opened in 2013 beside Namba Hatch, where the brand's ricotta pancakes became known as "dancing pancakes" for the way the three tall, wobbly layers arrive at the table; the site says the ricotta pancake won three stars at the SARAH Japan Menu Award 2018 for Kansai pancakes. They are made to order (about 20 minutes), light and only lightly sweet, at ¥1,750; there are chewy plain pancakes, seasonal specials, brunch plates and pasta too, and a morning menu here from 9:00. The queues of the pancake boom have gone and you can usually walk in, order from your phone and stay a while. A 2026 regular and others note that nearly all the guests, and some staff, come from overseas, which the site says is the target. Open daytime only, closed over the New Year.

roles: Run by 株式会社インデペンデント (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: "Mi casa" is Spanish for "my home" and "Deco" stands for decoration; the first shop opened in Osaka Namba in 2013; the brand now has shops in Osaka (Namba and THE PARK in なノにわ), Tokyo (Jingumae) and Kyoto, and invites franchise enquiries; its theme is "Cool & Cute", aimed at overseas visitors and fashion-minded young people; the ricotta pancake, cooked one at a time after ordering, won three stars, the top rating, in the Kansai pancake section of the SARAH Japan Menu Award 2018 (second half). Opened 16 September 2013 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: A place to feel at home, away from everyday life: "delicious, cute, fun" (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Ricotta cheese pancake; seasonal pancakes.

anecdotes.text: "When the staff brought them over, the pancakes were wobbling side to side, looking so soft and beautifully pale." — August 2026, a twenty-minute wait.
"A few years ago, when I visited, there was a huge line due to the pancake craze, and I had to wait every time. But now, it seems the trend has passed" — May 2026.
"Since it was just before 11 AM on a weekday, the restaurant was mostly filled with foreign customers." — September 2026, a seventh visit.

osaka_dining_stage_sakaiya_asahi_namba.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Sashimi, grilled fish and dashimaki are the plainest; the signature croquettes, large fried prawns, tempura, fried oysters and the ramen are wheat-based.
osaka_dining_stage_sakaiya_asahi_namba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood izakaya; the croquettes contain meat (nikujaga) or cream, and the set meals come with fish and miso soup.
osaka_dining_stage_sakaiya_asahi_namba.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:00) and 17:00–22:00 (last orders food 21:00, drinks 21:30); closed over the New Year (Tabelog). Reservations; two hours when busy (Tabelog). Dinner adds a ¥500 appetizer charge (choose two small dishes, October 2026) (Tabelog). Order by tablet; rice and miso soup refills at lunch (2026 reviews). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), IC cards, iD, QUICPay and QR (Tabelog). 80 seats: 12 at the counter, tables, and a horigotatsu room for 15–20; private hire up to 50; non-smoking; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog).
osaka_dining_stage_sakaiya_asahi_namba.notes: [Izakaya · Namba, the relocated Sakaiya of croquette lunches] A basement seafood izakaya across the road from Takashimaya that many diners know as the old Sakaiya, a popular Namba lunch spot that closed and has reopened here as DINING STAGE Sakaiya Asahi ('the location and owner have moved and reopened', an October 2026 reviewer writes). The fist-sized croquettes are back: nikujaga or a seasonal cream croquette, on a set or a one-plate lunch with many small sides and free refills of rice. At night it is sashimi, big tempura prawns, fried oysters and chicken tataki, with all-you-can-drink courses. Returning regulars are split: some are delighted it survived, others find the lunch smaller and the grilled fish and rice weaker than before (October 2026). Open daily for lunch and dinner.

chef_bio.background: Per 2026 reviews: the former "Sakaiya" in Namba (one diner says in Namba CITY) closed, and the shop reopened at this address as "DINING STAGE Sakaiya Asahi"; an October 2026 diner writes that "the location and owner have moved and reopened"; ordering moved to a tablet; the lunch menu was revamped in October 2026. Shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing; no opening date given. The listing says the kitchen is particular about fish, sake and shochu.
chef_bio.specialty: Croquette set meals; large fried prawns; seafood.

anecdotes.text: "It was a shame to see the popular 'Sakaiya' in Namba CITY close down, but I'm really glad that 'DINING STAGE Sakaiya Asahi' has taken over and is thriving under the same name!" — September 2026, croquette set.

"Astonishing! … It seems the location and owner have moved and reopened, which is an immense joy. However, has the lunch portion size decreased a bit?" — October 2026, large fried-prawn one-plate ¥1,350.
"I ordered a Mega Highball for the first toast, and I was surprised by its size—I couldn't finish it!" — October 2026, an 11th visit.

osaka_dogyan_honten_bakuromachi.hours_raw: Mon–Fri lunch 11:30–14:00 and dinner 17:00–23:30 (last order 23:00); Sat 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); closed Sundays and holidays (Tabelog). Lunch is weekdays only; order before 12:00 for a free raw egg or small side (August 2026); rice, miso soup and salad refills (August 2026). Book by the day before, especially on Fridays; a reservation assumes at least ¥2,500 a head, and a no-show after 15 minutes may be cancelled; seat-only or drinks-only bookings carry a ¥350 charge, not on courses (Tabelog). Cards for bills of ¥3,500 (before tax) or more, not with all-you-can-drink or discounts; PayPay and LINE Pay (Tabelog). 38 seats including a raised tatami area for 14; smoking allowed (after 13:00 at lunch, June 2026); up two flights of stairs (October 2026). Order by QR code (2026). Opened 29 September 2008 (Tabelog).
osaka_dogyan_honten_bakuromachi.notes: [Yakitori · Bakuromachi, Miyazaki chicken and a TV-famous ramen] Up two flights of stairs east of Shinsaibashi-suji, a casual Miyazaki izakaya open since 2008, with a counter, tables and a raised tatami area, where smoking is allowed. The draw is Miyazaki chicken: charcoal-grilled thigh of long-raised hens, chicken nanban under tartar sauce, fresh chicken sashimi and tataki. Yet many come for the ramen, five kinds, led by a Takaida-style chuka soba the shop calls its most popular dish (rich soy sauce on chicken broth, thick noodles) and a rare-in-Kansai Tsubamesanjo backfat ramen. Weekday lunch sets from ¥950 come with free refills of rice and miso soup. Diners in 2026 praise the chicken and the ramen; one found the lunch chicken nanban tough and pricey, another the floor greasy. Closed Sundays.

roles: Shop manager and staff (unnamed; the site carries a 店長ブログ)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site (dogyan.jp): Miyazaki regional cuisine, charcoal yakitori and ramen at this main shop and a shop in 立売堀, Nishi-ku; the same group runs the noodle and kakigori shop 麺とかき氷 ドギャン 谷四店 (osaka_men_to_kakigori_dogyan_tanimachi in data). Per the Tabelog shop text: Miyazaki dishes such as charcoal-grilled thigh of long-raised hens, chicken nanban and meat-wrapped rice balls, plus the Takaida-style chuka soba, featured on TV several times and the most popular dish. Opened 29 September 2008 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Charcoal-grilled hen thigh; chicken nanban; Takaida-style chuka soba.

anecdotes.text: "After taking a sip of the broth, I was astonished. It completely surpassed the offerings of a certain well-known Takeda-style chain." — April 2026, Takaida chuka soba with extra fat ¥900.
"I debated between Takai-da style and Tsubamesanjo style, but opted for the rare Tsubamesanjo style in Kansai." — June 2026, weekday lunch.
"This chicken cutlet had a good texture but was quite tough." — October 2026, Miyazaki chicken nanban set ¥1,100.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (dogyan.jp): 炭火焼鳥・ラーメン 宮崎郷土料理どぎゃん、心斎橋・本町立売堀、本店は中央区博労町3-1-13、立売堀店は西区立売堀1-6-14、麺とかき氷 ドギャン 谷四店 (かき氷専門店)、店長ブログ。食べログ (店舗会員): 焼き鳥・ラーメン・居酒屋、博労町3-1-13 戎センタービル 2F、Shinsaibashi 駅・Honmachi 駅から徒歩5分、月〜金 11:30〜14:00・17:00〜23:30 (L.O.23:00)、土 17:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、日祝休み、予約は前日までに、1人2,500円以上で予約成立、席のみや飲み放題のみの予約はチャージ料350円 (税別)、カードは3,500円 (税別) 以上から、PayPay・LINE Pay可、38席 (小上がり14席)、喫煙可、2008年9月29日オープン、長期飼育の親鶏もも炭火焼き、名物チキン南蛮、肉巻きおにぎり、テレビで何度も紹介された一番人気の「Takaida Chuka Soba」、飲み放題つきの宮崎郷土料理コース5,500〜6,000円。口コミ(2026年4月〜10月): Tsubamesanjo 背脂ラーメン1,000円、Takaida Chuka Soba 背脂増し900円、ラーメンは5種類、冷やし担々麺、粕ラーメン、平日のランチ定食950円から、ご飯・味噌汁・サラダのおかわり、鶏刺し、鶏のたたき、チキン南蛮は固いという声、QR で注文、階段を2回上がる。

cultural_comfort.note: Order by QR code at the table (2026). No English evidence found.

osaka_ashitani_panchi_doyama.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Courses include gyoza, mapo tofu, sukiyaki tsukune and a Taiwanese mazesoba of wheat noodles; sauces are not described.
osaka_ashitani_panchi_doyama.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an izakaya of wagyu, sea urchin, salmon roe, chicken and Chinese-style dishes.
osaka_ashitani_panchi_doyama.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–2:00, last order 1:15 (Tabelog). Opened July 2026 (Tabelog). All-you-can-drink of up to nine hours, three hours on Fridays (Tabelog). Appetizer charge ¥300 (Tabelog). Private-party bookings by phone (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), IC cards and other e-money, PayPay, d Barai, Rakuten Pay, au PAY, Alipay, WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 50 seats: tables for 2–8 on the first floor and tatami on the second, semi-private seating, up to 58 (Tabelog; October 2026). Smoking allowed; menus in English, Chinese and Korean, with photos (Tabelog).
osaka_ashitani_panchi_doyama.notes: [Izakaya · Umeda, Higashi-dori, cheap drinks till 2 am] A fifty-seat izakaya in the Higashi-dori shopping street area, opened in July 2026, built around very cheap drinking: highballs from ¥180 and all-you-can-drink plans that run up to nine hours (three on Fridays). The food mixes Chinese-style dishes and izakaya standards with luxury touches: cheese mapo tofu, spicy gyoza, wagyu tataki under a heap of green onion, a thick chateaubriand, an egg rice topped with sea urchin, salmon roe and wagyu, and a Taiwanese mazesoba to finish. Courses with drinks are ¥3,600–3,980, popular for groups on the tatami second floor. Smoking is allowed; open until 2 am.

roles: Kitchen staff (unnamed in the sources read)
chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): a casual tavern opened in July 2026 for authentic dishes at affordable prices, with creative cuisine using sea urchin, salmon roe and wagyu; drinks from ¥180; all-you-can-drink of up to nine hours.
chef_bio.philosophy: Authentic dishes at affordable prices (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Amazing TKG; chateaubriand; all-you-can-drink courses.

anecdotes.text: "The highlight was the Chateaubriand, cooked to perfection with an explosion of juices. To finish off, we had a hearty Taiwanese Mazesoba!" — October 2026, the 7-dish course.
"The interior features tables for 2 to 4 guests on the first floor, while the second floor boasts spacious tatami seating" — October 2026.
"I initially thought it would be mostly casual dishes since it's a public tavern, but there were also luxurious options" — October 2026, the Gold course.

cultural_comfort.note: Menus in English, Chinese and Korean, with photos (Tabelog).

osaka_ienchu_sakaba_doyama.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The menu includes soki soba (wheat noodles), mozuku tempura, beni-imo croquettes, curry and chicken nanban; Okinawan braises like rafute are usually cooked with soy sauce.
osaka_ienchu_sakaba_doyama.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Okinawan pork, beef and seafood dishes; jimami (peanut) tofu, sea grapes and island shallots also appear.
osaka_ienchu_sakaba_doyama.hours_raw: Mon–Sat and holidays 18:00–7:00 (last order 6:00); Sunday 16:00–23:00 (last order 22:00); closing days not fixed; if there are no customers the shop may close at 18:00 (Tabelog). Seating charge ¥450 with a small appetizer, included in courses (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX), IC cards and other e-money, PayPay, d Barai, Rakuten Pay, au PAY, Alipay (Tabelog). 15 seats: 5 at the counter, three tables, and a second-floor private tatami room for up to 15; smoking allowed; delivery available (Tabelog).
osaka_ienchu_sakaba_doyama.notes: [Okinawan · Umeda, Higashi-dori, an island izakaya open till morning] A small Okinawan izakaya in a narrow alley just north of Higashi-dori, run with ingredients from the owner's home island of Ie and open until 7 am. Diners call it one of the few places in Osaka for home-style Okinawan food: rafute and soki ribs, Ie-beef tataki, goya and somen champuru, mozuku tempura, jimami tofu, and soki soba to finish, washed down with Orion draft or awamori from half a dozen islands, plus a jar of habu sake. A ¥3,850 course includes all-you-can-drink, and the second-floor tatami room takes private parties of up to 15. The room is tight and tables are small; smoking is allowed. Sundays close at 23:00.

chef_bio.origin: The owner's hometown is Ie Island, Okinawa (Tabelog).
chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): Okinawan cuisine with carefully selected ingredients from the owner's hometown, Ie Island; Ie beef and Agu pork; rafute, soki soba and Ie beef tataki; awamori and limited and seasonal sakes chosen by the owner; Okinawan fruit liqueurs; open until 7 am. A December 2024 diner: "one of the few places in Osaka where I can enjoy authentic Okinawan home-cooked dishes".
chef_bio.philosophy: A hidden izakaya where you can relax on Okinawan time (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Rafute; soki soba; awamori.

anecdotes.text: "You can enjoy Awamori from various regions such as Ie Island, the main island, Miyako Island, Ishigaki Island, Kume Island, Hateruma Island, and Yonaguni Island!" — July 2026.
"I personally recommend the Soki Nitsuke over the Rafute! Also, be sure to try the Habu Sake—it's surprisingly good!" — June 2025.
"The tofu had a simple, delicious flavor reminiscent of sesame pudding!" — June 2026, the jimami tofu.

cultural_comfort.note: Small alley izakaya; book for Friday nights (2024–2026). No English evidence found.

osaka_sonjuku_yaneura_bettei.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Dishes include quiche, a sole meunière, cream croquettes and a foie gras pizza.
osaka_sonjuku_yaneura_bettei.vegan_detail: Not vegan: French courses of foie gras, fish, beef, duck and pork.
osaka_sonjuku_yaneura_bettei.hours_raw: Daily 18:00–23:00, open all year (check at New Year) (Tabelog). Walk-ins welcome, even alone; courses booked by the day before; à la carte on the day (Tabelog). Enter by ringing the intercom; the shop is on 2F but the door is on the "2.5th floor" (Tabelog; September–October 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), PayPay, Rakuten Pay; no e-money (Tabelog). 12 seats: 6 at the counter, 6 at tables; private hire up to 20; heated tobacco only in a designated area (Tabelog).
osaka_sonjuku_yaneura_bettei.notes: [French · Ohatsu Tenjin, a hidden attic bar] A twelve-seat wa-French bar up a half-flight of stairs by Ohatsu Tenjin's south gate, where you ring an intercom to be let in and find a dim room made to look like a church attic. A former hotel chef cooks French dishes with plenty of foie gras: in an omelette, on a pizza, over rice at the end of the course. The Joruri course runs to seven dishes for about ¥6,400 (with an extra dish at ¥6,580 during a 20th-anniversary campaign), and à la carte comes to about ¥8,000–9,000 a head with drinks. Regulars come for birthdays, with a message on the dessert plate. A sister of the Sonjuku bars, whose Ura-Namba chef one diner recognised at the counter.

chef_bio.origin: A sister of the 村塾 (Sonjuku) restaurants; a September 2026 diner recognised the chef from the Sonjuku in Ura-Namba (osaka_sonjuku_namba).
chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): a calm restaurant inspired by a church attic, with a bar-like feel for after-dinner drinks; foie gras and à la carte; "authentic French cuisine crafted by a former hotel chef"; message plates for anniversaries. A 20th-anniversary campaign in autumn 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Foie gras dishes; Joruri course.

anecdotes.text: "To enter, you have to ring the bell to be let in. As soon as the door opened, I made eye contact with the chef at the counter, someone I had met a few times at the Sonjuku in Ura-Namba." — September 2026.
"We celebrate each other's birthdays here every year." — October 2026, a colleague's birthday.
"The foie gras omelet, croquettes, and the three types of meat were all spot on." — September 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: Ring the intercom to enter; dishes are explained (2026). No English evidence found.

osaka_epais_kitashinchi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: breaded and fried tonkatsu and croquettes.
osaka_epais_kitashinchi.hours_raw: Lunch Mon–Sat 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:00); dinner Mon–Fri 18:00–21:00 (last order 20:00); both until ingredients run out; closed Sundays and holidays; extra closures announced on Tabelog (e.g. several days in September 2026) (Tabelog). Lunch bookings by phone, dinner online; same-day dinner bookings are tables only, à la carte, no courses; one drink per person at dinner (Tabelog). Cutlets are fried slowly at low temperature, so expect a wait (September 2026); rice refills are charged (August–September 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), PayPay, d Barai, Rakuten Pay, au PAY (Tabelog). 11 seats: 3 at the counter, 8 at tables (the shop text also says 12 seats); non-smoking; takeout of curry, bento and katsu sandwiches, ready about 30 minutes after ordering (Tabelog).
osaka_epais_kitashinchi.notes: [Tonkatsu · Kitashinchi, rosy brand-pork cutlets] An eleven-seat tonkatsu room on a Kitashinchi third floor, named to Tabelog's Tonkatsu 100 in 2017, 2018, 2019, 2021, 2022, 2024 and 2026, where brand pork is fried slowly at a low temperature so the tenderloin and chateaubriand cutlets come out pink and juicy inside. Lunch sets start at ¥1,100 (a chateaubriand cutlet set was ¥2,640 in September 2026), with a truffle-and-mushroom cream croquette as an add-on; dinner is an 11-dish course from ¥3,300 with a choice of pork brand, or à la carte. Diners rave about the tenderness; the gripes are the wait (the frying takes time), charged rice refills and, for one, dry rice. Book lunch by phone; closed Sundays, and dinner only on weekdays.

chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): carefully selected brand-pork tonkatsu in a relaxed, refined room of 12 seats; a dinner course of different pork brands or à la carte; set meals at lunch from 11:00. Tabelog Tonkatsu 100 in 2017, 2018, 2019, 2021, 2022, 2024 and 2026. A September 2026 diner describes it as "featured in the Michelin guide".
chef_bio.philosophy: Tender brand pork, carefully fried (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Chateaubriand and tenderloin pork cutlets.

anecdotes.text: "…fry it slowly at a low temperature, it took a little time to arrive!" — September 2026, the 100 g tenderloin and truffle croquette.
"It's rare to find pork Chateaubriand, but the meat was so tender that it felt like it was beyond what you would expect from pork" — October 2026.
"I wanted to order a second serving of rice, but it seemed like it wasn't free, so I decided against it." — August 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: Small room; lunch booked by phone, dinner online (Tabelog). No English evidence found.

osaka_monday_vibes_coffee_namba.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Much of the menu is bread, croissants, French toast, pancakes, pasta and churros (Tabelog menu; reviews); the meat and fish dishes are not described.
osaka_monday_vibes_coffee_namba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: no vegan options are described; the café dishes carry egg, bacon, ham, salmon, cheese or butter, and the bar menu is meat and fish (Tabelog menu).
osaka_monday_vibes_coffee_namba.hours_raw: Daily 7:00–21:00, as café and bar (Tabelog); closed 14:00–16:30 on 13 November 2026 for maintenance. Online booking for bar use and courses only; café guests walk in or call. Café use limited to 90 minutes, bar use to 2 hours. Bar use carries a ¥330 charge (Tabelog); an October 2026 diner paid ¥400 for the bar appetizer. Orders by QR code via LINE (October 2026). Cards (incl. UnionPay), transport IC and other e-money, PayPay. 41 seats; non-smoking; free Wi-Fi and power outlets (Tabelog).
osaka_monday_vibes_coffee_namba.notes: [Café · Namba, café by day and Italian bar by night] A café and Italian bar a minute from Namba Station, opened January 2025 by the ten-shop 十忠八九 group, open from 7 AM to 9 PM every day. Mornings bring breakfast sets, eggs Benedict, smash-croissant open sandwiches and French toast; from midday it turns into an Italian bar with pasta, beef-tongue stew and acqua pazza. Diners in October 2026 praise the stylish wood-toned room, the brunch dishes and the bar food; one breakfast set came with lukewarm soup, cold bread and an undressed salad, and another diner found the restroom freezing. An early-opening stop for night-bus arrivals, with Wi-Fi and outlets; an October 2026 diner found it full of young people and visitors from abroad. Tabelog lists an English, Chinese and Korean menu.

roles: Shop staff unnamed; a shop of the 十忠八九 group (株式会社オーゼットカンパニー; lit.link)
chef_bio.background: The 十忠八九 group page (lit.link) lists ten shops in Osaka (Fukushima, Namba, Umeda) and Tokyo (Takadanobaba): tavern, sushi, yoshoku and café formats, MONDAY VIBES COFFEE among them. The group's stated concept is shops "a little better than just right": "more than an izakaya, less than a ryoriya; more than a café or bar, less than a restaurant". Tabelog gives the opening as 24 January 2025.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Create a new standard for the casual dining scene" (group page).
chef_bio.specialty: All-day brunch and Italian bar food.

anecdotes.text: "The early morning hours are great for night bus travelers, and I was the first customer." — October 2026, whipped-butter pancakes.

"I was excited by how it looked, but unfortunately, the soup was lukewarm, the bread was cold and the butter wouldn’t melt, and the salad didn’t have any dressing on it." — October 2026, breakfast set.
"They were so delicious that I switched from the café to the bar, where I had beef stew and fish and chips, along with some champagne, which was delightful." — October 2026.
"It was filled with young people and international visitors." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 十忠八九グループ (株式会社オーゼットカンパニー、lit.link): 店舗は魚屋 十忠八九 (福島)、みなみの十忠八九 (難波)、お初の十忠八九 (梅田)、福島呑場ヒンジ (福島)、浪速炉ばた 東洋小噺 (難波)、なにわ寿し 本店 (難波)、二階の洋品店 (福島)、生ハムとPIZZA。86ストア (難波)、MONDAY VIBES COFFEE (難波)、本酒場 満丸 東店 (高田馬場)、酒場・寿司・洋食・カフェの業態、ビジョン「カジュアルな飲食シーンの新しい基準を作る」、コンセプト「丁度いい、より、もうちょっとだけいい店」「居酒屋以上、料理屋未満」「カフェ・バル以上、レストラン未満」。食べログ (店舗会員、英語版): 難波4-1-2 三信ビル 1F、2025年1月24日オープン、毎日7:00〜21:00、カフェとイタリアンバル、バル利用はチャージ330円、カフェは90分・バルは2時間、41席、禁煙、Wi-Fi・電源、多言語メニュー (英語・中国語・韓国語)、グループ全10店。メニュー (2026年10月): 牛タンの低温調理シチュー、鴨のロースト赤ワインソース、鯛と魚介のアクアパッツァ、エッグベネディクト、クロックムッシュ、クロックマダム、ソーセージエッグのフレンチトースト、前菜盛り合わせ、生ハムとサラミ。口コミ (2026年9月〜10月): 朝7時から、夜行バスの客にも便利、エッグベネディクト、フレンチトースト、ホイップバターのパンケーキ、ペペロンチーノ、QRコードとLINEで注文、朝食セットのスープがぬるくパンが冷たかったという声、トイレが寒いという声、若い人と外国からの客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Tabelog lists a multilingual menu (English, Simplified Chinese, Korean) with photos and a digital menu; orders by QR code. No evidence on English-speaking staff.

osaka_moulin_minamihorie.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The menu mixes pasta, bread, lasagna, cutlets and fried dishes with charcoal-grilled meats, carpaccio and salads (Tabelog menu); nothing is stated about wheat.
osaka_moulin_minamihorie.vegan_detail: Not vegan: no vegan options are described; the menu is built on meat, fish, cheese and cream (Tabelog menu).
osaka_moulin_minamihorie.hours_raw: Daily 9:00–23:00: morning 9:00–11:00 (last order), lunch 11:00–15:00 (last order), dinner 17:00–22:00 (last order), café 9:00–22:30 (last order); open year-round (Tabelog). The official site gives lunch 11:00–15:00, dinner 17:00–22:00 and café 11:00–22:30 (last orders), close 23:00, with no morning. Reservations taken, not for café use; 90 minutes per table; changes or cancellations at least two days ahead; one drink per person after 17:00 (Tabelog). No service charge. Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and transport IC and other e-money; no QR payment. 200 seats: 102 inside, 98 on the riverside terrace; non-smoking inside, smoking allowed on the terrace; private room for up to 30; wheelchair accessible; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). Orders by QR code (October 2026 reviews).
osaka_moulin_minamihorie.notes: [Italian · Minamihorie, riverside terrace on the Dotonbori River] A big glass-walled restaurant and café at Canal Terrace Horie, opened July 2008 by Balnibarbi with Osaka City as the company's first waterside restaurant, and run under a permit to use the Dotonbori River waterside. Open from 9 AM to 11 PM: morning, a weekly lunch plate, café cakes, charcoal-grilled meat at night, and in summer a terrace beer garden with all-you-can-eat-and-drink, where small sightseeing boats pass by. Diners in 2026 enjoy the calm away from central Namba and the terrace breeze; a September 2026 repeat visitor found the beer-garden spare ribs now served off the bone and the food less careful than two years earlier. The room also hosts weddings and parties of up to 400 standing.

roles: Kitchen staff unnamed; a restaurant of 株式会社バルニバービ (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per Balnibarbi's securities report (text on edinetdb.jp), the company opened the restaurant & café ムーラン in Minamihorie, Nishi-ku, in July 2008 in partnership with Osaka City, starting its waterside restaurant development; the report describes it as a restaurant & café run under a permit to use the waterside of the Dotonbori River at Canal Terrace, with barbecue among its uses. The official site shows the © of BALNIBARBI Co.Ltd.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Enjoy dinner with the night view" (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Riverside terrace; charcoal-grilled meat; summer beer garden.

anecdotes.text: "When I visited about two years ago, the spare ribs were juicy and delicious with the bone still attached, but this time they were served cut off the bone, which diminished the flavor." — September 2026, terrace buffet.
"Located by the river, this place has a unique atmosphere with small tourist boats passing by." — September 2026, beer garden.
"Although it's located in Namba, which is usually chaotic with tourists, this place is a bit away from the center, making it quite peaceful." — October 2026, café.
"It was my first time eating a cream puff that you cut with a knife, and it was delicious." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: なんば・南堀江のレストラン、夜景を楽しみながらディナーを、Restaurant & CAFÉ MOULiN、最大400名 (立食) の貸切、BBQとビアガーデンの120分飲み放題プラン、歓送迎会のパーティープラン、三陸・常磐うみうまフェア (2026年2月)、大阪市西区南堀江1-5-26 キャナルテラス 1F、毎日 LUNCH 11:00〜15:00 (L.O.)、DINNER 17:00〜22:00 (L.O.)、CAFE 11:00〜22:30 (L.O.)、CLOSE 23:00、©BALNIBARBI Co.Ltd.。バルニバービの有価証券報告書 (edinetdb.jp): 2008年7月に大阪市西区南堀江に大阪市と連携しレストラン&カフェ「ムーラン」をオープンし水辺のレストラン開発を開始、ムーランはキャナルテラスで道頓堀川の水辺利用許可を得て運営、バーベキューなど。食べログ (店舗会員、英語版): 毎日9:00〜23:00 (モーニング9:00〜11:00 L.O.)、200席 (店内102、テラス98)、テラスは喫煙可、30名までの個室、カフェは予約不可、17時以降はワンドリンク制。メニュー (2026年1月): 炭火焼き (Awaji 牛、Yumi pork、Awaodori chicken、ラム、黒毛和牛)、パスタ、Awaji 牛のラザニア、仔牛のコトレッタ、Toyonaka の Loaf Bakery のバゲットのアヒージョ。口コミ (2026年9月〜10月): テラスのビアガーデン食べ放題4,000円、観光船が通る川辺、ムーランランチ、バスクチーズケーキ、シフォンケーキ、ナイフで切るシュークリーム、QRコードで注文、スペアリブが骨なしになり雑になったという声も。

osaka_bar_a_vin_tokuzo_shinsaibashi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Signature dishes include the blue-cheese ham cutlet, sardine cutlet, spring rolls, quiche and pasta, beside the beef stew, carpaccio and cheese (Tabelog menu; official site); nothing is stated about wheat.
osaka_bar_a_vin_tokuzo_shinsaibashi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: no vegan options are described; the menu is built on cheese, meat and seafood (official site; Tabelog menu).
osaka_bar_a_vin_tokuzo_shinsaibashi.hours_raw: Mon–Thu 12:00–22:00; Fri, Sat and the day before a holiday 12:00–23:00; Sun and holidays 12:00–21:00 (Tabelog). Reservations recommended; 2 hours per table; a no-show is assumed after 15 minutes late (Tabelog); same-day cancellations may be charged in full (official site). No service charge. Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), PayPay, d Barai; no e-money. 47 seats (24 table, 23 counter-table) over two floors, a semi-private room behind frosted glass, the second floor for up to 20 privately; non-smoking (Tabelog; official site). Bottles from the adjoining wine shop can be brought in for a ¥2,000 corkage (official site). Ordering by barcode (October 2026 review).
osaka_bar_a_vin_tokuzo_shinsaibashi.notes: [Wine bistro · Shinsaibashi, a wine importer's restaurant since 1983] A wine bistro two minutes from Shinsaibashi Station, run directly by a wine importer and open since 1983, with a bright, flower-decked ground floor and a darker second floor for fine wine and courses. Over 40 wines come by the glass, unfiltered wine is bottled for the house in Yamanashi, and bottles from the wine shop next door can be opened for a corkage fee. The beef stew, made the same way for 40 years, survives every change of the shop's name and look, and over 80% of tables order the blue-cheese ham cutlet. Diners in 2026 praise the cheese, the wine range and the prices; some found the blue cheese strong, the liver pâté dry, the chairs hard or a smell in the room.

roles: Chef unnamed, "trained at numerous restaurants" (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site, 徳蔵 (とくぞう) is a long-established wine restaurant founded in 1983 and run directly by a wine importer; the company bottles wine at its own plant in Yamanashi and runs the wine shop next door, with about 2,000 wines. The beef stew has been made for 40 years and can use red wine freely "because this is a shop run directly by a wine trading company". Tabelog speaks of a predecessor, "Wainya", loved as an izakaya-style restaurant; a September 2026 regular notes that the name and look have changed several times.
chef_bio.philosophy: "We always want guests to taste many wines at reasonable prices" (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Beef stew of 40 years; blue-cheese ham cutlet; wine by the glass.

anecdotes.text: "The name and appearance have changed several times, but it remains a classic." — September 2026, second visit.
"I heard the ham cutlet is famous, so I ordered it, but it had blue cheese inside, which was quite strong for my taste." — September 2026.
"The biggest disappointment was the liver pâté. It lacked moisture" — October 2026, all-you-can-drink plan.
"The beef stew, sardine cutlet, pasta, and chocolate cake were all excellent, and the all-you-can-drink wine menu was impressive." — October 2026, retirement party.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: ワインとチーズと旨い肴のBAR à VIN 徳蔵 とくぞう 心斎橋、ワインインポーターが経営する創業1983年の老舗レストラン、グラスワイン常時40種以上・常時100種類以上の銘柄、隣のワインショップから持ち込み料2,000円で持ち込み可 (約2,000種)、山梨県の自社工場でボトリングした無濾過・非加熱の生ワイン、1階は生花で彩る明るくカジュアルな空間、2階は高級ワインとコース料理のシックな空間 (TOKUZO FIFTYS)、数々のレストランで修行を積んだシェフ、40年の伝統の特製ビーフシチュー (ワイン商社直営だから赤ワインを惜しげもなく)、直輸入チーズ、11月の旬菜 (仔羊とムール貝のトマト煮込み、真鯛昆布締めと洋ナシのカルパッチョ、紅ズワイカニと春菊のキッシュ、うなぎと牛肉の春巻き、かきとベーコンのカツレツ、タラ白子のアヒージョ、鰆の味噌漬け)、ブルーチーズをはさんだハムカツ、エスカルゴ、ノルウェー産サーモンマリネ、当日キャンセルは全額の場合あり。食べログ (店舗会員、英語版): 1983年10月3日オープン、月〜木12:00〜22:00、金・土・祝前日12:00〜23:00、日・祝12:00〜21:00、47席、2時間制、前身は居酒屋風の「Wainya」、ハムカツの注文率8割以上。口コミ (2026年2月〜10月): ビーフシチューは名前が変わっても同じ味、チーズの質、グラスワインの種類、ブルーチーズが強い、レバーパテが乾いていた、椅子が硬い、店内のにおい、バーコードで注文、飲み放題。
