osaka_shinmachi_itchome.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: an Italian built on handmade pasta and stone-oven pizza (official site; Tabelog), with bread charged per person (Tabelog). Fish, meat and carpaccio exist, but nothing is stated about wheat.
osaka_shinmachi_itchome.vegan_detail: Not vegan: no vegan options are described; the appetizer platter, pastas and pizzas use meat, seafood and cheese (Tabelog menu).
osaka_shinmachi_itchome.hours_raw: Daily lunch 11:30–14:00 (last order 14:00) and dinner 18:00–23:00 (last food order 22:00, drinks 22:30); no closing days; closed 31 December and 1 January, 16:00–22:00 on 2–5 January (official site; Tabelog). Reservations taken; the room fills at 18:00 opening (2026 reviews). ¥400 per person for bread (Tabelog); a September 2026 diner got two small pieces and only on request. Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR accepted. 24 seats (8 counter, 16 table); non-smoking since April 2020 (official site; Tabelog). Everything can be taken out (official site).
osaka_shinmachi_itchome.notes: [Italian · Shinmachi, stone-oven pizza and a 13-item appetizer platter] A 24-seat Italian on a side street off Yotsubashi-suji, open since May 2008, the sister shop of the 10-seat Il Piatto in Higashi-Shinsaibashi; the two make up the Il Piatto group. The draw is the platter of 13 small appetizers, then stone-oven pizza, handmade pasta and fish from Kyushu and Shikoku, with wines chosen by the house sommelier. Lunch regulars come for the daily pasta with amuse-bouche and soup. The room fills right at 18:00 opening. Most 2026 diners rave about the appetizer platter; some found the portions one bite each, the pasta sauce heavy or the drinks pricey, and one was charged ¥400 for two small pieces of bread.

roles: Kitchen staff unnamed; a sommelier on staff (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per ilpiatto.info, the Il Piatto group has two shops around Shinsaibashi: イルピアット in Higashi-Shinsaibashi (10 seats, open until 2 AM, a hideaway Italian) and 料理屋 新町壱丁目 for banquets and parties; both offer the signature appetizer platter, carbonara described as the house's origin, and wines suggested by a sommelier on staff. The Shinmachi page says the fish comes from Kyushu and Shikoku. Tabelog gives the opening as 2 May 2008.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Authentic Italian, from handmade pasta to pizza baked in the stone oven" (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Thirteen-item appetizer platter; stone-oven pizza.

anecdotes.text: "As soon as the doors opened at 6 PM, the place was packed in no time!" — September 2026, first visit.
"The main pasta dish alone is satisfying, but it’s a bonus that it comes with an amuse-bouche and soup at this price." — October 2026, lunch regular.
"In the end, we ended up paying JPY 400 for just two small pieces of bread." — September 2026.
"The marinated octopus in the appetizer platter was so good that I ordered it again." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (ilpiatto.info): 大阪心斎橋を中心に2店舗展開するイルピアットグループ、名物前菜盛合せ、お店の原点のカルボナーラ、宴会やパーティーなら新町壱丁目店、隠れ家イタリアンならイルピアット 東心斎橋店 (10席、17:00〜翌2:00)、各店にソムリエ。料理屋 新町壱丁目のページ: 手作りパスタと石窯で焼き上げたピザの本格イタリアン、仕入れにこだわった魚と肉、九州・四国から取り寄せる魚、ソムリエが厳選するワイン、焼きたてのピザは持ち帰り可、全品テイクアウト可、2020年4月1日から店内全面禁煙、ランチ11:30〜14:00 (L.O.)、ディナー18:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、無休。食べログ (店舗会員、英語版): 2008年5月2日オープン、24席、パン代1人400円、400度以上の石窯、注文ごとに切る手打ちパスタ、ワイン約60種、年末年始の営業時間。メニュー (2025年9月): 前菜13種盛り合わせ1,730円、ピザ、パスタ、ズッパ・ディ・ペッシェ、ラムチョップ。口コミ (2026年9月〜10月): 18時の開店ですぐ満席、前菜盛り合わせ、タコのマリネ、日替わりパスタのランチ、パン代400円で小さなパン2切れだったという声、ソースが重い・飲み物が高めという声も。

osaka_tsukemen_r_and_s_higashimikuni.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: thick wheat noodles; gyoza, xiao long bao and other wheat-wrapped dim sum at night.
osaka_tsukemen_r_and_s_higashimikuni.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood and chicken white broth; pork and chicken chashu.
osaka_tsukemen_r_and_s_higashimikuni.hours_raw: Daily except Wednesday 11:00–14:30 and 17:30–23:00; hours may change (Tabelog). Buy a ticket at the machine inside on the left (¥1,000 notes only; the one outside is for takeaway) (2022, 2024). No cards or e-money; PayPay accepted (Tabelog; December 2025). Counter of 5–6 and a few tables for four; non-smoking (Tabelog; 2024 reviews). Evenings lean to Chinese gyoza and dim sum, with a 90-minute all-you-can-eat boiled-dumpling plan best booked (January 2024; September 2025). Opened 6 September 2020; reopened 12 March 2022 (Tabelog).
osaka_tsukemen_r_and_s_higashimikuni.notes: [Tsukemen · Higashi-Mikuni, thick noodles by day, dumplings by night] A small tsukemen shop near Higashi-Mikuni Station, one of the Ryusho group's shops (September 2025), whose homemade, aged, thick straight noodles have a slight green hue and a strong chew, large size free. Pick a dip: the tangy chicken paitan (¥950), a sweet-and-spicy one with the heat you choose (¥980), or the shrimp cream (¥1,000), thick with the aroma of fried shrimp; then hand the bowl back for cheese rice. At night it turns into a Chinese gyoza and dim sum place with Chinese staff and many Chinese customers (2024–2026), including a 90-minute all-you-can-eat of boiled dumplings. Closed Wednesdays; PayPay or cash.

roles: Kitchen and floor staff of the Ryusho group (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog listing: tsukemen and ramen, opened 6 September 2020, reopened 12 March 2022. Per reviews: "a sister restaurant of" the Ryusho shop by Higashi-Yodogawa station (2022–2024); "One of the three pillars of the Ryusho Group, Tsukemen R&S, underwent a renovation during the pandemic … blending the traditional focus on tsukemen with a bar-style setting where you can enjoy gyoza and xiaolongbao" and Ryusho's traits are "No chemical additives or preservatives", a "Rich seafood and chicken white broth" and "Homemade, aged, high-hydration noodles" (September 2025); the dim sum is made by "a top-level dim sum chef" (January 2024); "staff members who are Chinese managing the restaurant" in the evening (May 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Shrimp cream tsukemen; thick homemade noodles.

anecdotes.text: "The original tsukemen, on the other hand, boasts straight, thick noodles that are smooth and chewy, with a slight green hue." — September 2025, shrimp cream tsukemen ¥1,000.
"The dipping sauce came in a cup similar to a coffee cup, and the handle was quite convenient." — December 2025, sweet-and-spicy tsukemen ¥980.
"It seems to focus more on Chinese cuisine than ramen, as most of the other customers were enjoying Chinese dishes." — May 2026, an evening visit.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: つけ麺R&S、つけ麺・ラーメン、大阪市淀川区東三国4-21-23、東三国駅から366m、月・火・木〜日11:00〜14:30、17:30〜23:00、水曜休み、予約不可、カード・電子マネー不可、PayPay 可、禁煙、2020年9月6日オープン、2022年3月12日再開。口コミ(2022年7月〜2026年5月): Ryusho グループの店、店内の券売機 (1,000円札のみ)、自家製の熟成した太いストレート麺、大盛り無料、鶏白湯つけ麺950円、甘辛つけ麺980円 (辛さを選ぶ)、海老クリームつけ麺1,000円、豚と鶏の2種のチャーシュー、味玉、メンマ、水菜、チーズライス80円、鶏白湯ラーメン850円、担々麺880円、夜は約20種の gyoza や小籠包、水 gyoza の食べ放題、中国のスタッフと客。

osaka_ramen_king_nishinakajima.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat noodles (thick whole-wheat noodles in the mazesoba); gyoza on the side.
osaka_ramen_king_nishinakajima.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seafood, chicken and crab broths, chashu.
osaka_ramen_king_nishinakajima.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Thu and holidays 11:00–15:00 and 18:00–01:00 (last order 00:30); Fri–Sun 11:00–15:00 and 18:00–02:00 (last order 01:30); closed Wednesday for lack of staff; until sold out (Tabelog). Fills right after opening and is busy at 23:00 too (2025–2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), iD, PayPay and d Barai (Tabelog). 15 seats at a counter and tables; non-smoking (Tabelog). Large noodles free (2025–2026). Opened 18 April 2013 (Tabelog).
osaka_ramen_king_nishinakajima.notes: [Ramen · Nishinakajima-Minamigata, a late-night counter with crab specials] A 15-seat ramen shop three minutes from Minamikata and Nishinakajima-Minamigata stations, open since 2013 and until 1 or 2 a.m., featured on an Asahi Broadcasting TV show (Tabelog). The list is long: a tuna-bonito chuka soba that regulars call the favourite (¥1,100 with egg), a seafood shio built on iriko, shijimi and hamaguri, a blender-foamed chicken paitan, and Taiwan mazesoba on thick whole-wheat noodles, plus seasonal crab bowls such as chilled snow-crab tsukemen (¥1,320, 2026). Noodles come from the group's own Maruyoshi noodle works, and large portions are free. Busy at lunch and after 23:00; closed Wednesdays.

roles: Kitchen and floor staff (unnamed); two young women on the floor in August and October 2025
chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: "Featured on Asahi Broadcasting's 'Matsumoto Family's Holiday'"; a seafood shio ramen "made with carefully selected iriko, kombu, katsuobushi, shijimi, and hamaguri"; Taiwan mazesoba; closed Wednesdays "due to staff shortages"; opened 18 April 2013; website maguromaruyoshi.jbplt.jp. Per reviews: "The noodles from Maruyoshi Seimenjo are perfectly balanced" (September 2026); "you can't go wrong with the noodles from the Maruyoshi Group" (April 2026); the chicken paitan "features a slightly espuma-style broth made with a hand blender" (July 2026); "The two young female staff members were energetic and provided excellent service" (August 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Tuna-bonito chuka soba; seasonal crab ramen; Taiwan mazesoba.

anecdotes.text: "I entered around 11 PM, and the place was packed with customers coming in continuously." — March 2026, tuna-bonito chuka soba ¥1,100.
"A thick layer of homemade crab oil floats on top, enhancing the crab aroma and keeping the heat in." — April 2025, crab miso ramen ¥1,180.
"They offer a fantastic service where you can get a large size (2 servings) for free." — September 2026, chilled snow-crab tsukemen.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): らーめん キング、ラーメン・台湾まぜそば・餃子、大阪市淀川区西中島3-6-10、Hankyu Minamikata 駅と西中島南方駅から徒歩3分、月・火・木・祝11:00〜15:00、18:00〜翌1:00、金〜日11:00〜15:00、18:00〜翌2:00、水曜休み (人手不足のため)、売り切れまで、カード・iD・PayPay・d払い可、15席、禁煙、2013年4月18日オープン、Asahi Broadcasting の番組で紹介、いりこ、昆布、かつお節、しじみ、はまぐりの魚介の塩ラーメンに大きなはまぐり、台湾まぜそば。口コミ(2025年4月〜2026年9月): いちばん人気のマグロ節の中華そば味玉1,100円、ハンドブレンダーで泡立てる鶏白湯、辛い鶏白湯、台湾まぜそば (塩、辛、カレー)、台湾カレーまぜそば1,210円、季節の Hanasaki のカニの味噌ラーメン1,180円、ズワイガニの冷やしつけ麺1,320円、焼きかレアのチャーシュー、Maruyoshi の製麺所の麺、大盛り無料、深夜も混む、女性スタッフの接客。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter; choose noodle size and chashu. No English evidence found.

osaka_shinsui_mukou_nishinakajima.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Chinese dishes with soy and oyster sauces, noodles, dumplings, fried dishes and Shaoxing-wine marinades; nothing is described as gluten-free.
osaka_shinsui_mukou_nishinakajima.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a Shanghai-style Chinese menu of pork, beef, chicken, seafood and crab; garlic water spinach and stir-fried eggplant are not described as made without meat stock.
osaka_shinsui_mukou_nishinakajima.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:00–14:00 and 17:00–22:30; Sat 17:00–22:30; Sun and holidays 17:00–21:30; open all year; no lunch at weekends (Tabelog). Call ahead for parties of eight or more; drunken crab needs booking in advance, autumn only (Tabelog; November 2014 and 2025 reviews). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 46 seats at tables, areas screened by curtains, whole hire for 20–50; designated smoking area (Tabelog). Parking space out front if free, coin parking next door (March 2025).
osaka_shinsui_mukou_nishinakajima.notes: [Chinese · Nishinakajima-Minamigata, a calm Shanghai-style restaurant] A clean, quiet 46-seat Chinese restaurant three minutes from Nishinakajima-Minamigata, serving Shanghai-style cooking that some customers order in Chinese (March 2025). Weekday lunch sets change daily, around ¥980 with salad, soup and pickles, from Hainan chicken rice to soupless dandan noodles with fried rice. In the evening the round tables fill with Shanghai-style beef and root-vegetable stew, garlic water spinach, xiao long bao and seafood crispy rice poured at the table, and in autumn one regular comes every year for the drunken Shanghai crab, which must be ordered in advance (2014–2025). Courses from ¥6,600. Friendly staff who remember faces (2022).

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: Chinese, ramen and izakaya, 46 table seats, open all year, no weekend lunch. Per reviews: "serves authentic Shanghai cuisine" (November 2021); "Unlike typical local Chinese restaurants, this place is kept very clean" (November 2024); "I noticed some customers ordering in Chinese, which suggests it's authentic Chinese cuisine" (March 2025); "The staff recalled my visits and remembered me" (November 2022); "the staff were very friendly, chatting with us a lot" (July 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Drunken Shanghai crab (autumn); lunch sets.

anecdotes.text: "My main goal was to try the 'Drunken Crab.' All the other dishes are delicious too." — November 2025, a visit made most autumns since 2014.
"Seafood Crispy Rice: [The staff] poured the sauce right in front of me with a sizzling sound." — March 2025.
"The photo is of the spicy chicken, which wasn't on the menu, but when I asked, [the staff] said it was available." — July 2025.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 真水無香、中華料理・ラーメン・居酒屋、大阪市淀川区西中島4-8-4 リッツ新大阪南 1F、Hankyu Minamikata 駅と西中島南方駅北口から徒歩3分、月〜金11:00〜14:00、17:00〜22:30、土17:00〜22:30、日・祝17:00〜21:30、年中無休、土日祝は昼の営業なし、8名以上は要連絡、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、テーブル46席、カーテンで仕切れる席、貸切20〜50名、分煙。口コミ(2014年〜2026年10月): 上海料理、日替わりのランチ定食 (サラダ、スープ、漬物、ごはん)、海南チキンライス980円、汁なし担々麺とチャーハンと杏仁豆腐980円、油淋鶏、回鍋肉、なすの炒め物、秋の酔っぱらい蟹 (要予約)、上海風の牛肉と根菜の煮込み、空心菜のにんにく炒め、酢豚、海鮮おこげ、小籠包、ごま団子、カスタードまん、6,600円のコース、店内はきれい、中国語で注文する客も。

osaka_kushiyaki_tanakaya_miyahara.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Skewers come with salt or sauce; fried items such as akaten, thick fried tofu and garlic toast are on the menu.
osaka_kushiyaki_tanakaya_miyahara.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken, beef and offal skewers and seafood.
osaka_kushiyaki_tanakaya_miyahara.hours_raw: Tue–Sat 18:00–01:00 (last order 00:00); Sun and holidays 18:00–24:00 (last order 23:00); closed Monday and the third Sunday of the month (shop site; Tabelog). Reservations accepted and advised: only 12 seats, so phone before coming (shop site; 2024–2026). Cover charge ¥500 before tax (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR (Tabelog). 12 counter seats; private hire up to 20; smoking allowed (Tabelog). Opened 30 November 2009 (Tabelog).
osaka_kushiyaki_tanakaya_miyahara.notes: [Skewers · Higashi-Yodogawa, a 12-seat counter by the station] A twelve-seat skewer counter a minute from the west exit of JR Higashi-Yodogawa, open since 2009, where the owner chooses the ingredients first and then minds the cut, the skewering and the grill, at everyday prices (shop site). The skewers are big: a juicy seseri, a negima made with neck meat, tsukune, thick outside skirt and beef harami, plus daily small dishes, akaten and garlic toast. Regulars come back again and again for the friendly owner and the attentive woman who works the room (2024–2026). It fills fast, so phone first; open to 1 a.m.; ¥500 cover; smoking allowed.

roles: A woman who looks after the room (August 2026 review)
chef_bio.background: Per the shop site (kushiyaki-tanakaya.com, read 2026-11-02): 串焼き たなかや, a 12-seat counter izakaya near JR Higashi-Yodogawa and Higashi-Mikuni; "味も居心地も両方大事" (taste and comfort both matter) is the owner's care, so first-timers settle in easily; ingredients are chosen first, then the cut, the skewering and the grilling are attended to, at prices for everyday use; solo diners welcome; phone ahead because seats are few. Per the Tabelog listing: opened 30 November 2009. Per reviews: "The owner is incredibly friendly, and the hostess is smart and attentive" (August 2026); "the owner remembered me as soon as I walked in" after four or five years (March 2025).
chef_bio.philosophy: "味も居心地も両方大事" (both taste and comfort matter; shop site).
chef_bio.specialty: Big seseri and negima skewers; outside skirt.

anecdotes.text: "You rarely come across such large chicken neck skewers. Because they are so big, they are incredibly juicy!! Plus, the meat in the negima … is also chicken neck!!" — August 2026.
"It's been about 4 or 5 years since I last visited. Yet, the owner remembered me as soon as I walked in." — March 2025.
"The counter seating fills up quickly, but if you're dining alone like I often do, you have a good chance of getting a seat." — August 2026.

osaka_matsutake_kushishabu_doyama.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The skewers include fresh wheat gluten (nama-fu), the dipping sauces include sesame sauce, and the finishing dishes are ramen, udon, mazesoba or rice porridge in the bonito-based broth.
osaka_matsutake_kushishabu_doyama.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the shabu-shabu broth is bonito-based dashi (operator site), and the skewers are mostly meat and seafood.
osaka_matsutake_kushishabu_doyama.hours_raw: Tue–Sat, holidays and the day before a holiday 18:00–5:00 (last order 4:00); Sun 18:00–3:00 (last order 2:00); closed Mondays, or the Tuesday after when Monday is a holiday (Tabelog; the operator site gives 18:00–5:00). Reservations accepted; couples may be moved to the counter if a group books (Tabelog). No service charge (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), IC cards and other e-money, PayPay, Rakuten Pay (Tabelog). 15 seats: a counter of 8 and tables for 7; private hire up to 20; smoking allowed (Tabelog). Opened 4 April 2019 (Tabelog). The entrance is down a narrow passage (July 2026).
osaka_matsutake_kushishabu_doyama.notes: [Shabu-shabu · Doyama, on skewers until 5:00] The second shop of the Kitashinchi kushi-shabu specialist, a small wooden room in Doyama open until 5:00 most nights, where shabu-shabu comes on skewers you swish yourself in a light bonito broth, so nobody's chopsticks go into the shared pot. Start with a clam in the broth, then work through Wakayama Inobuta pork, Omi beef, beef tongue with salt and sesame, quail and lettuce and the cult 'Negi Bakudan' green-onion bomb, each with its suggested dip; finish with ramen, udon or a rice porridge in the broth. Courses run ¥3,300–5,500 (the ¥3,300 one is the trial), or order skewers one by one. Fifteen seats, so book; smoking is allowed.

chef_bio.background: Per the operator site three-six.jp: "元祖串しゃぶ専門店 まつたけ" offers shabu-shabu in a new skewer style, with Inobuta pork from Susami, Omi beef and local ingredients; shops are the Kitashinchi main shop (曽根崎新地1-9-8, 17:00–5:00), this Doyama shop and a third, 北新地別邸 (曽根崎新地1-2-23). The shop-maintained Tabelog listing calls Doyama the second shop of the Kitashinchi original; opened 4 April 2019.
chef_bio.specialty: Kushi-shabu; clam broth; Negi Bakudan.

anecdotes.text: "The Negi Bakudan (green onion bomb) is especially addictive—I can't help but eat several!" — June 2025.
"I appreciated that we could comfortably gather around the hot pot without using direct chopsticks." — December 2025.
"I often visit this place in Shinchi because it's open until the early morning, but this was my first time at this location!" — June 2025.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (three-six.jp): 元祖串しゃぶ専門店 まつたけ、北新地本店 (曽根崎新地1-9-8 北原ビル1F、17:00〜5:00)、堂山店 (堂山町17-3 イーグルビル1F、18:00〜5:00、月曜休み、祝日の場合は翌火曜)、3店舗目の北新地別邸 (曽根崎新地1-2-23 ガーデニアビル3F、18:00〜24:00)、しゃぶしゃぶを串のスタイルで、和歌山県すさみ町のイノブタ「イブの恵み」、近江牛、ガリシア栗豚、三重県の海鮮と野菜、あっさりした特製の出汁に串のままくぐらせるので直箸がいらない、鰹節ベースの出汁、うめ・たけ・まつの3コース、日本酒は常時10種ほどで月に2回入れ替え。食べログ (店舗会員): 北新地の人気店の2号店、火〜土・祝・祝前日18:00〜5:00 (L.O.4:00)、日18:00〜3:00 (L.O.2:00)、月曜休み、うめコース3,300円、たけコース4,400円、まつコース5,500円、サービス料なし、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、15席 (カウンター8、テーブル7)、貸切20名まで、喫煙可、2019年4月4日オープン。口コミ(2025年6月〜2026年11月): 最初の貝、Negi Bakudan、ごまだれと塩、牛タン、和牛巻き、うずらとレタス、アスパラ、ホタテ、ブリ、豚巻き、生麩、エビ、玉ねぎ、貝の追加500円、〆のラーメン・うどん・雑炊、刺身もおいしい、入口は細い通路の先、2〜4人向けの小さな店。

osaka_takuya_ohatsu_tenjin.gf_detail: The operator says the signature black cutlet is coated in a gluten-free crumb ground from its own 100% brown-rice squid-ink bread and cooked slowly in lard, and diners in 2026 booked courses sold as "gluten-free". Not confirmed: whether the cutlet is floured with wheat before the crumb, whether the fryer is shared with other coated dishes (the fruit-tomato "katsu" has a thin crisp coat of unstated make), and whether the "junmai" soy sauce on the goya and the rice has wheat. Ask when booking by phone.
osaka_takuya_ohatsu_tenjin.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork cutlets fried in lard, bonito flakes on the goya and the rice, egg and seafood in the starters.
osaka_takuya_ohatsu_tenjin.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 18:00–23:30 (last order 23:30); closed Sundays and holidays (Tabelog; operator site). Reservations by phone only, 9:00–17:00 except Sundays and holidays; same-day walk-ins if a seat is free (operator site). Seat charge (otoshi) ¥1,100, which brings two to four starters (Tabelog; September–October 2026). No prices on the menu (September–October 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), IC cards, nanaco, WAON, PayPay, d Barai, Rakuten Pay, au PAY (Tabelog). 8 counter seats; non-smoking; children and strollers welcome (Tabelog). Private courses from ¥80,000 including drinks (Tabelog).
osaka_takuya_ohatsu_tenjin.notes: [Tonkatsu · Ohatsu Tenjin, a black gluten-free cutlet] An eight-seat counter in the back lane behind Tsuyu Tenjin shrine, run by its owner alone and on Tabelog's Tonkatsu 100 list five times since 2018. Its signature is a jet-black cutlet: pork in a crumb ground from the shop's own brown-rice and squid-ink bread, gluten-free by the shop's account, cooked gently in lard until faintly pink and eaten with three salts. The meal starts with small seasonal dishes and ends with a squid-ink risotto or a brown-rice fried rice; a fruit tomato fried in a thin crisp coat is the other famous dish. Booking by phone (9:00–17:00) is expected. The menu shows no prices; diners in 2026 paid about ¥6,000–15,000, with a ¥1,100 seat charge that brings starters. Expect a quiet, unhurried pace.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: "「とんかつ」ではなく、豚を活かす" (not tonkatsu but making the most of pork); an 8-seat counter hideaway behind Ohatsu Tenjin; the owner runs the shop alone, so bookings are asked for. The shop-maintained Tabelog listing lists Tabelog Tonkatsu 100 in 2018, 2019, 2021, 2024 and 2026. Reviews describe a quiet chef (August 2026); a regular on a twelfth visit in October 2026.
chef_bio.philosophy: "「とんかつ」ではなく、豚を活かす。" (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Black brown-rice squid-ink cutlet; fruit-tomato katsu.

anecdotes.text: "Just keep in mind that since it's run by a single person, it may take a bit of time to be served." — April 2025, a tenth visit.
"The pork dish was exquisite, using squid ink breadcrumbs made from brown rice, which made it incredibly light and not greasy at all." — October 2026, a twelfth visit.
"By the way, the menu does not list prices." — October 2026, a seat-only booking.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 涿屋 (たくや)、お初天神裏、変作豚活、カウンター八席の隠れ家、「とんかつ」ではなく豚を活かす、名物の黒い豚活は玄米100%の自家製イカスミパンから挽いたグルテンフリーの玄米パン粉、ラードでじっくり火入れして中は薄紅色、塩で、ヒレ活・ロース活・トロ活、コースは季節の前菜盛り合わせ (とろりと火を入れたたまご、海ぶどう、旬の魚介や野菜) から豚活、〆はイカスミリゾットか玄米平焼き飯、献立は日々変わる、フルーツトマト活 (極薄のカリカリ衣)、自家製の燻製、アラカルトのみも可、古民家風の外観と草色の暖簾、カウンター8席・完全禁煙、店主一人で営業、露天神社 (お初天神) の東鳥居の近くの路地、東梅田駅・北新地駅から徒歩4分、18:00〜23:30 (L.O.23:30)、日曜・祝日休み、カード・QR・電子マネー可、予約は電話のみ (9:00〜17:00、日曜・祝日を除く)、空席があれば当日も可。食べログ (店舗会員): 予約のみ、お席代 (お通し) 1,100円、8席、禁煙、子ども可、貸切のコースは飲み物込みで80,000円から、とんかつ 百名店 2018・2019・2021・2024・2026。口コミ(2025年4月〜2026年10月): グルテンフリーのとんかつ、イカスミと玄米のパン粉、3種の塩、すだち、お通しの前菜2〜4品、燻製の盛り合わせ (ヒレ・ロース・肩)、トロ活、玄米、イカスミリゾット、トロカツのコース5,500円、8,800円のコース、フルーツトマトのサラダ、ゴーヤの刺身と鰹節と純米醤油、玄米塩麹のスープ、豆の小鉢6種、山芋とあおさ、湯葉の揚げ物、パンチェッタのオムレツ、鮎の揚げ物、ラードで揚げる、メニューに値段がない、店主一人なので時間がかかる、静かな店主、12回通う常連。

cultural_comfort.note: Phone-only booking in Japanese hours; no prices on the menu (2026). No English evidence found.

positives.text: Official site: the black cutlet's crumb is "グルテンフリーの衣", ground from house-made 100% brown-rice squid-ink bread, and the cutlets are cooked in lard.
A September 2026 diner booked a course sold as "Gut Health Gourmet Gluten-Free"; an October 2026 diner's course was billed as gluten-free and gut-friendly.

osaka_rakusui_kitashinchi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Chinese dishes in sauces (mapo tofu, chili shrimp, sweet and sour pork), spring rolls, dan dan noodles and XO sauce; nothing is described as gluten-free.
osaka_rakusui_kitashinchi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the mapo tofu is made with wagyu, beef tripe and tendon; the menu is of meat and seafood dishes; no vegetarian dish is named.
osaka_rakusui_kitashinchi.hours_raw: Dinner Mon–Sat, the day before and after a holiday 18:00–22:30 (last order food 21:30, drinks 22:00); closed Sundays and holidays (Tabelog). Weekday lunch began in 2026 and is not on the listing; diners from September and October 2026 had the ¥1,500 mapo tofu set with free rice refills. Reservations accepted (Tabelog). ¥500 seat charge for à la carte orders only (Tabelog). Strong perfume may be refused (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), IC cards, Edy, iD, PayPay, d Barai, Rakuten Pay, au PAY, Alipay (Tabelog). 16 seats; counter seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). Opened 10 March 2004 (Tabelog).
osaka_rakusui_kitashinchi.notes: [Chinese · Kitashinchi, creative Chinese and 'Gokawa' mapo tofu] A 16-seat creative Chinese restaurant by Kitashinchi station, running since 2004 under a sign that names its mapo tofu in letters bigger than its own. The 'Gokawa' mapo, meant to outdo Sichuan, uses chunks of wagyu, tripe and tendon and a lot of numbing pepper. Around it the Hokkaido-born owner plays: a Chinese salad dressed like sushi, sweet and sour pork stuffed with cheese and plated as the solar system, shrimp mayo in pistachio sauce. Dinner courses ¥7,500–8,800, or à la carte with a ¥500 seat charge; since 2026 a weekday lunch of the mapo with free rice refills for ¥1,500. Mind the spice, and skip strong perfume.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed), a culinary author, 47 per the listing
chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: creative Chinese from an owner with ten years of training at a hotel and a renowned Chinese restaurant; the owner is from Hokkaido and a culinary author (47); 20 years in Kitashinchi; once a bar, hence the drinks list; opened 10 March 2004; Tabelog Chinese WEST 100 in 2021. The Tabelog invoice number T1120001183005 is registered to ＧＦ２Ｒｅ株式会社, 西天満 (NTA invoice register, read 2026-11-02).
chef_bio.philosophy: The mapo tofu is named "with the hope of surpassing Sichuan cuisine" (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Gokawa mapo tofu; solar-system sweet and sour pork.

anecdotes.text: "…recently started offering lunch, but there's no information about it on Tabelog..." — October 2026, the weekday mapo tofu lunch.
"The sweet and sour pork had several types of cheese inside, and the presentation resembled the solar system, with the spherical sweet and sour pork representing the Earth." — October 2026.
"The chef's concept was explained by a robot" — October 2026, an à la carte dinner.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): RAKUSUI、中華料理・創作料理、大阪市北区曽根崎新地1-9-8 ゴアビル 1F、JR 北新地駅の出口11-43から徒歩1分、月〜土・祝前日・祝後日18:00〜22:30 (L.O.料理21:30、ドリンク22:00)、日・祝休み、予約可、単品注文のみお席料500円、香りの強い香水は断ることも、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、16席、禁煙、2004年3月10日オープン、北新地で20年の創作中華、ホテルと有名な中華料理店で10年修業、四川料理をこえたいという名の「Gokawa」麻婆豆腐、店主は Hokkaido 出身、料理の著者 (47)、もとバーのお酒の品ぞろえ、前菜6種の盛り合わせ2,000円、定番の軽めのコース7,500円、7品から3品を選ぶコース8,800円、食べログ 中国料理 WEST 百名店 2021。インボイス登録はＧＦ２Ｒｅ株式会社 (西天満)。口コミ(2026年6月〜10月): 平日のランチが始まった、Gokawa 麻婆豆腐の定食1,500円 (ごはんおかわり自由、カニのサラダとポテトサラダ、Kitami の玉ねぎのスープ)、1,200円の日替わり、ひき肉ではなく和牛のかたまりとセンマイと牛すじ、花椒がたっぷりでしびれる、寿司のような刺身の中華サラダ、チーズ入りで太陽系のように盛った酢豚、ピスタチオソースのイタリア風エビマヨ、フランス風エビチリ、ホタテのアヒージョ、さつまいもとチーズの春巻き、牛肉とピーマンの炒め物、担々麺、XO醤のポテトサラダ、ロボットが料理のコンセプトを説明、自家製のカードゲーム Shuraba Karuta を販売、テレビで紹介された、洋食店のような内装。

cultural_comfort.note: À la carte or courses; dish concepts explained at the table (2026). No English evidence found.

osaka_oden_rokken_kitashinchi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Oden simmered in a soy-seasoned broth, handmade fish cakes, chikuwa, and a finishing kitsune udon; nothing is described as gluten-free.
osaka_oden_rokken_kitashinchi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the oden broth is made with bonito and sardines as well as kombu (Tabelog). Tabelog ticks "vegetarian options", but the dashi rules it out for vegans.
osaka_oden_rokken_kitashinchi.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 17:00–24:00 (last order 22:30); closed Sundays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; the menu changes with the season (Tabelog). Service charge ¥550 and a starter ¥550 a head, both included in course prices (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), PayPay, d Barai, Rakuten Pay, au PAY; no e-money (Tabelog). 30 seats: a counter of 8 at the oden pot on the ground floor, five private rooms upstairs for 2 to 8; completely non-smoking, e-cigarettes included; children welcome (Tabelog).
osaka_oden_rokken_kitashinchi.notes: [Oden · Kitashinchi, a Kyoto-style oden course] An oden house in Kitashinchi with a counter round the oden pot downstairs and five quiet private rooms upstairs, popular for business dinners and family meals. The broth is a pale-gold Kyoto style of Hokkaido kombu, bonito and sardines; the ¥7,000 course brings a small dish, six oden served one bowl at a time (the daikon under grated yam and the beef tendon get the praise), then the house finale, udon hidden inside a big fried-tofu pouch, and a wasabi sorbet. Courses include tax and service; à la carte adds ¥550 service and a ¥550 starter. Open to midnight, closed Sundays; completely non-smoking.

roles: Oden cooks at the counter (unnamed) and floor staff
chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: nourishing oden in a relaxed atmosphere, a dashi of premium Hokkaido kombu with bonito and sardines "seasoned in a golden ratio", handmade fish cakes, private table rooms. The Tabelog invoice number T2120001135104 is registered to 株式会社ジャパンフーズコーポレーション, 万歳町 (NTA invoice register, read 2026-11-02).
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto-style oden course; kitsune udon finale.

anecdotes.text: "When I broke open the large pouch, silky udon noodles spilled out, creating a delightful sensory surprise!" — August 2026, the Rokken Oden Course.
"each dish is served in its own bowl, so the heat isn't overwhelming." — July 2026, on oden in summer.
"The meal concluded with a wasabi sorbet, which refreshingly cleansed the palate with its aromatic and invigorating flavor." — August 2026, in a private room upstairs.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): おでん料理 地酒 大阪・北新地 六根、おでん・日本料理・居酒屋、大阪市北区曽根崎新地1-6-24、JR 北新地駅から徒歩3分、月〜土17:00〜24:00 (L.O.22:30)、日曜休み、予約可、全席禁煙 (電子たばこも)、サービス料550円とお通し550円 (コースは税・サービス料込み)、カード・QR 可、電子マネー不可、30席 (1階はおでん鍋のカウンター8席、2階は個室5室)、子ども可、ベジタリアンメニューあり、Hokkaido の昆布とかつお、いわしの黄金比のだし、季節の野菜と魚介、手作りの練り物、京風のおでん、全国の地酒、おでん6種の六根おでんコース7,000円、季節の刺身つきの季節の特別コース8,000円。インボイス登録は株式会社ジャパンフーズコーポレーション (万歳町)。口コミ(2026年7月〜10月): おでんは1品ずつ器で、とろろとかつお節の大根、厚揚げ、牛すじ、ちくわ、ピリ辛こんにゃく、ロールキャベツ、地鶏、はんぺん、はじめに水菜のサラダなどの小鉢、〆はお揚げの中にうどんが入った「きつね」、わさびのシャーベットやフルーツのシャーベット、日本酒の Mutsu Hassen 1,800円、2階の個室で接待や家族の食事、スタッフが親切。

cultural_comfort.note: Set oden courses in private rooms; one September 2026 diner suggests it for a night out while travelling. No English evidence found.

osaka_hanako_kitahorie.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The soba is made with domestic buckwheat flour and Tanba black beans, and a 100% buckwheat version is +¥300 (August 2026), but the blend of the regular soba is not stated, and the dipping sauce is soy-based (a reviewer found it strong in soy sauce, October 2026). Tempura sets, fried tuna and oyakodon are also on the menu.
osaka_hanako_kitahorie.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the soba is served with a dipping broth, and the menu centres on fish, duck and chicken.
osaka_hanako_kitahorie.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–15:00 and 17:30–23:00, last order 22:00; closed New Year's Day (Tabelog). No reservations at lunch; reservations taken for dinner (Tabelog). Fills up at lunch (September–October 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), transport IC, iD and PayPay (Tabelog). 22 seats: 4 at the counter, 18 at tables; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; children and strollers welcome (Tabelog).
osaka_hanako_kitahorie.notes: [Soba · Kitahorie, black-bean soba and fish] A calm soba shop by Yotsubashi Station whose noodles carry the aroma of Tanba black beans. Lunch is a daily-changing set of soba with clay-pot rice for about ¥1,200; at dinner it turns into a fish-and-sake izakaya with sashimi, duck and clay-pot rice for two. Order the black-bean zaru soba (100% buckwheat for +¥300) and the soba pudding. Lunch fills fast and cannot be booked, so come at 11:00; book for dinner.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop listing (corporate member): opened 1 October 2020; soba of domestic buckwheat flour and Tanba black beans, fish, and sake; courses with Omi duck hot pot.
chef_bio.specialty: Black-bean soba ("Kuro Mame Soba").

anecdotes.text: "It was my first time eating black bean soba, and it was quite delicious! ... The Soba Pudding for JPY 300 was outstanding." — August 2026, a first visit.
"I visited right after it opened, and by the time I left, it was almost full!" — October 2026, at lunch.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): hanako 北堀江、そば・魚介・居酒屋、大阪市西区北堀江1-11-10、四ツ橋駅から徒歩2分、毎日11:00〜15:00、17:30〜23:00 (L.O. 22:00)、元日休み、ランチは予約不可、カード・交通系IC・iD・PayPay 可、22席 (カウンター4、テーブル18)、禁煙、2020年10月1日オープン。国産そば粉と Tanba の黒豆のそば、鮮魚と日本酒、おまかせコース8品5,500円、7品4,500円、Omi の鴨鍋コース5,500円。口コミ(2026年7月〜11月): ランチAセットの天ざるそばとじゃこ明太の土鍋ごはん1,200円、黒豆ざるそば大盛り240g 1,300円、とろろ300円、そばプリン300円、十割は+300円、柚子塩のつけそば、鴨つくねのつけそば、牡蠣のつけそば、鯛・さわら・鮎の土鍋ごはん (2人から)、そば湯と黒豆茶、昼は満席に。

osaka_nihonshu_unagidani_shinsaibashi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Eel is glazed with a sweet-savoury sauce, and the menu includes squid, maitake and chikuwa tempura, somen and sushi rolls.
osaka_nihonshu_unagidani_shinsaibashi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an eel, fish and sake bar; the eel omelette is a dashi omelette.
osaka_nihonshu_unagidani_shinsaibashi.hours_raw: Daily 12:00–23:30, last order food 22:30, drinks 23:00; open year-round (Tabelog). Reservations for seats; 1.5-hour limit only when crowded (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 40 seats, mainly standing with some chairs and a counter (Tabelog; April and July 2026); non-smoking (Tabelog). Food is ordered by QR code; sake is chosen from the fridge, standard serving 90 cc (June 2026). Hard to find: Google Maps shows the building to the north; go down the alley behind the vending machines next to Ichiran, turn left at the end; dark at night (Tabelog).
osaka_nihonshu_unagidani_shinsaibashi.notes: [Sake bar · Shinsaibashi, 100+ sakes and eel] A lively, mostly standing sake bar tucked behind the Shinsaibashi-suji arcade, open from noon every day, with over 100 sakes you pick yourself from the fridge in 90 cc pours. Eat the "U-maki" eel omelette, uzaku and some sashimi, or come at lunch for unaju at about ¥3,000. Hard to find: walk down the alley behind the vending machines beside Ichiran and turn left. Book on weekend nights; expect ¥3,000–5,000 a head in 2026.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop listing (corporate member): opened 24 April 2015; over 100 sakes always in stock; signature "U-maki", newer unaju. A July 2026 reviewer writes that the sakes are selected by the owner (owner not named).
chef_bio.specialty: "U-maki" eel omelette; 100+ sakes.

anecdotes.text: "There were really a lot of foreign visitors here [around Shinsaibashi] ... It's nice that a place focused on local sake has fewer inbound visitors, making it a relaxing spot." — June 2026, at 3 PM on a rainy day.
"At first, I tried to navigate there but got lost and wandered around for a bit before finally finding it!" — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 日本酒うなぎだに、居酒屋・うなぎ・日本酒バー、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋1-3-28、心斎橋駅5・6番出口から徒歩2分、Google マップでは北側の建物が出る、一蘭の横の自販機の裏の路地を入って突き当たりを左、夜は暗いので足元に注意。毎日12:00〜23:30 (料理 L.O. 22:30、ドリンク L.O. 23:00)、年中無休、席のみ予約可、混雑時は1.5時間制、カード・PayPay 可、電子マネー不可、40席、立ち飲み中心、禁煙、2015年4月24日オープン。日本酒は常時100種以上、名物「う巻き」は注文率90%、新名物のうな重、日本酒約60種飲み放題と寿司のコース9,900円、約50種の飲み放題と料理のコース6,600円。口コミ(2026年4月〜10月): 冷蔵庫から選ぶ日本酒、90cc、料理は QR コードで注文、飲み比べ、大吟醸セット1,880円、Saku のグラス1,400円、お通し440円、長芋の醤油焼き650円、うなぎ玉子900円、うざく、鶏刺し、馬肉ユッケ、うな重は昼に3,000円ほど、2/3と3/4のサイズ、揖保乃糸のお素麺、鴨ロース、周辺は外国人客が多いが店は落ち着いている。

cultural_comfort.note: Food ordered by QR code; sake picked from the fridge and handed to staff (2026). A June 2026 reviewer notes fewer overseas visitors here than in the surrounding streets. No English evidence found.

osaka_cafe_bistro_for_yu_kitahorie.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The courses centre on fresh pasta, bread with free refills and a Rossini with Périgueux sauce; a September 2026 reviewer's request for no raw food (for a pregnancy) was handled at booking, so state needs when reserving.
osaka_cafe_bistro_for_yu_kitahorie.vegan_detail: Ask. No vegan information. The menu is French-Italian with wagyu, foie gras, prosciutto and seafood pasta; dietary requests have been taken at booking (September 2026).
osaka_cafe_bistro_for_yu_kitahorie.hours_raw: Mon–Sat and holidays 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–23:00; Sun 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–22:00 (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), transport IC, Rakuten Edy, nanaco, WAON, iD, QUICPay and QR payment (Tabelog). 22 seats: 8 at the counter, 14 at tables; smoking allowed near the entrance; wheelchair accessible; free Wi-Fi; private hire up to 20 (Tabelog). Dogs allowed inside, with a dog menu (Tabelog; October 2026).
osaka_cafe_bistro_for_yu_kitahorie.notes: [French-Italian bistro · Kitahorie, Rossini and dogs welcome] A small bistro a minute from Yotsubashi Station serving French-Italian courses at low prices, with a Rossini of Takamori wagyu and foie gras as the signature. Come for the ¥1,800 Italian lunch of appetisers, pasta and dessert, or the weekday 7-dish dinner course at ¥3,500; the bread is refilled. Dogs may come inside, and there is a dog menu. Book: 22 seats, one chef in the kitchen (October 2026), and it is near full at lunch.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop listing (corporate member): opened 15 April 2023; the chef trained at a high-end Tokyo restaurant (not named) and cooks French-Italian dishes with Japanese ingredients. An October 2026 reviewer saw one chef cooking and two other staff serving.
chef_bio.specialty: Takamori wagyu and foie gras Rossini.

anecdotes.text: "There was one chef cooking and two other staff members ... the bread served during the meal is unlimited!" — October 2026, a celebration lunch.
"If I had to nitpick, the beef Rossini was a bit tough." — October 2026, a birthday dinner.
"We came to celebrate my dog's birthday ... a message plate for the final dessert." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): Cafe&Bistro For Yu、イタリアン・ビストロ・バル、大阪市西区北堀江1-9-9 1階、四ツ橋駅から徒歩1分、月〜土・祝11:30〜15:00、17:00〜23:00、日11:30〜15:00、17:00〜22:00、予約可、ディナーのアラカルトはアミューズ代ひとり300円、カード・電子マネー・QR 決済可、22席 (カウンター8、テーブル14)、入口付近で喫煙可、ペット可、2023年4月15日オープン。東京の高級店で修業したシェフのフレンチとイタリアン、名物は Dassai の酒粕で育てた Takamori の和牛とフォアグラのロッシーニ、平日限定のフルコース7品3,500円、ランチ8品1,800円から。口コミ(2026年9月〜10月): イタリアンランチ1,800円、フレンチランチ2,800円、バスクチーズケーキ+300円、山椒のボロネーゼ大盛り無料、パンのおかわり、犬と店内で食事、犬のメニュー、メッセージプレート、ロッシーニがやや硬いという声も、シェフ1人とスタッフ2人。

osaka_gin_an_shinsaibashi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: battered, deep-fried kushikatsu (one skewer is raw wheat gluten, October 2026), dipped in a thickened dashi, salt or sauce.
osaka_gin_an_shinsaibashi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the skewers are eaten with dashi, and the kamameshi is chicken, sea bream, eel or seafood.
osaka_gin_an_shinsaibashi.hours_raw: Sun–Fri 17:00–23:30, Sat 16:30–23:30, last order 23:00 (Tabelog). Reservations recommended; walk-ins are often turned away (May 2026); check an online booking is for the Shinsaibashi shop; counter bookings may be moved to a table; two-hour limit when busy (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), transport IC and other e-money, PayPay, d Barai, Rakuten Pay, au PAY, Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 28 seats: 8 at the counter, 20 at tables; non-smoking, smoking space outside; not suitable for infants (Tabelog). Menu in English, traditional and simplified Chinese and Korean, with photos (Tabelog).
osaka_gin_an_shinsaibashi.notes: [Kushikatsu · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, skewers in dashi and kamameshi] A calm kushikatsu restaurant where the skewers are dipped in a thick dashi instead of the usual sauce, and the meal ends with kamameshi cooked in an iron pot. Take the omakase, stopping when full, and order the kamameshi early because it takes time; staff tell you which dip suits each skewer. Book: walk-ins are often turned away. One of three Gin An shops (also Namba and Kyobashi). Expect ¥5,000–8,000 a head in 2026.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop listing (corporate member): opened 19 December 2017; kushikatsu eaten with dashi and kamameshi; website antique-dining.com. Other Gin An shops in Namba and Kyobashi are listed on gurunavi and tabiiro.
chef_bio.specialty: Kushikatsu with dashi; kamameshi.

anecdotes.text: "It's definitely better to make a reservation at this place." — May 2026, a regular who adds that walk-ins were turned away on every visit.
"The staff recommends which to use for each freshly fried kushikatsu." — September 2026.
"The broth had a thick, sauce-like consistency, but personally, I prefer a thinner broth." — August 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): お出汁で食べる串かつと釜めしの専門店 ぎん庵 心斎橋、串揚げ・釜めし・居酒屋、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-9-13、Crysta Nagahori の南5番出口から南へ30m、長堀橋駅から徒歩3分、日〜金17:00〜23:30、土16:30〜23:30 (L.O. 23:00)、予約可、心斎橋店の予約か確認を、混雑時は2時間制、カード・電子マネー・QR 決済可、28席 (カウンター8、テーブル20)、禁煙 (店外に喫煙所)、英語・中国語・韓国語のメニュー、2017年12月19日オープン。お出汁で食べる串かつと釜めし、Tenshi no Ebi、黒毛和牛サーロイン、Hokkaido のホタテ、串かつ12本のコース4,500円、レディースコース4,500円、特選コース6,500円。口コミ(2026年3月〜10月): 予約なしは断られることが多い、おまかせは20本ほどで好きなところで止められる、だし・塩・ソースを店の人がすすめてくれる、釜めしは鶏、鯛、うなぎ、ホタルイカ、鮭いくら、さんま、だしでお茶漬けに、串10本と釜めしと1杯で5,100円ほど。系列は難波と京橋にも (ぐるなび)。

osaka_yama_goya_nishinakajima.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the daily lunches are often breaded (menchi katsu, filet cutlet) and come with demi-glace sauce, which is usually thickened with flour.
osaka_yama_goya_nishinakajima.vegan_detail: Not vegan: steak, hamburg steak, chicken and cutlets.
osaka_yama_goya_nishinakajima.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–22:00; closed Sunday and holidays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 18 seats at a counter and tables; smoking allowed (Tabelog). Food comes fast at lunch (April 2026).
osaka_yama_goya_nishinakajima.notes: [Yoshoku · Nishinakajima, a couple's steak counter] A wood-panelled steak and yoshoku counter a minute from Nishinakajima-Minamigata, run by an older couple: a bearded master smiling at the grill and the lady of the house taking orders (April, May and August 2026). One diner put it at 50 years old (March 2026). Lunch is a ¥1,000 daily special with rice and miso soup, a different main each day (menchi katsu or a small filet cutlet under rich demi-glace, chicken steak with sansho, ketchup-simmered hamburg steak), quick and filling enough for office workers to make it a habit (2026). The ¥1,500 steak lunch is tender, with lemon herb butter (October 2025). Smoking is allowed. Closed Sunday.

roles: Owner couple (unnamed): the master at the grill and a partner on the floor
chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog listing: an open-kitchen counter in a calm, wood-themed room serving good steak at fair prices. Reviewers: "It seemed like an elderly couple was running the place" (April 2026); "the master and the lady of the house welcomed me with kindness" (May 2026); "A steakhouse where the master with a beard smiles while grilling. It seems to be run by a couple" (August 2026); "This place has been around for 50 years" (March 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Daily ¥1,000 lunch with demi-glace; steak lunch.

anecdotes.text: "So far, I haven't had the same menu item twice." — January 2026, a regular at lunch.
"A steakhouse where the master with a beard smiles while grilling." — August 2026, the JPY 1,000 lunch.
"I also enjoyed changing the flavor by spreading some herb butter with lemon on the meat." — October 2025, the steak lunch for JPY 1,500.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 山小屋、ステーキ・鉄板焼き・ハンバーグ、大阪市淀川区西中島3-19-7 第一ユヤマビル 1F、Midosuji 線 西中島南方駅から徒歩1分、阪急 南方駅から3分、月〜土11:30〜14:00、17:00〜22:00、日・祝休み、予約可、カード (JCB、AMEX、Diners) 可、電子マネー・QR 不可、18席、喫煙可。店の紹介: 木の落ち着いた空間、オープンキッチンのカウンター、上質のステーキを手頃に。口コミ(2025年9月〜2026年9月): 日替わりランチ1,000円 (ごはんとみそ汁つき、メンチカツのデミグラス、小さなヒレカツとミートボール、チキンステーキ、ケチャップで煮込んだハンバーグ)、ステーキランチ1,500円 (サラダ、レモンのハーブバター)、ヒレステーキのポン酢、カレー、りんごとオレンジのサラダ、年配の夫婦で切り盛り、ひげのマスター、50年続く洋食屋という声、出てくるのが早い。

osaka_omusubi_on_higashimikuni.gf_detail: Ask. Tabelog's feature list ticks "gluten-free options", and an April 2026 diner had a gluten-free cake set; the onigiri are rice, nori and salt, but many fillings are seasoned (soy-marinated egg yolk, mayonnaise mixes) and the side somen is wheat. Ask which fillings suit.
osaka_omusubi_on_higashimikuni.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog's feature list ticks "vegan options" and "vegetarian options", and there are plain fillings such as sesame kombu and honey plum (2026), but nothing is labelled vegan; the miso soup is a clam broth (November 2025) and the meat soup is meat.
osaka_omusubi_on_higashimikuni.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri and Sat 8:00–20:00; Sun 9:00–15:00; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservations through the shop's LINE account until the day before; same-day by phone first, though the phone may go unanswered when staff are busy (Tabelog). No cards or e-money; PayPay accepted (Tabelog). 14 seats plus a terrace where pets may sit; non-smoking; children and strollers welcome; free Wi-Fi; takeaway and delivery (Tabelog). Order at the counter; staff bring the food (February 2026). Opened 11 January 2024 (Tabelog).
osaka_omusubi_on_higashimikuni.notes: [Onigiri · Higashimikuni, rice balls made to order from 8 am] A small onigiri shop in the shopping street by Higashiyodogawa Station, opened in January 2024 by an owner who trained at a popular onigiri shop in Otsuka, Tokyo (Tabelog). Each rice ball is shaped after you order, loose and fluffy with the filling packed right through, in two sizes (150 g or 100 g) and with 34 fillings from salmon and sujiko to minced meat with soy-cured yolk or shrimp mayo with cream cheese (2026). Add a set of clam miso soup, dashimaki and takuan, or the meat soup, or have the onigiri drowned in dashi as chazuke. Open from 8:00 for breakfast; Tabelog marks gluten-free and vegan options, so ask. The owner is warm (May 2026). Book by LINE the day before. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog listing: "The owner, who trained at a popular restaurant in Otsuka, Tokyo, opened this place in January 2024"; freshly made rice balls after ordering; mostly domestic, additive-free, handmade ingredients; fillings packed from first bite to last. An April 2026 diner lists Shiga Koshihikari rice, first-grade Ariake nori and Okinawa salt. A May 2026 diner praises "the warm hospitality from the owner".
chef_bio.specialty: Made-to-order onigiri with 34 fillings; miso-soup set.

anecdotes.text: "The fillings were not only on top but generously packed inside as well, providing satisfaction until the very last bite." — February 2026, salmon and sujiko with the miso-soup set.
"For an additional JPY 150, you can have either hot or cold dashi poured over your omusubi." — July 2026, sesame kombu for JPY 330.
"The cake set is a delightful gluten-free treat." — April 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 恩結び -on-、おにぎり、大阪市淀川区東三国1-20-2、東三国駅4番出口から徒歩3分、JR 東淀川駅西口から4分、月・火・木・金・土8:00〜20:00、日曜9:00〜15:00、水曜休み、予約は前日までに公式 LINE で、当日は電話で、カード・電子マネー不可、PayPay 可、14席、テラス席はペット可、禁煙、子ども可、Wi-Fi、テイクアウトとデリバリー、野菜にこだわり、モーニング、ヴィーガン・ベジタリアン・グルテンフリーのメニューありの表示、2024年1月11日オープン。店の紹介: Tokyo の Otsuka の人気店で修業した店主が2024年1月に開店、注文を受けてからにぎる、ふわっと空気をふくむ大粒のお米、具は最初から最後まで、国産中心で無添加、手作り、トッピングを自由に。口コミ(2025年9月〜2026年10月): おむすび150gとこむすび100g (100円安い)、具は34種、Shiga のコシヒカリ、Ariake ののり、Okinawa の塩、雑穀米も、鮭、すじこ、鮭マヨ、そぼろと卵黄の醤油漬け、明太子と高菜、エビマヨとクリームチーズと大葉、鮭といくら、ツナの角煮、たらこクリームチーズ、ねぎといくら、ごま昆布330円、はちみつ梅、ねぎとろ480円、貝のだしのみそ汁とだし巻きとたくあんのセット、肉のスープ、そうめん330円、だし茶漬けは150円増し、グルテンフリーのケーキのセット、朝8時から、お酒も、店主のあたたかいもてなし。

osaka_kixisoba_kishimoto_nishinakajima.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: homemade wheat noodles; the shoyu tare is soy.
osaka_kixisoba_kishimoto_nishinakajima.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken and bonito broth, shrimp in the Awai soba, pork chashu.
osaka_kixisoba_kishimoto_nishinakajima.hours_raw: Mon–Thu, Sat and Sun 11:00–16:00; closed Friday, plus temporary closures announced on the shop's social media (Tabelog). No reservations; no cards; transport IC cards and PayPay accepted (Tabelog); buy a ticket at the machine by the door (October 2026). 7 counter seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). Full at lunch, often with a short wait (2026). Opened 12 November 2019 (Tabelog); closed for about three years and reopened on 29 May 2026 (June and October 2026 reviews).
osaka_kixisoba_kishimoto_nishinakajima.notes: [Ramen · Nishinakajima, ¥690 espuma dashi soba] A seven-seat counter in a residential block west of Nishinakajima-Minamigata, opened in 2019 by an owner who trained at the popular Chuka Soba Kuzu, closed for about three years at the height of its fame and reopened on 29 May 2026 to lines (June and October 2026). The Dashi Soba is the bowl: a frothy, creamy chicken and bonito broth with two Hozan soy sauces, homemade noodles in a 1.5-serving portion, smoked chashu and chopped onion at the bottom, for ¥690 at a time when ramen costs ¥1,000 (2026). The Awai Soba adds shrimp and white tamari, and a smoked seasoned egg is ¥100 well spent. Buy a ticket at the door; lunch only, 11:00–16:00, closed Friday.

roles: Owner (unnamed), trained at Chuka Soba Kuzu
chef_bio.background: Per a June 2026 review: "The owner trained at the very popular shop 'Chuka Soba Kuzu' before opening this place. It temporarily closed about three years ago during its peak popularity, but it reopened on May 29th." An October 2026 review gives the broth as chicken and honkarebushi with two soy sauces from Hozan (Aichi) and the noodles as homemade, additive-free. Opened 12 November 2019 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Dashi Soba; Awai Soba; smoked seasoned egg.

anecdotes.text: "Seven years ago, the price was JPY 650, but even after reopening, you can still enjoy this great bowl for JPY 690!" — October 2026, the Dashi Soba.
"It had a smoky aroma reminiscent of being smoked, which I really enjoyed. Adding it for JPY 100 was definitely a great decision." — October 2026, the seasoned egg on the Dashi Soba.
"It was great to reunite with the bubbly espuma Dashi Soba!" — October 2026, just before 2 pm, the shop still packed.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 喜蕎麦司 きし元、ラーメン、大阪市淀川区西中島4-11-24 第1ユーリハイツ 1F、西中島南方駅から299m、月〜木・土・日11:00〜16:00、金曜休み (臨時休業は公式 SNS で)、予約不可、カード不可、交通系 IC・PayPay 可、7席 (カウンター)、禁煙、2019年11月12日オープン。口コミ(2026年6月〜10月): Chuka Soba Kuzu で修業した店主、約3年の休業のあと2026年5月29日に再開、入口の券売機、Dashi Soba 690円 (麺大盛り150円)、Awai Soba 770円、卵の麺380円、トッピング、鶏と本枯節のスープに Hozan の醤油2種、泡立ったクリーミーな「エスプーマ」、少しの鶏油とローストガーリック、自家製麺は1.5玉、燻製のチャーシュー、ねぎ、刻み玉ねぎ、柚子こしょう、Awai Soba はエビと白たまり、限定の塩、とんこつ約880円、味玉のローストポーク丼 (バジルのソース)、ミニチャーシュー丼、燻製の味玉、昼は満席で少し待つことも。

osaka_stand_beer_tora_higashimikuni.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a beer bar (barley beer), with fried "popper" peppers, schnitzel, bruschetta and yaki udon on the menu.
osaka_stand_beer_tora_higashimikuni.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the signature popper is stuffed with cheese and bacon; smoked fish, sausages and meat dishes.
osaka_stand_beer_tora_higashimikuni.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Fri and Sat 17:30–23:00; Sun 17:30–21:00; closed Wednesday and Thursday (Tabelog). Reservations by phone only, no online booking; with few seats, booking is wise (Tabelog; August 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), QUICPay and QR payments (Tabelog). No cover charge (August 2026). 16 seats: a counter of six, two tables for four and one for two; non-smoking; children and strollers welcome; free Wi-Fi; sports on screen (Tabelog). Opened 7 November 2023 (Tabelog).
osaka_stand_beer_tora_higashimikuni.notes: [Beer bar · Higashimikuni, Pilsner Urquell from a certified tapster] A 16-seat beer stand two minutes from Higashimikuni Station, opened in 2023 around draft Pilsner Urquell poured properly by its owner, Daisuke, a certified tapster (December 2025), who told one diner that the pour was learned from the Czech Pavilion staff at the 2025 Expo (August 2026); Expo fans come back for it, and the foam-heavy "Mirko" has its regulars. The food is the other draw and changes with the seasons: the signature popper (a fried pepper filled with jalapeño, cheese and bacon, one each), smoked mackerel and fish cake, schnitzel, figs with cream cheese (2025–2026). Busy and small, so phone ahead. Closed Wednesday and Thursday.

roles: Owner and certified Pilsner Urquell tapster
chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog listing: draft Pilsner Urquell poured by a certified "Tap Star", craft gin and fermented ginger ale, the "Tacopy" and "Popper" and smoked dishes; opened 7 November 2023. A December 2025 diner had "beer poured by the owner, Daisuke, during an event in Tokyo" before visiting the bar. An August 2026 diner was told by the owner that the staff of the Czech Pavilion had taught the pour.
chef_bio.specialty: Pilsner Urquell poured several ways; popper; smoked dishes.

anecdotes.text: "It truly tasted just like the beer from the expo! I was so moved!" — August 2026, Pilsner Urquell large for JPY 1,300.
"The more you grow up, the more you start to love green peppers, and you absolutely have to try their specialties, 'Hopper' and 'Takopi!'" — January 2026, drinks and food for JPY 2,780.
"The pouring technique is simply wonderful and soothing!" — February 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: スタンド ビアとら、バル・ビアバー・タコス、大阪市淀川区東三国1-24-8、Midosuji 線 東三国駅4番出口から徒歩2分、JR 東淀川駅から6分、新大阪駅から10分、月・火・金・土17:30〜23:00、日曜17:30〜21:00、水・木休み、予約は電話のみ (ネット予約なし)、カード・QUICPay・QR 可、16席 (カウンター6、4人テーブル2、2人テーブル1)、禁煙、子ども可、Wi-Fi、スポーツ観戦、2023年11月7日オープン。店の紹介: 認定タップスターが注ぐPilsner Urquell の生、クラフトジン、発酵ジンジャーエール、ピーマンにタコミートの「Tacopy」、看板の「Popper」、燻製のメニュー。口コミ(2024年6月〜2026年9月): 店主 Daisuke さん、万博のチェコのパビリオンのスタッフから注ぎ方を教わったという話、Mirko、Pilsner Urquell 大1,300円、ハラペーニョとチーズとベーコンの Popper (ひとり1つ)、サバの燻製、燻製のかまぼこ、シュニッツェル、菜の花のおひたし、ライスなしのハヤシ、鮮魚のねぎ、新じゃがの素揚げ、焼きうどん、ソーセージ5種680円、焼きトマトとしらすのガーリックブルスケッタ、チャーシューエッグ、いちじくとクリームチーズ、Masahiro の Okinawa のジン、チャージなし、席が少ないので予約を。

osaka_shokudo_matsuoka_shinsaibashi_parc.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The oden dashi of kombu, bonito and chicken is finished with white soy sauce (Tabelog), and soy sauces usually contain wheat; the fried horse mackerel, tempura, shumai and the whole-wheat ramen are wheat-based. Sashimi is the place to start asking.
osaka_shokudo_matsuoka_shinsaibashi_parc.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish and oden izakaya; the oden dashi uses bonito and chicken (Tabelog).
osaka_shokudo_matsuoka_shinsaibashi_parc.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 12:00–15:00 and 17:00–22:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–22:00; closed when Shinsaibashi PARCO closes (Tabelog). The official site lists lunch 12:00–15:00 and dinner 17:00–22:00, irregular closures. The ramen is a weekday-lunch dish (Tabelog; October 2026). Reservations online; groups of 12 or more by phone; a booking may be cancelled 15 minutes after the time if the shop cannot reach you (Tabelog). Courses: Tabelog says courses are currently not available, while a July 2026 regular booked the omakase course through Tabelog. Order by smartphone or QR code (March 2025; October 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), IC cards, iD, QUICPay and QR (Tabelog). 25 seats with a counter; non-smoking, smoking area on the same floor; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog; seat count also on the official site). Opened 18 March 2021 (Tabelog).
osaka_shokudo_matsuoka_shinsaibashi_parc.notes: [Izakaya · Shinsaibashi PARCO, a Bib Gourmand oden and fish izakaya] A calm counter izakaya in the B2F food street of Shinsaibashi PARCO, run by the sio group and known until 2026 as The New World (a regular reports the rename in July 2026); one regular notes Bib Gourmand listings in the Michelin Guide Kyoto-Osaka. The draws are oden in a deep kombu, bonito and chicken dashi, aged sashimi and straw-grilled bonito, crisp fried horse mackerel with pickle tartar and a soft-boiled egg in fuki-miso sauce. Weekday lunch brings a light Japanese-style ramen of Kujo negi and bluefin tuna. Diners in 2026 call the food carefully made and fairly priced for the location; one found the QR ordering confusing. Open daily, following PARCO's closing days.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an "authentic diner operated by the Sio Group", opened 18 March 2021; the former name was The New World (ザ・ニューワールド). Per a regular of 19 visits: still The New World in January 2026, "completely revamped and is now called Shokudo Matsuoka" by July 2026; the same diner congratulated it on a Bib Gourmand in the Michelin Guide Kyoto-Osaka 2023 (October 2022) and wrote in March 2025 that it had been a Bib Gourmand two years running. Per the official site: oden in an ultimate dashi and sashimi, seasonal ingredients and the plates of craftsmen, with drinks from around Japan.
chef_bio.philosophy: Casual Japanese food: oden in an ultimate dashi and sashimi, with seasonal ingredients and drinks from around Japan, in a calm room (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Oden; sashimi; fried horse mackerel.

anecdotes.text: "The izakaya 'The New World' located on the basement level of Shinsaibashi PARCO has been completely revamped and is now called 'Shokudo Matsuoka.'" — July 2026, a 19th visit, the omakase course.
"It's worth going just to try this soft-boiled egg." — June 2026, with fuki miso sauce.

"I initially thought this place would be an expensive Japanese restaurant based on its atmosphere … However, when I passed by the restaurant, I discovered they offer a reasonably priced weekday ramen special." — October 2026.

Smoking allowed (Tabelog); a September 2026 diner found it mostly smoke-free just after lunch.
osaka_koubaiken_senba.notes: [Chinese · Senba, Showa-style sara udon and fried rice] A long-running local Chinese restaurant at the end of the basement food street of Senba Center Building No. 10, straight off Honmachi Station, where weekday lunch brings queues of office workers and evenings fill with colleagues over beer. Order the sara udon, crisp noodles buried in a thick vegetable and seafood sauce (add mustard, then vinegar), or the champon, with a side of sweet, moist fried rice; set meals are big. Cash only, tables shared and smoking allowed. Diners in 2026 love the fried rice, sara udon and the warm service; others found the kara-age and sweet and sour pork tough and a gyoza order slow. Closed Sundays; Saturday lunch only.

chef_bio.background: Per 2026 reviews: a long-established local Chinese restaurant in Senba Center Building No. 10, directly connected to Honmachi Station; a staff member who appeared to be the owner was friendly and apologised for a slow gyoza order with a few extra gyoza (August 2026). Tabelog gives no opening date; the listing is not shop-maintained.
chef_bio.specialty: Sara udon; champon; fried rice.

anecdotes.text: "During lunchtime, it gets so crowded with salarymen that you could almost play a rugby match in there!" — August 2025, sara udon with half fried rice ¥1,200.
"I added some mustard for a flavor change. Then, after eating about half, I drizzled some vinegar on it for another flavor twist." — October 2026, sara udon.
"The two signature dishes here are Sara Udon and Champon." — October 2026, around 1 PM.

osaka_kissa_victorya_nannan.notes: [Kissa · Namba Nannan, a 1957 coffee shop with a four-egg sandwich] A long-loved kissa in the NAMBA Nannan underground mall under the sign "OSAKA NAMBA 1957", just off the Midosuji Line gates, so you can reach it without going outside. Come for the thick omelette sandwich, four eggs high and gently seasoned with dashi, or the hamburg Napolitan, a slice of Dojima roll, scones with clotted cream, an Osaka mixed juice or a cream soda. It opens at 9:00 for breakfast and stays open until 22:00, with sofas, Wi-Fi, outlets and QR ordering. Diners in 2026 praise the sandwich and the convenience; one found the royal milk tea weak and lukewarm for ¥920, another the morning mixed juice not fresh. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog listing (shop-maintained): established 65 years ago in Minami, Osaka, serving its signature coffee-shop menu of Napolitan, thick omelette sandwiches, Osaka mixed juice, cream soda and pudding à la mode; former name Victoria Cafe (ビクトリア カフェ). A September 2026 diner notes the sign "OSAKA NAMBA 1957".
chef_bio.specialty: Thick omelette sandwich; Napolitan; Dojima roll.

"Located inside NAMBA Nannan, this long-loved, traditional café has a charming retro atmosphere, marked by the sign 'OSAKA NAMBA 1957'." — September 2026, matcha affogato.

osaka_brooklyn_parlor_shinsaibashi.notes: [American · Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Blue Note's burger, book and jazz parlor] A big brick-and-wood basement café-bar for music, café, books, eats and bar, the Osaka sister of Brooklyn Parlor in Shinjuku, produced by Blue Note Tokyo, with live jazz and DJ nights. It serves non-stop from 11:00 to 23:00: burgers in half or full sizes, clam chowder, roast beef, jambalaya, salads and pizza, with lunch sets that come with milk bread and a honey dip. The 160 seats and sofas make it a relaxed place for meetings or a late coffee and cake. Diners in 2026 like the food and the mood; one found the service slow, and an earlier regular the music loud. Open daily.

roles: Run by BLUE NOTE JAPAN, INC. (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: "music, cafe, books, eats, bar"; produced by Blue Note Tokyo and operated by Blue Note Japan; two shops, Shinjuku (Shinjuku OIOI Annex B1F) and Osaka; regular jazz events ("JAZZ@the Parlor") and other live shows. Opened 20 April 2014 (Tabelog).

osaka_kopuchan_chi_shinsaibashi.notes: [Korean · Shinsaibashi, gopchang under club lights] A bright, Instagram-styled Korean restaurant three minutes from Shinsaibashi Station, built around kopchang: beef small intestine grilled on a hot plate in the house sauce, wrapped in perilla leaves, and finished as fried rice in the same pan. Lunch from 10 a.m. runs to sundubu, seolleongtang and samgyeopsal sets; at night it fills with young groups and K-pop, with all-you-can-drink courses. The sundubu spice level is fixed, so ask if you are sensitive to heat. Bills over ¥10,000 earn a spin of the gacha at the till (August 2026). English, Chinese and Korean menus; Korean-speaking staff.

roles: Kitchen and floor staff (unnamed); Korean-speaking staff (Tabelog)

Opened 15 April 2022.

osaka_niku_sakana_sake_yuu_shinsaibashi.notes: [Izakaya · Minami-Shinsaibashi, a hundred dishes until 2 a.m.] A hideaway izakaya on the ground floor of a building of snack bars in Minami-Shinsaibashi, with a menu of about a hundred dishes that runs from thick-cut sashimi to Peking duck, so everyone in a mixed group finds something to order. Favourites in September 2026 were the black-truffle pork gyoza (¥680), a bluefin toro and takuan roll to wrap in Korean seaweed (¥900) and black wagyu tataki (¥980); a half grilled eel was ¥1,800 in October 2026. osaka_namba_teppanyaki_sublime.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Steak comes with bonito soy sauce, onion soy sauce, salt and wasabi; one October 2026 diner who asked ahead had dietary restrictions met.
osaka_namba_teppanyaki_sublime.vegan_detail: Not vegan: wagyu and seafood teppanyaki courses.
osaka_namba_teppanyaki_sublime.hours_raw: Daily 12:00–15:00 and 17:00–23:00; open year-round; no phone cancellations outside opening hours (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Service charge 10% (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 38 seats: an 8-seat counter at the teppan, private rooms (Tabelog; October 2026). Non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). Bottled water ¥660 a litre (October 2026).
osaka_namba_teppanyaki_sublime.notes: [Teppanyaki · Namba, wagyu and live abalone at the counter] A sixth-floor teppanyaki room two minutes from Namba Station, run with Azabu-Juban Sublime, the Tokyo restaurant the shop says held a Michelin star three years running. At the eight-seat counter the chef grills black wagyu and live Hyogo abalone, still moving in front of you, with Burgundy butter. Lunch is the way in: a lean and strip-loin comparison course for ¥3,800. The dinner Classic course adds an appetizer box, a wagyu shabu-shabu and wagyu sirloin sushi. A sushi bar on the same floor belongs to the same group. One October 2026 birthday diner found the course rushed at about an hour, and bottled water was ¥660. A 10% service charge applies.

chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a collaboration with Azabu-Juban Sublime, "featured in the Michelin Guide Tokyo for 2018, 2019, and 2020"; the finest Kobe beef on the teppan; private rooms. Official site (sublime-g.com) lists 名駅 鮨 Sublime, 難波 鉄板焼き Sublime, 銀座 フレンチ Sublime, Premium 銀座 鉄板焼き Sublime and 恵比寿 鉄板焼き Sublime. Reviews (August 2026) note that a sushi restaurant on the same floor is a sister shop.
chef_bio.specialty: Wagyu and live-abalone teppanyaki courses.

anecdotes.text: "A giant abalone still moving right in front of me!" — August 2026.
"I visited this restaurant on a date with my girlfriend, and I’m glad I chose it for a special occasion." — October 2026; dietary restrictions raised in advance were accommodated.
"However, the course was served within about an hour, and the overall pace of the dishes was a bit too fast for my liking." — October 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (sublime-g.com): 店舗は名駅 鮨 Sublime、難波 鉄板焼き Sublime、銀座 フレンチ Sublime、Premium 銀座 鉄板焼き Sublime、恵比寿 鉄板焼き Sublime、2018年・2019年・2020年度ミシュラン3年連続の星。食べログ (店舗会員): 難波 鉄板焼き Sublime、ステーキ・鉄板焼き・日本料理、大阪市中央区難波3-4-13 味わいばしビル 6-D、なんば駅から徒歩2分、毎日12:00〜15:00・17:00〜23:00、年中無休、予約可、サービス料10%、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、38席、個室、禁煙、子ども可、麻布十番 Sublime とのコラボの店、神戸牛の鉄板焼き、ランチの赤身とサーロインの食べ比べのコース3,800円、クリスマスのコース12,000円と18,000円。口コミ(2026年7月〜10月): 前菜の箱、穴子となすのテリーヌ、きのこのブイヨンの黒毛和牛のしゃぶしゃぶ、兵庫の活あわびの鉄板焼き、サーロインと赤身、ガーリックライス1,200円、和牛サーロインの炙り寿司3,500円、アイス、カウンター8席、同じ階の寿司の店は姉妹店、事前に相談した食事制限に対応、コースが1時間ほどで早すぎたという声、水が1リットル660円。

osaka_kaisen_monogatari_namba_shinsaibas.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Raw shrimp is dipped in soy sauce, the hot pot ends with ramen, and kushikatsu and tempura are on the menu.
osaka_kaisen_monogatari_namba_shinsaibas.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood izakaya; the hot pots are shrimp and crab broths.
osaka_kaisen_monogatari_namba_shinsaibas.hours_raw: Mon–Thu and Sun 17:00–2:00 (food last order 1:00, drinks 1:30); Fri and Sat 17:00–3:00 (food 2:00, drinks 2:30) (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; held 15 minutes; you may be sent to the Midosuji branch when full (Tabelog; October 2026). Cards, e-money and QR payments including Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 56 seats: counter facing the fish preparation, tables, tatami and sunken seating; a view over Dotonbori (Tabelog; October 2026). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). English, Chinese and Korean menus with photos; English, Chinese and Korean-speaking staff (Tabelog).
osaka_kaisen_monogatari_namba_shinsaibas.notes: [Seafood · Dotonbori, shrimp shabu-shabu above the street] A second-floor seafood izakaya on Dotonbori, five minutes from Namba Station, with a view over the street and kitchen open until 2 a.m. (3 a.m. at weekends). The thing to order is shrimp shabu-shabu: big red shrimp you first eat raw with soy sauce, then swish through a broth made rich with their own heads, finishing with ramen in the pot; a crab-and-shrimp version comes with grilled crab miso. Courses run ¥4,000–5,500. Around it are sashimi boats, overflowing sushi, a cheese-loaded sushi pizza and Osaka kushikatsu. It is busy; when full you may be sent to the sister shop on Midosuji, so call ahead. Smoking allowed. English, Chinese and Korean menus and staff.

roles: Kitchen and floor staff (unnamed); multilingual staff (Tabelog)
chef_bio.background: Shop-maintained Tabelog listing: sushi and izakaya, original shrimp shabu-shabu (raw in soy sauce, then shabu-shabu in a miso broth, ramen to finish), sashimi platters, overflowing sushi and grilled shellfish from fresh seafood; a counter to watch the fish prepared; two shops (this and the Midosuji branch).
chef_bio.specialty: Shrimp shabu-shabu; sashimi boats.

anecdotes.text: "Since the shrimp can be eaten raw, you can enjoy it as sashimi, lightly shabu-shabu for a rare taste, or cooked thoroughly" — August 2026.
"With the a la carte hot pot, you can enjoy up to 7 shrimp per person." — October 2026.
"There are two locations, and I was directed to a different one from this one. I recommend calling ahead to confirm." — October 2026.

osaka_tori_to_marumaru_togano.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Skewers are salt-seasoned in one review (May 2024), but tsukune is glazed and courses include saikyo-miso fish, sweet-simmered liver, dashi chazuke, udon and oyakodon.
osaka_tori_to_marumaru_togano.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken and fish courses with dashi.
osaka_tori_to_marumaru_togano.hours_raw: Daily 12:00–1:00 (Tabelog). Reservation only; phone lines may be closed, book online (Tabelog). Opened June 9, 2021 (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), Suica-type IC cards, iD, PayPay (Tabelog). 12 seats: 6 at the counter on the first floor, tables, and a fully private second-floor room for 6; private hire up to 20 (Tabelog). Smoking: Tabelog lists a designated smoking area; diners smoked at the table in the private room (December 2025), and an April 2026 diner says smoking is allowed, perhaps e-cigarettes only. The stairs start right inside the private room's sliding door (April 2026). Not an invoice-registered business (Tabelog).
osaka_tori_to_marumaru_togano.notes: [Yakitori · Umeda, Togano-cho, a reservation-only chicken house] A small reservation-only yakitori house in Togano-cho, opened in 2021, whose name says it all: chicken, and sometimes fish. The owner, who ran it solo on a January 2025 visit, grills Awaodori chicken from Tokushima over charcoal with salt and builds courses around it: thigh and breast-and-skin skewers, tsukune, sweet-simmered liver, katsuo tataki, saikyo-grilled fish, and an oyakodon or sea-bream chazuke to finish. Courses run about ¥3,500–6,600, some with all-you-can-drink, and there is a lunch course too. Downstairs is a six-seat counter; upstairs a fully private room that groups book for drinking parties, and where smoking has been allowed. Open noon to 1 am.

chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): opened June 9, 2021; chicken dishes centred on yakitori, made with Tokushima's Awaodori chicken; seasonal creative Japanese courses; fresh seasonal fish, with requests welcome. A January 2025 diner: "The owner operates the restaurant solo"; the counter has 6 seats and the second floor is for private dining.
chef_bio.philosophy: A calm, wood-grain Japanese room where time flows slowly (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Awaodori chicken yakitori; seasonal fish.

anecdotes.text: "This yakitori restaurant uses Awaodori chicken from Tokushima, and occasionally serves fish, which is how it got its name (laughs)." — January 2025.

"The course meal started with a flavorful Katsuo no Tataki topped with plenty of condiments, followed by delicious yakitori, and finished off with a delightful Oyakodon. With an all-you-can-drink option, the price was reasonable at JPY 5000 per person." — October 2024.
"As soon as you open the sliding door to the room, there are stairs right there, so it could be dangerous if you've had too much to drink." — April 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: Reservation only, booked online; hard to find (January 2024). No English evidence found.

osaka_tempura_morii_kitashinchi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: battered tempura, and a fried shrimp-paste bread.
osaka_tempura_morii_kitashinchi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seafood and chicken tempura; the course ends with dashi tencha or egg on rice. Vegetable tempura is served too.
osaka_tempura_morii_kitashinchi.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Fri 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:00), Sat 17:30–21:00 (last order 20:00), closed Sundays and holidays. Hot Pepper: Mon–Fri and days before holidays 17:00–23:00 (food last order 22:00), closed Saturdays and Sundays. The two listings differ; check before a Saturday visit. Opened April 6, 2011 (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Seats: 20 on Tabelog (10 counter, 10 table), 16 on Hot Pepper; private hire up to 20 (Tabelog). Smoking allowed (Tabelog; Hot Pepper: all seats). No one under 20, even with an adult (Hot Pepper). Service charge: Tabelog's Japanese field says なし (none); its machine translation says a charge is added.
osaka_tempura_morii_kitashinchi.notes: [Tempura · Kitashinchi, a relaxed counter with à la carte] A twenty-seat tempura room on a Kitashinchi ground floor, open since 2011, where you can watch each piece fried in front of you in a sesame-oil blend that is changed for every four guests. The seasonal course runs to twelve pieces, prawn, sweetfish, pike conger, ume-and-shiso chicken, oysters in February, and ends with tencha or egg on rice; the shrimp-paste toast with curry salt is the signature. Unusually for the area you can also order à la carte, and diners call it relaxed rather than formal, with friendly staff; one diner was remembered on a second visit. Expect ¥10,000–15,000 a head with drinks; one diner found it pricey. Smoking is allowed and no one under 20 is admitted.

chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): a hideaway for adults with seasonal tempura and fine sake; a blend of white sesame oil and white frying oil, refreshed regularly; prawn tempura and a 12-dish seasonal course recommended; sake and shochu from across Japan. Opened April 6, 2011.
chef_bio.philosophy: Light tempura that adults can eat without feeling heavy (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal tempura course; shrimp-paste bread.

anecdotes.text: "Most of the refined and delicious tempura restaurants offer only set courses, so I'm thrilled that I can order a la carte here!" — July 2024.
"This was my second visit, and I was pleasantly surprised…" — July 2025, on being remembered from the first visit.
"The signature breaded shrimp pairs perfectly with curry powder, allowing the sweetness of the shrimp to bloom." — February 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: Counter seats facing the fryer; staff attentive and friendly (2025–2026). No English evidence found.

osaka_casa_m_kitashinchi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The signature is spaghettini finished in a Parmigiano wheel; grilled dishes come with sauces of Japanese and Western seasonings.
osaka_casa_m_kitashinchi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: charcoal-grilled wagyu, chicken and seafood courses, and a cheese-and-cream pasta.
osaka_casa_m_kitashinchi.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 18:00–23:00 (last order 21:00), closing days not fixed. Official site: 18:00–24:00 (last order 23:00), closing days not fixed; a wine bar with à la carte from 21:00. The two differ on closing time. Lunch is not in either schedule, but Tabelog lists a lunch-only course and diners came for lunch (January 2025; November 2025; March 2026). Opened June 16, 2014 (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, and Discover on the official site); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Seats: 16 on Tabelog (4 counter, 10 table, a private room for 2–3), 19 on the official site (5 counter, 12 table, 2 private); private hire up to 20 (Tabelog). Non-smoking; please avoid strong perfume (Tabelog). Service charge: Tabelog's Japanese field says なし (none); its machine translation says a charge is added.
osaka_casa_m_kitashinchi.notes: [Italian · Kitashinchi, charcoal grill and a flaming cheese wheel] A hidden fourth-floor Italian room down a Kitashinchi alley, open since 2014, where wagyu, jidori and seasonal fish are grilled over charcoal and the courses build to the house show: spaghettini tossed in a flambéed wheel of Parmigiano. Courses are ¥7,000 and ¥11,000 (with caviar, abalone and foie gras), and the owner-sommelier keeps over 100 wines, mostly Burgundy pinot, 13 by the glass. After 9 pm it doubles as a wine bar with à la carte. Diners call it the best value high-end Italian in Kitashinchi and say it feels like home; one describes a couple running it, others one person handling everything. Hard to find: follow the arrows down the alley.

roles: Owner-sommelier and chef (unnamed); a couple runs the room (February 2026)
chef_bio.background: Official site: Casa M (カーサ エム), charcoal grill and Italian in Kitashinchi; "casa" means "home", named so guests can relax; wine stock of over 100 chosen by the owner-sommelier. Tabelog: opened June 16, 2014. Diners: one person handles cooking and serving (January 2025, lunch; February 2026); a February 2026 diner credits the warm atmosphere to the master and the master's wife. "This is the best value high-end Italian restaurant in Kitashinchi." — November 2025.
"The pasta made on a cheese wheel was quite impressive and full of entertainment value." — March 2026.

osaka_stand_koneko_doyama.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The menu includes kara-age, fried figs in dashi, gratin, Neapolitan spaghetti, garlic toast and fried chikuwa.
osaka_stand_koneko_doyama.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a creative izakaya of wagyu, sashimi, sea urchin and chicken, with many dashi-based dishes.
osaka_stand_koneko_doyama.hours_raw: Mon–Sat and holidays 18:00–3:00 (food last order 2:00, drinks 2:30); closed Sundays, some other days and at New Year (Tabelog). Opened June 6, 2025 (Tabelog). Seat charge ¥450 (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), PayPay, d Barai, Rakuten Pay, au PAY, Alipay; no e-money (Tabelog). 18 seats: a counter of 8, tables for 6 and 4, and standing room for about 7; private hire up to 20 (Tabelog); a September 2026 diner found it all seated. Smoking allowed (Tabelog). Phone bookings are easiest after 17:00 (Tabelog).
osaka_stand_koneko_doyama.notes: [Izakaya · Umeda, Doyama, a cat-themed late-night kitchen] A small creative izakaya in a Doyama leisure building, opened in 2025 and open until 3 am, where the cat-loving owner has filled the room with cat figurines, illustrations and photos of staff and customers' cats (there are no real cats, so allergies are not a worry). The cooking is more serious than the decor: a daily wagyu steak with shaliapin sauce, thick sashimi, sea urchin on homemade sesame tofu, tempura figs in dashi, a stuffed baked tomato, sansho-spiced chicken, and a Neapolitan spaghetti served only after 10 pm. Most dishes are ¥400–900, with a ¥450 seat charge, cat-named sours and a short sake list. Busy with regulars; smoking is allowed; closed Sundays.

chef_bio.background: Shop text (Tabelog): creative Japanese dishes by a cat-loving chef; wagyu steak of a different cut each day; three appetizers in cat-shaped dishes with a drink; set meals; a dim, wood-toned room for office workers. Opened June 6, 2025. A September 2026 diner: "A hidden stand run by a cat-loving owner", with house specialties recommended by the owner.
chef_bio.philosophy: Dishes careful in both look and taste (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Wagyu steak; fried figs in dashi; KO-NEKO Neapolitan.

"There are no cats, so it's suitable for those with allergies or who prefer animals." — September 2026.
"The interior is filled with cat-themed decor, including photos of cats belonging to the staff and customers" — October 2026.

cultural_comfort.note: Friendly staff; welcoming to solo diners (September 2026). No English evidence found.
