osaka_sushi_genya_nishinakajima.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Sushi with soy sauce and tempura in batter, with a dipping sauce of katsuobushi, saba-bushi and kombu seasoned with shio-koji (Tabelog); salt is offered as an alternative for the tempura. One February 2026 course was adjusted for a dietary restriction.
osaka_sushi_genya_nishinakajima.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish and seafood sushi, tempura and sashimi. Tabelog ticks "vegetarian options" but names none.
osaka_sushi_genya_nishinakajima.hours_raw: Mon and Wed–Sun 18:00–23:30 (last order 23:00); closed Tuesday; open 29 December 2026, closed 31 December 2026–4 January 2027 (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; calls before 16:00 are answered by an AI system; courses must be booked by the day before (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay; no e-money (Tabelog). 22 seats: 10 at the counter and 3 tables for four; private hire up to 20; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible (Tabelog). Often fully booked by evening (2025–2026). Opened 11 December 2015 (Tabelog).
osaka_sushi_genya_nishinakajima.notes: [Sushi · Nishinakajima-Minamigata, sushi and tempura at one counter] A 22-seat sushi bar a few minutes west of Nishinakajima-Minamigata, behind a deep-blue noren, where one counter turns out both sushi on red-vinegar rice and tempura fried in front of you. The ¥6,000 course of 14 seasonal dishes runs from sashimi and a grilled fish through tempura of red eggplant and angel shrimp to five nigiri such as chutoro and sea urchin; or order a la carte from single pieces. Ten-plus sakes come in cups you choose yourself, every plate is one of a kind, and it fills up most evenings (2025–2026). Book courses a day ahead; closed Tuesdays.

osaka_negiyaki_okonomiyaki_kazu_nishinak.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Nishinakajima-Minamigata, a negiyaki counter at the teppan] A 16-seat okonomiyaki house two minutes from Nishinakajima-Minamigata, always full of repeat customers (March 2026), where the counter faces the teppan and the chef cooks everything in front of you. The negiyaki is the order: a thin batter heaped with green onion and beef tendon, finished with dashi soy sauce, light enough to eat after a night out (September 2025). Regulars also swear by the black yakisoba in squid-ink sauce, the thick-pork tonpei-yaki and the big "Daimyo" negi and soba (¥1,400, 2026). Skewers, stews and a beer at ¥530 make it an izakaya too. From 15:00; PayPay, no cards; smoking allowed.

Per reviews: "The owner is entertaining" (March 2025); "Sitting at the counter, I had the best view of the chef cooking right in front of me" (June 2025); "This cozy restaurant is always packed with repeat customers" (March 2026).

Lunch sets ¥900 until 16:00, ¥950 after (February 2026). Takeaway bento for sale outside, ¥400–500 (July 2022); delivery through apps such as Demaekan (May 2024). osaka_shinkyo_hanten_nishinakajima.notes: [Chinese · Nishinakajima, an all-day neighbourhood canteen] A 17-seat Chinese canteen a few minutes from Nishinakajima-Minamigata with a retro "Peking cuisine" sign, open every day from 11:16 to 21:50, the odd minutes straight from its listing. Lunch sets of champon or gomoku soba with fried rice cost ¥900 until 16:00 (2026), and the Chinese-style katsudon under a sweet-salty sauce has fans (2022–2024). Food arrives fast, deliveries go out constantly, and bento sit outside for passers-by. In the evening, ¥600 small plates and beer sets make it a cheap place to drink. Simple, light seasoning, by one regular's account (February 2026).

osaka_koyoju_honmachi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The signature is tantanmen (wheat noodles), with dumplings, spring rolls and sauced stir-fries; mapo tofu and fried rice are not described (Tabelog menu; reviews).

osaka_koyoju_honmachi.notes: [Chinese · Honmachi, tantanmen in a big basement room] A Chinese restaurant down a spiral stair under a Chuo-dori office building, open for about 40 years and known for its tantanmen, made with house chili oil. The small entrance hides a big room with round tables that fills with office workers at lunch; come before noon or expect a short wait. Diners in 2026 praise the original-flavour tantanmen — sesame-rich, spicy but not overwhelming, the broth light enough to drink — and the mapo tofu set, served within minutes. One diner flies back from Tokyo for it. At night it hosts banquets in private rooms for up to 60.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog, Koyoju Honmachi has reached its 40th anniversary, keeping its tantanmen and suan la tang noodles while trying new dishes; a Tabelog feature speaks of "homemade chili oil and evolved Dan Dan Noodles: 27 years in the making". The shop says Sichuan food has many flavours beyond heat — spicy, sour, numbing, fruity and bitter. A September 2026 regular notes a second Koyoju in Tanimachi 4-chome.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Evolving while preserving our traditional flavours" (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Tantanmen with house chili oil.

osaka_tanimachi_furusato_kozu.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: an udon shop (wheat noodles) with soba, tempura, kara-age and curry; the dashi is the house pride but its seasoning is not described (Tabelog).
osaka_tanimachi_furusato_kozu.vegan_detail: Not vegan: no vegan options are described; the noodle dishes come in a dashi that is not described, and the toppings include meat, chicken, egg, tempura and fish (Tabelog menu).
osaka_tanimachi_furusato_kozu.hours_raw: Open 24 hours, every day; closed 1 January (Tabelog). No reservations. Sushi is taken self-serve from a showcase and added up at the till (September 2026 review).
osaka_tanimachi_furusato_kozu.notes: [Udon · Kozu, 24-hour udon and sushi] An old Osaka udon house that ran for decades in Tanimachi 9-chome and moved in June 2025 to a new building near the National Bunraku Theatre, still open 24 hours. Tabelog speaks of about 50 years; an October 2026 diner says it began as a food stall in 1948. The dashi is the house pride, the noodles soft and flat in the old Osaka style, and sushi waits in a showcase for diners to help themselves. It is a classic last stop after a night out in Minami and a breakfast spot by 5 AM. Regulars of 20 and 30 years say the taste survived the move; two September 2026 diners found the noodles softer, or more like dried noodles, than before.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog, a long-established udon shop of about 50 years that relocated and reopened (opening date of the new shop 8 June 2025); dashi is its specialty, and sushi is made in the shop from fresh market fish every day. An October 2026 review says it was established in 1948, started as a food stall and moved from Tanimachi 9-chome to Nipponbashi, in front of the National Bunraku Theatre.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Dashi is our specialty" (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Osaka udon in house dashi; sushi rolls with udon.

osaka_wakabayashi_shinsaibashi_parco.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–23:00 (Tabelog). Reservations taken; often full on holidays (September 2026). Weekday lunch sets until 18:00 (September 2026 review). A service fee may be added (Tabelog). Cards (incl. UnionPay), transport IC and other e-money, QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay. 40 seats incl. counter; open to the neighbouring shops of the food street; non-smoking (Tabelog; reviews).
osaka_wakabayashi_shinsaibashi_parco.notes: [Chinese · Shinsaibashi PARCO, basement Chinese tavern] A busy Chinese tavern in the Neon Dining Street two floors under Shinsaibashi PARCO, open to the neighbouring stalls like a food court and open from 11 AM to 11 PM. The signature is a big chunk of lemony sweet and sour pork eaten with a knife and fork; diners in 2026 also order the drunken shrimp, gyoza, mapo tofu and the pulpy lemon sour, often after a film at the PARCO cinema. Weekday lunch sets run until 6 PM. Diners note shops of the same name in Links Umeda and Tennoji Mio.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog, "a creative twist on classic Chinese dishes by skilled chefs", with original drinks such as a homemade sansho highball and Shaoxing-wine cocktails. Two September 2026 diners mention Wakabayashi shops in Links Umeda and Tennoji Mio. Tabelog gives the opening as 18 March 2021.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Everyday delight" (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Lemony sweet and sour pork with knife and fork.

anecdotes.text: "The layout of the restaurant is open, with no walls separating it from neighboring shops, creating a lively atmosphere" — September 2026.
"The lemon sour here is refreshing, packed with fruit pulp and lemon peel, and I couldn't help but order it repeatedly." — September 2026.
"I noticed they also have locations in Links Umeda and Tennoji Mio." — September 2026, group of four on a holiday.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 日本語の情報源は未確認。食べログ (英語版): 大衆中華酒場 若林 心斎橋パルコ店、心斎橋パルコ B2F ネオン食堂街、2021年3月18日オープン、毎日11:00〜23:00、40席、禁煙、サービス料がかかる場合あり、職人による定番中華のひと工夫、名物の酢豚はナイフとフォークで、酔っ払い海老、Tenshinhan、自家製Sansho ハイボール、Shaoxing 酒のカクテル。メニュー (2024年8月): 若林の名物7品 (酢豚、Mao Zedong チキン、Mapo tofu、空芯菜炒め、海老春巻き、Tenshinhan、ピスタチオアイス)。口コミ (2026年8月〜10月): いつも混む、隣の店と壁がない屋台のような雰囲気、平日18時までのランチセット、Gyoza、Mapo tofu、レモンサワー、パルコの映画の後に、リンクス梅田と天王寺ミオにも店があるという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Pays with Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). No English menu or English-speaking staff found in the sources.

osaka_torafugu_jo_higashishinsaibashi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Tessa and grilled fugu come with ponzu, garlic salt or moromi soy sauce, and the menu has kara-age, eel and zosui (Tabelog menu; reviews); nothing is stated about wheat.
osaka_torafugu_jo_higashishinsaibashi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fugu, crab and eel restaurant.
osaka_torafugu_jo_higashishinsaibashi.hours_raw: Winter (October–March) daily 16:00–23:30 (last order 22:00); summer (April–September) 12:00–14:00 (last order 13:45) and 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); 24–30 December 15:00–23:30; 31 December–3 January 15:00–21:00 with a 10% service charge; open year-round; no eel in December and January (Tabelog; official site). Reservations: reservation-only courses at least two days ahead; online bookings require a course for every guest; 2-hour limit. Cards (incl. UnionPay), PayPay, Alipay; no e-money. 78 seats: private sunken-kotatsu rooms on the second floor, a tatami room with tables for up to 32 on the third (Tabelog).
osaka_torafugu_jo_higashishinsaibashi.notes: [Fugu · Higashi-Shinsaibashi, tiger fugu with private rooms] A three-floor fugu house a minute from Nagahoribashi Station that serves only domestic tiger fugu, aged to bring out the flavour, plus snow crab and eel. Diners in 2026 praise the grilled fugu, the aged tessa and the creamy grilled shirako, and the staff who grill the fugu and tend the hot pot; one August diner saw the cut fugu still twitch in the pot. A six-visit regular calls the range of cooking outstanding. Private rooms and a tatami hall suit celebrations and banquets. Hours change with the season: evenings only from October to March, lunch and dinner from April to September.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site, the house ages its tiger fugu to draw out the umami for tessa and prepares the tecchiri fish at each visit "to taste the umami down to the marrow"; good dishes start from good ingredients. Tabelog gives the opening as 11 September 2014 and says all fugu is domestic tiger fugu.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Good food comes from good ingredients" (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Aged tiger-fugu tessa; charcoal-grilled fugu.

anecdotes.text: "The staff were incredibly kind, carefully grilling the fugu and preparing the hot pot, which I really appreciated." — June 2026, first fugu.
"The fugu served in the hot pot was still twitching (it was my first time seeing cut fugu move like that), and the final zosui was rich and delicious." — August 2026.
"Everything was delicious, but the grilled soft roe was especially amazing—completely free of any fishy taste and so creamy that I ordered it twice!" — June 2026, à la carte.
"The final dish, the zosui (rice porridge), ended up being quite mild in flavor" — August 2026, private-room course.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: とらふぐ城、大阪心斎橋の国産ふぐ料理、ふぐ・かに・うなぎ・季節限定、熟成させて旨味を引き出した透き通るてっさ、来店ごとに捌き骨の髄から旨味を味わうてっちり、ふぐの王様とらふぐ、ずわいがに、旨い料理は良質な食材から、ふぐで忘年会・ひれ酒で乾杯、東心斎橋1-4-24、夏季 (4月〜9月) 12:00〜14:00 (L.O.13:45)・17:00〜22:00 (L.O.21:00)、冬季 (10月〜3月) 16:00〜23:30、長堀橋駅7番出口から徒歩1分。食べログ (店舗会員、英語版): 2014年9月11日オープン、国産とらふぐのみ、78席、2階は掘りごたつの個室、3階は32名までの座敷、年末年始の営業時間とサービス料、12月と1月はうなぎなし。メニュー (2026年8月): てっさ2,180円、炭火焼き、ふぐの石焼き、Kara-age、Shirako、ふぐ鍋。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年10月): 焼きふぐ、熟成のてっさ、焼き Shirako、スタッフが焼いて鍋を作る、鍋のふぐが動いていた、夏の conger eel、Unaju、Tenshu コース7,980円、Zosui の味が薄めという声も、6回通う客。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff grill the fugu and prepare the hot pot (2026 reviews); pays with Alipay (Tabelog). No English menu or English-speaking staff found in the sources.

existence.note: Official site with year-end banquet notice and shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing with an August 2026 menu; reviews dated through October 2026.

osaka_steak_house_noda_ohatsutenjin.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The steak is served on bread and the bread is grilled in the meat juices with butter at the end; shrimp crackers and octopus rice crackers come alongside; steak sauces not described.
osaka_steak_house_noda_ohatsutenjin.vegan_detail: Not vegan: wagyu and seafood teppanyaki courses.
osaka_steak_house_noda_ohatsutenjin.hours_raw: Mon–Sat and holidays 17:00–22:00 (last order 22:00); closed Sundays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; the celebration and business courses must be booked by 2:00 on the day; one course per child; smart-casual dress code (Tabelog). Service charge (amount not given) (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), IC cards and other e-money, PayPay, d Barai, Rakuten Pay, au PAY, Alipay, WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 10 counter seats, private hire for 9–10; designated smoking area (Tabelog).
osaka_steak_house_noda_ohatsutenjin.notes: [Teppanyaki · Ohatsu Tenjin, wagyu and a magic show] A ten-seat teppanyaki counter in a quiet lane by Ohatsu Tenjin, long-established and full of regulars, where the cheerful owner grills A5 black wagyu in front of you and, after dessert, performs magic tricks. The ¥9,900 course brings prawns baked in foil, grilled vegetables and 180 g of wagyu, best taken half fillet, half strip loin, served on bread that is then crisped in the meat juices and butter. Birthdays get a message cake (¥13,200 course). Diners keep calling it good value for teppanyaki, and the flambé is announced so you can film it.

roles: Owner and teppan chef (the invoice holder)
chef_bio.background: The Tabelog invoice number T9810910782033 is registered to an individual, 野田　博臣 (NTA invoice register, read 2026-11-02). Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: "A Historic Teppanyaki Restaurant with a Homely Atmosphere" near Ohatsu Tenjin, A5 black wagyu grilled by the chef in front of you, "You might even catch a magic show!". A February 2024 diner believed it was founded in 1975. Reviews from 2022 to 2026 describe a cheerful owner ("master") who cooks and then performs magic.
chef_bio.specialty: A5 wagyu half-and-half; magic after the meal.

anecdotes.text: "Beyond the steak, the butter-soaked bread and octopus rice crackers are also delicious, making for some unique side options." — August 2024, "a fun steakhouse with a cheerful owner".
"The master even performed some magic tricks at the end, and we were all surprised and enjoyed it together." — December 2024, a birthday.
"The steak was a half-and-half option, allowing us to enjoy two different flavors, which was very satisfying." — August 2026, dinner with a boss.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): ステーキハウス 野田 お初天神 梅田店、ステーキ・鉄板焼き・海鮮、大阪市北区曽根崎2-5-33 KIYO BLD2 1F、お初天神のすぐ近く、東梅田駅から5分、月〜土・祝17:00〜22:00、日曜休み、予約可、サービス料あり、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、10席 (カウンター)、9〜10名で貸切、分煙、スマートカジュアル、A5ランクの黒毛和牛を目の前の鉄板で、ヒレとロースのハーフ&ハーフが人気、180gの黒毛和牛のコース9,900円、メッセージケーキつきの記念日コース13,200円、接待コース14,850円、マジックが見られるかも。インボイス登録は個人の野田博臣。口コミ(2022年5月〜2026年8月): 丸いカウンター、エビとキノコのホイル焼き、もやし炒め、塩昆布のサラダ、焼き野菜 (厚揚げ、かぼちゃ、じゃがいも、玉ねぎ)、アワビ・ホタテ・イカの鉄板焼き、パンとえびせんの上のステーキ、肉汁とバターでパンを焼く、たこせん、フランベ、明るいマスターのマジック、常連が多い、1975年創業という声、テッパンヤキとして安い。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter teppanyaki with set courses; the cooking and the magic are visual (2022–2026). No English evidence found.

osaka_otona_izakaya_pon_doyama.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Black-vinegar sweet and sour pork, shrimp in kadaif, mehikari tempura, liver pâté on baguette and a shellfish-broth noodle sit beside sashimi and kamameshi.
osaka_otona_izakaya_pon_doyama.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood izakaya; the kamameshi is cooked in dashi.
osaka_otona_izakaya_pon_doyama.hours_raw: Mon–Thu, Sun, holidays and the day after a holiday 17:00–24:00 (last order 23:30); Fri, Sat and the day before a holiday 17:00–2:00 (last order 1:30) (Tabelog); no closing day (October 2026). Reservations accepted; cover ¥450 a head (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), IC cards and other e-money, PayPay, d Barai, Rakuten Pay, au PAY, Alipay, WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 16 seats: a counter of 8 and two tables of 4; narrow spacing at the counter (October 2026); smoking allowed (Tabelog). Opened 11 April 2025 (Tabelog).
osaka_otona_izakaya_pon_doyama.notes: [Izakaya · Doyama, seafood and sake for grown-ups] A 16-seat izakaya on a side street in Doyama, open since April 2025 and until 2:00 at weekends, pitched between casual and upscale with about twenty sakes. Diners order the house trio: the sashimi platter (with salmon roe), the mackerel or sardine rolls packed with herbs, and the black-vinegar sweet and sour pork; then a salmon and ikura kamameshi, which takes time, so order it early. Expect about ¥4,000–5,000 a head, plus a ¥450 cover. In October 2026 one diner found the counter cramped and the room noisy, and another found the price high for the portions; most others praise the food.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: a sophisticated izakaya of sake and seasonal seafood, creative dishes such as the black-vinegar sweet and sour pork and the Shaoxing-wine squid, 20 sakes including rare labels from specialty shops; opened 11 April 2025.
chef_bio.specialty: Black-vinegar sweet and sour pork; herb rolls; kamameshi.

anecdotes.text: "The recommended Tomato Chuhai with black pepper was an unexpected combination, yet refreshing and addictive." — June 2026.
"In particular, the mackerel and herb rolls were packed with flavor and delicious even without soy sauce!" — July 2026, the three signature dishes.
"It takes a little time to prepare after ordering, but the result is well worth the wait!" — August 2026, of the kamameshi.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 大人居酒屋 ぽん、居酒屋・海鮮・創作料理、大阪市北区堂山町16-12 中通りレジャービル 102、東梅田駅から徒歩3分、月〜木・日・祝・祝後日17:00〜24:00 (L.O.23:30)、金・土・祝前日17:00〜2:00 (L.O.1:30)、予約可、チャージ450円、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、16席 (カウンター8、4名のテーブル2)、喫煙可、2025年4月11日オープン、厳選した鮮魚の創作料理、黒酢の酢豚、紹興酒のイカ、全国の日本酒20種、刺身と選べる釜めしのコース4,000円、和牛ユッケと季節の料理のコース5,000円、日本酒の飲み放題2,500円。口コミ(2026年6月〜10月): 刺身の盛り合わせ (3人で3,840円、いくら入り)、サバやイワシと薬味の巻物 (2人で1,980円)、黒酢の酢豚 (2人で2,560円)、赤エビ3尾1,350円、ぶりがり、カダイフのエビ、めひかりの天ぷら1,360円、肉みそのピーマン480円、豚の角煮、あさりの酒蒸し、レバーパテとバゲット、鮭といくらの釜めし (時間がかかる)、貝の出汁の麺1,000円、黒こしょうのトマトチューハイ、カウンターがせまく音がにぎやかという声、量のわりに高いという声、定休日なし。

cultural_comfort.note: À la carte izakaya and two set courses (Tabelog). No English evidence found.

osaka_kitashinchi_uehara_dojima.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Hotpots in a dashi of bonito, kombu and grilled kinmedai, finished with noodles; lunch has nyumen and soy-dressed seafood.
osaka_kitashinchi_uehara_dojima.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish and whale hotpots in bonito dashi (operator site).
osaka_kitashinchi_uehara_dojima.hours_raw: Mon 17:30–24:00 (last order 23:00); Tue–Fri 11:30–13:30 and 17:30–24:00 (last order 23:00); Sat 17:30–21:00 (last order 20:30); closed Sundays and holidays; after 20:00 à la carte only (Tabelog; operator site). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Service charge 10% (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 20 seats: a counter of 10 and a sunken-floor private room for 3–10; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog).
osaka_kitashinchi_uehara_dojima.notes: [Japanese · Dojima, fish shabu-shabu and whale hotpot] A white-wood counter restaurant on the west side of Kitashinchi, served on antique Ko-Imari and Kutani ware, with two signature hotpots: seasonal fish the head chef picks each morning, swished in a dashi of bonito, kombu and grilled kinmedai, and whale 'harihari-nabe' of rare cuts sent from Taiji in Wakayama (¥7,480 a head). Seasonal courses such as hamo shabu-shabu run ¥13,200–19,800 plus 10% service; after 20:00 you can order à la carte. Weekday lunch is a ¥1,500 bargain: a seafood bowl with thick slices, a meat-sauced dashimaki, nyumen and a house ice cream. English menu, English-speaking staff and wheelchair access.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the head chef picks seasonal fish at the market every morning; whale meat direct from a whaling master (網元) in 太地町, Wakayama; dishes served on antique Ko-Imari, Kutani and Oribe ware; about ten sakes including unlisted ones. A May 2026 diner found the owner running lunch alone. The Tabelog invoice number T7120001164445 is registered to 日本環境コンサルティング株式会社 at the shop's address (NTA invoice register, read 2026-11-02).
chef_bio.specialty: Fish shabu-suki; whale harihari-nabe.

anecdotes.text: "I think getting all this for JPY 1500 is an incredible deal." — April 2026, the seafood bowl lunch.
"We also ordered whale sashimi as an extra, which was equally delightful, and our guests were very pleased." — June 2026, a business dinner for eight.
"for dessert, you can choose from ice cream flavors like matcha, hojicha, black sesame, and coconut." — July 2026, a private booking.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 北新地 うえはら、北新地駅から徒歩3分、大将が目利きする旬魚のしゃぶしゃぶと希少部位の鯨のハリハリ鍋、繊細な一品、古伊万里・九谷焼・織部などの古器、大将が毎朝市場で選ぶ季節の魚の「しゃぶすき鍋」、削りたてのかつおと昆布に焼いた金目鯛のあらを加えた出汁、和歌山県太地町の網元から直送のくじら肉のハリハリ鍋、店主おすすめの隠れ酒をふくむ日本酒約10種、日本酒の麹のクラフトビール、厳選食材コース10品16,500円 (サ別)、20時以降はアラカルト、お造りや藁焼き、記念日のメッセージプレート、白木のカウンター、3〜10名の完全個室。食べログ (店舗会員): 北新地 うえはら、海鮮・しゃぶしゃぶ・日本料理、大阪市北区堂島1-3-20 CriceNikko薬師堂ビル 1F、月17:30〜24:00、火〜金11:30〜13:30と17:30〜24:00、土17:30〜21:00、日・祝休み、サービス料10%、カード・PayPay 可、20席 (カウンター10、掘りごたつの個室)、禁煙、車いす可、英語のメニューと英語を話すスタッフ、ハリハリ鍋7,480円、鯨のコース7品16,500円、秋の鱧しゃぶしゃぶのコース13,200円、鱧・松茸・Miyazaki の牛のコース16,500円、特選コース19,800円。インボイス登録は日本環境コンサルティング株式会社 (店と同じ住所)。口コミ(2026年4月〜7月): 平日のランチ1,500円 (海鮮丼、肉だし巻き、にゅう麺、小鉢、漬物、自家製アイス)、よこわ・鯛・ひらまさ・カンパチ・ネギトロ・釜揚げしらす、ランチは店主ひとり、アイスは抹茶・ほうじ茶・黒ごま・ココナッツなど、鱧のコース、鯨の刺身、鱧と豚のしゃぶしゃぶ、〆の麺。

cultural_comfort.note: Tabelog lists an English menu and English-speaking staff; the official site has an English version; a French-language Google review on the site praises the owner and server.

existence.note: Shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing and the official site (posts dated 2026-10-30); reviews dated through July 2026.

osaka_taiko_zushi_nishinakajima.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sushi and seafood counter.
osaka_taiko_zushi_nishinakajima.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 17:00–24:00; closed Sunday and holidays, Obon (13–17 August) and New Year (30 December–4 January) (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 20 seats: a counter and two tables or a tatami room at the back (Tabelog; 2024–2025). Tabelog says all seats became non-smoking from April 2025, but diners could use an IQOS (April 2026) and found smoking allowed (September 2026). Busy most evenings; a Saturday at 20:00 was full (August 2026).
osaka_taiko_zushi_nishinakajima.notes: [Sushi · Nishinakajima, cheap and cheerful machi-zushi] A lively neighbourhood sushi counter five minutes west of Nishinakajima-Minamigata, with a homely tatami room at the back, where nigiri are priced by the piece from about ¥80 to ¥385 (September 2025) and the regulars order fast. The chef, the chef's brother and the staff keep up a friendly patter (January 2026), and diners single out the mackerel, the big sweet shrimp and the sprouted green onion; there are side dishes too, from turban shell to tempura and chawanmushi. Eating and drinking well comes to about ¥5,000 a head (2026). It fills up in the evening. Cash only. Tabelog says non-smoking since April 2025, but 2026 diners still saw smoking. Closed Sunday.

roles: Chef (unnamed), the chef's brother and staff
chef_bio.background: No shop description on Tabelog. Reviewers: the chef, the chef's brother and the staff "were all very friendly" (January 2026); "The two owners were friendly, creating a welcoming atmosphere" (August 2026); a diner on a fourth visit was recognised at once (February 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Nigiri by the piece; sweet shrimp; mackerel.

anecdotes.text: "Especially the mackerel, with such rich flavor for just JPY 75. I can't go back to high-end places after this." — September 2026.
"I always order the sweet shrimp, which is thick, large, and absolutely delicious!" — February 2026, a fourth visit.
"We were led to a cozy, homey room at the back of the counter." — July 2024.

osaka_sushimaruya_higashimikuni.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Sushi and sashimi come with soy sauce (usually wheat-containing), and tempura, kara-age, croquettes and gratin are on the menu.
osaka_sushimaruya_higashimikuni.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sushi and seafood izakaya. Tabelog's feature list ticks "vegetarian options", but no vegetarian dish is named.
osaka_sushimaruya_higashimikuni.hours_raw: Daily 17:00–02:00 (last order 01:30) (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; no seat requests in December (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Service charge: the English listing says one is added, but its original Japanese reads 無し (none) (Tabelog). 57 seats including sunken-kotatsu seats, a counter and private rooms for 10–20; outdoor tables (October 2025); smoking allowed (Tabelog). A seven-for-five sashimi deal through Tabelog bookings (September 2025, April 2026). Opened 17 February 2004 (Tabelog).
osaka_sushimaruya_higashimikuni.notes: [Sushi izakaya · Higashimikuni, fish until 2 am] A roomy sushi izakaya by Higashimikuni Station, open since 2004 and serving until 2 am every night, with a counter, sunken-kotatsu tables, private rooms and a few outdoor tables. It is a favourite for office parties: two-hour all-you-can-drink courses at ¥5,000–5,500 open with the house eel sushi under crab and salmon roe and run through sashimi, tempura and butter-grilled scallops to nigiri and red miso soup, with the group's name printed on the menu (2025–2026). À la carte, people order thick-cut sashimi, a huge shrimp tempura and a crab gratin kept hot over a candle. About ¥6,000–9,000 a head with drinks (2026). Staff are warm, and one diner left with a small gift (June 2026). Smoking is allowed.

chef_bio.background: No shop description on Tabelog beyond booking notes; opened 17 February 2004 (Tabelog). Reviewers note a menu printed with the booking name (July 2025), warm service (2025–2026) and a small parting gift (June 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Banquet courses; sashimi platters; shrimp tempura.

anecdotes.text: "… a menu with the reservation name printed on it again." — July 2025, the JPY 5,000 Omakase banquet course.
"It's served with a personal stove (heated by a candle), so I could enjoy it piping hot." — August 2025, the crab gratin.
"I was looking for a sushi restaurant open late at night and ended up here." — December 2025.

osaka_italian_bar_storia_nishinakajima.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat pasta and pizza make up most of the menu.
osaka_italian_bar_storia_nishinakajima.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pasta with cream, cheese, seafood and mentaiko; meat dishes.
osaka_italian_bar_storia_nishinakajima.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 12:00–14:00 (last order 13:30) and 18:00–01:00; Sat 18:00–01:00; closed Sunday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR payments (Tabelog). 14 seats: 8 at the counter and 6 at tables; smoking allowed; free Wi-Fi; takeaway; all-you-can-drink plans (Tabelog; February 2026). Opened 1 October 2015 (Tabelog).
osaka_italian_bar_storia_nishinakajima.notes: [Italian · Nishinakajima, a small bar open till 1 am] A 14-seat Italian bar on a second floor three minutes from Nishinakajima-Minamigata, open since 2015, with lunch on weekdays and dinner until 1 am. Lunch is a ¥900 pasta with a free large portion, often the mentaiko and mushroom cream or, in summer, a chilled seafood tomato pasta with bonito flakes, and a ¥600 glass of wine (2025–2026). Evenings are for small plates and wine: curried soybeans in the antipasto, oysters done like escargot, roast wagyu, spare ribs, a butter-pumpkin potage, and thin-crust pizza (2024–2026). The owner will halve a salad on request (December 2025) and suggest drinks. Smoking is allowed. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: No shop description on Tabelog; opened 1 October 2015 (Tabelog). Reviewers: ask the master for drink recommendations (May 2024); the owner made a half-size salad on request (December 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Lunch pasta; antipasti and wine at night.

anecdotes.text: "Pasta for JPY 900!! I also added some wine because it was such a great deal." — October 2026, lunch.
"To avoid having too much food, I spoke with the owner and requested a half-size salad." — December 2025.
"The oysters prepared escargot-style were also fantastic!" — February 2026.

osaka_yuraku_nishinakajima.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Yakiniku comes with tare or salt; the lunch sets are kara-age, fried horse mackerel and tonjiru.
osaka_yuraku_nishinakajima.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a yakiniku and offal restaurant; the lunch tonjiru is full of pork.
osaka_yuraku_nishinakajima.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:30–13:30 and 18:00–24:00; Sat and Sun 18:00–24:00; closing days not fixed (Tabelog); lunch days may be irregular (August 2026). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 20 seats: a counter of six and tables; smoking allowed; free Wi-Fi and two TVs for sports (Tabelog). A line at weekday lunch (2026).
osaka_yuraku_nishinakajima.notes: [Yakiniku · Nishinakajima, Omi beef by night, tonjiru by day] A small yakiniku restaurant near Nishinakajima-Minamigata that grills Omi beef in the evening, with TVs on for big matches (Tabelog), but is best known at lunch for its tonjiru: a bowl bigger than the rice, crammed with pork and vegetables, in a ¥1,000 set with kara-age or fried horse mackerel, a rolled omelette and free rice refills (2025–2026). Office workers line up for it; three women ran the lunch on a July 2026 visit. At night there is a ¥5,000 all-you-can-drink course from tongue through kalbi to offal (September 2025). Cash only; smoking allowed. Lunch days can be irregular, so check.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog listing: Omi beef, "one of Japan's top three wagyu", with the popular "Jou Harami"; a good-value lunch; counter and tables, free Wi-Fi, two TVs for sports, surprise celebrations by arrangement. A July 2026 diner saw three women running lunch.
chef_bio.specialty: Tonjiru set lunches; Omi beef yakiniku.

anecdotes.text: "The bowl of pork miso soup was larger than the rice bowl, filled to the brim with plenty of ingredients." — July 2026, the tonjiru and fried horse mackerel set for JPY 1,000.
"Instead of miso soup, I recommend adding the Pork Soup for just an extra JPY 50." — October 2026.
"For the JPY 5000 course, we had everything from tongue to kalbi and horumon." — September 2025, a group of six.

osaka_chikuchikuya_namba.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The lunch gozen include tempura, dashi-maki, sashimi and miso soup; the dinner courses are chef's choice.
osaka_chikuchikuya_namba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-focused Japanese restaurant cooking with Kansai-style dashi (July 2026).
osaka_chikuchikuya_namba.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00) and 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:00) (Tabelog). In the Obon week of August 2026 there was no weekday lunch (August 2026 review). Reservations accepted; the Tabelog remarks say lunch bookings are for groups of 4 or more on the banquet course, booked 2 days ahead, while August 2026 reviewers booked lunch for one and for three by phone — ask. About ten people queued before opening on a July 2026 day. Cards, PayPay and d Barai; no e-money (Tabelog). 64 seats in a three-storey house: counter (shoes off, August 2026), tatami, sunken seating and private rooms for 6 to 30+; banquets up to 60 (Tabelog). Smoking: Tabelog says non-smoking at lunch and smoking allowed at dinner; a July 2026 reviewer found smoking and non-smoking separated by floor. No toilets on the ground floor (August 2026). Children welcome (Tabelog).
osaka_chikuchikuya_namba.notes: [Japanese izakaya · Namba, gozen lunches in an old townhouse] A three-storey, Kyoto-townhouse-style Japanese restaurant a minute from Namba Station, with a counter, tatami rooms and private rooms. At lunch it serves trays of ten small dishes — sashimi, tempura, dashi-maki, grilled fish — from about ¥1,800 to ¥3,000; at night, chef's-choice courses built on market fish, with over 50 local sakes. Lunch has a queue at opening; book, and ask about smoking if it matters (the rules depend on time and floor).

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop listing (corporate member): the head chef goes to the market every day to choose fish; over 50 local sakes; private rooms in a Kyoto-townhouse-style setting. Reviewers name Kizu Market as the source (August 2026). One other shop, 矗々家 JR大阪駅前店 in Umeda, appears on Tabelog with its listing on hold.
chef_bio.specialty: Obanzai gozen lunches; market fish.

anecdotes.text: "There were about ten people lined up before the opening. The interior has an old-fashioned charm reminiscent of 'Spirited Away.'" — July 2026, at lunch.
"When I made the reservation by phone about two days ago ... only counter seats were available, but when we arrived ... a sunken kotatsu seating for us" — August 2026, three generations at lunch.
"It's a small three-story building, but there are no restrooms on the first floor, so elderly guests may find it challenging to go up to the second floor." — August 2026.

osaka_harijyu_curry_shop_dotonbori.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the mainstays are breaded beef, chicken and pork katsu with curry or demi-glace sauce; the "Beef Wan" beef bowl is simmered in a sweet-salty sauce, and nothing is described as gluten-free.
osaka_harijyu_curry_shop_dotonbori.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the menu is built on Harijyu beef — beef curry, beef katsu, beef bowl, yakiniku set; the beef bowl has a dashi-based sauce (September 2026).
osaka_harijyu_curry_shop_dotonbori.hours_raw: Mon and Wed–Sun 11:30–20:00; closed Tuesdays, but open on Tuesdays that are holidays or the day before a holiday, and every day in December (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Fills around noon at weekends, but seats free up quickly (June and October 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), transport IC, Rakuten Edy, nanaco, WAON, iD, QUICPay and QR payment (Tabelog). 38 seats at tables; non-smoking (Tabelog).
osaka_harijyu_curry_shop_dotonbori.notes: [Yoshoku and curry · Dotonbori, Harijyu beef at diner prices] The Showa-era diner on the Midosuji corner of the Harijyu building, where the famous sukiyaki house serves its beef cheaply. Order the "Beef Wan" (a beef-and-egg rice bowl, about ¥1,200) or the beef katsu curry (¥1,540); the wagyu bifukatsu with demi-glace is the splurge. No bookings and no Tuesday service (except holidays and December); reviewers walk in at Sunday noon while the surrounding streets are packed with tourists.

chef_bio.background: Per reviews (July–August 2026): run by Harijyu, the Dotonbori sukiyaki house, next to the main restaurant and Harijyu Grill. The neighbouring record はり重 道頓堀本店 (osaka_harijyu_dotonbori) notes: "Harijyu Grill, a curry shop and the butcher share the building (official site)" and dates the house to a butcher opened in 1919 that came to Dotonbori in 1948.
chef_bio.specialty: "Beef Wan" beef bowl; beef katsu curry.

anecdotes.text: "While Namba is bustling with tourists, this restaurant is a hidden gem despite being an established spot. I was able to get in without waiting." — September 2026, Sunday noon.

"Today, Dotonbori is bustling with inbound tourists. While foreign visitors are everywhere, I make my way to the retro Showa-style Hariju Curry Shop, located along Midosuji." — October 2026, a regular.
"The paper napkins were folded into triangles, giving a wonderful retro feel." — July 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: はり重カレーショップ、洋食・カレー・牛肉の丼、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-9-17、なんば駅14番出口から徒歩1分以内、月・水〜日11:30〜20:00、火曜休み (祝日・祝前日・12月は営業)、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 決済可、38席 (4人テーブル8、2人テーブル3)、禁煙、公式 harijyu.co.jp。口コミ(2026年6月〜10月): すき焼きのはり重が営む店、Beef Wan 1,200円・1,210円・1,240円ほど (時期で違う)、甘さより塩気、山椒、赤だし、ビーフカツカレー1,540円、チキンカツカレー1,320円、辛くないうまみのカレーという声と、ほどよい辛さという声、和牛のビフカツとデミグラスソース、オニオンスープのセット、焼肉定食2,200円、ハヤシライス、福神漬けとほうじ茶、ドリンク660円、昭和レトロの店内、道頓堀は観光客が多いが店は入りやすい。

osaka_bistro_akira_shinmachi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Raw oysters come with lemon, shallot vinegar and yuzu ponzu (July 2026); fried oysters, fish and chips, oyster pasta and risotto are also on the menu.
osaka_bistro_akira_shinmachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an oyster and meat bistro; the shop mentions seasonal dishes for people who do not eat oysters, but none described as plant-based.
osaka_bistro_akira_shinmachi.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 15:00–23:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–23:00; last order food 22:00, drinks 22:30; closed 31 December–5 January (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; fills up at weekends (September 2026). ¥500 appetiser for guests not on a course (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), transport IC and other e-money, PayPay, Rakuten Pay, au PAY, Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 36 seats: 14 at the counter, 22 at tables, a semi-private room for 6; non-smoking, ashtray by the entrance; wheelchair accessible; BYO drinks (Tabelog). Pets only at the counter by the entrance (Tabelog), in a cart (August 2026); dog menu (August 2026).
osaka_bistro_akira_shinmachi.notes: [Oyster bar · Shinmachi, raw oysters by origin and charcoal-grilled wagyu] A counter-led oyster and meat bistro in a quiet street of Shinmachi, with an ice bed of oysters from around Japan at the door. Order a tasting of three origins (about ¥600 each), staff explain each one, then the charcoal-grilled Awaji wagyu; courses run ¥5,500–6,600. Reviews in 2026 are mostly warm, but two diners in August–September 2026 found the cooking average and the wagyu disappointing. Book at weekends; open from 15:00 on weekdays.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop listing (corporate member): opened 25 October 2021; oysters and meat, fish from Miyakubo port in the Seto Inland Sea, half-private rooms. A September 2026 reviewer mentions an open kitchen.
chef_bio.specialty: Raw oysters from several regions; charcoal-grilled wagyu.

anecdotes.text: "It was interesting to learn that each one has a different flavor depending on its origin, with the staff explaining the characteristics of each." — August 2026.

"I was a bit worried if it was okay to eat this many raw oysters ... if you have a sensitive stomach, it might be better to order a la carte and take it slow." — June 2026, a course with five kinds of oyster.

"Overall, the dishes were just average. The ajillo was a bit bland, and the pasta was overly seasoned." — August 2026; a September 2026 reviewer was also disappointed by the wagyu and saw a potato that fell on the kitchen floor served.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 四ツ橋・新町 牡蠣と肉たらしビストロAKIRA、オイスターバー・肉バル・ビストロ、大阪市西区新町1-9-17 矢野園ビル 1F、四ツ橋駅から徒歩5分、月〜金15:00〜23:00、土日祝11:30〜15:00、17:00〜23:00 (料理 L.O. 22:00、ドリンク L.O. 22:30)、12月31日〜1月5日休み、予約可、コース以外はお通し500円、カード・電子マネー・QR 決済可、36席 (カウンター14、テーブル22)、禁煙 (入口横に灰皿)、ペットは入口のカウンターのみ、2021年10月25日オープン。全国の生牡蠣を常時5種以上、生・焼き・揚げ・パスタ、和牛とジビエの炭火焼き、Miyakubo の漁港 (Seto Inland Sea) から直送の魚、牡蠣好きのコース6,600円、牡蠣・カニ・ロブスター・牛・鴨・フォアグラのコース5,500円。口コミ(2026年6月〜10月): 産地別の生牡蠣1個550〜650円、Nanao、Ofunato、Murotsu、Konagai、生牡蠣の盛り合わせ2,500円、カキフライ550円、フィッシュアンドチップス1,580円、Imabari の魚のカルパッチョ1,200円、黒毛和牛 (Awaji beef) の炭火焼きステーキ3,980円、犬のメニュー600円、店の人が産地ごとの味を説明、ふつうだった・和牛が残念だったという声も (2026年8〜9月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff explain each oyster's origin (2026); counter seating. No English evidence found.

osaka_kunsei_sugiya_shoten_namba.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Sashimi is served with smoked soy sauce, the smoked sukiyaki uses a sweet soy broth, and courses end with rice or udon.
osaka_kunsei_sugiya_shoten_namba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the signatures are smoked wagyu, smoked sukiyaki with smoked raw egg, sashimi, bacon and sausage.
osaka_kunsei_sugiya_shoten_namba.hours_raw: Tue–Thu, Sun and holidays 17:00–23:00 (last food order 22:30); Fri–Sat 17:00–23:30 (last food order 23:00); closed Mondays and 30 December–4 January (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, also by Instagram DM; two-hour limit when busy; cancellation fees for no-shows (Tabelog). ¥330 appetiser (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 28 seats, all at a U-shaped counter (Tabelog; September 2026); non-smoking (Tabelog). No one under 20 admitted (Tabelog). Menu in English, Chinese and Korean, with photos and a digital menu (Tabelog); order by QR code (October 2026). Hard to find: no sign outside, 4th floor, look for the name on the building directory (October 2026); shoes off and a low entrance to crouch through (September 2026).
osaka_kunsei_sugiya_shoten_namba.notes: [Smoked-food izakaya · Namba, smoked sukiyaki at a counter] A hideaway on the 4th floor of a Namba back-street building — no sign outside, shoes off, a low door — where almost everything on the menu is smoked, down to the soy sauce and the lemon sour. Order the smoked sukiyaki (¥2,160) with its smoked egg and tomato-sorbet dips, the smoked potato salad and the 16-hour smoked cheese; the ¥4,000 course covers the classics. Counter only, adults only (20+), English menu. One July 2026 reviewer found many dishes too salty.

chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop listing (corporate member) and website kunsei-sugiya-shouten.com: opened 7 March 2019; a smoked-food izakaya "tucked away in a back alley of Namba".
chef_bio.specialty: Smoked sukiyaki; instant-smoked wagyu.

anecdotes.text: "I arrived at the right location, but I couldn't find the sign for the restaurant. After a bit of searching, I finally spotted a notice with the restaurant's name on the building directory and entered." — October 2026, a first visit.
"Eating the smoked tomato sorbet wrapped in meat like sushi made me involuntarily exclaim, 'So good!'" — September 2026, Sunday at 5 PM.
"Upon arrival, I found a reserved cushion with my name printed on it ... the appetizer was smoked takuan" — August 2026, a Friday booking.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 燻製スギヤ商店、居酒屋・すき焼き、大阪市中央区難波1-7-18 心斎橋ヨーロピアンビル 4F、なんば駅14番出口から徒歩2分、火〜木・日・祝17:00〜23:00 (料理 L.O. 22:30)、金・土17:00〜23:30 (料理 L.O. 23:00)、月曜休み、12月30日〜1月4日休み、予約可 (Instagram の DM も)、混雑時は2時間制、お通し330円、カード・PayPay 可、電子マネー不可、28席 (カウンターのみ)、禁煙、20歳未満は入店不可、英語・中国語・韓国語のメニュー、2019年3月7日オープン。和牛ヒレの瞬間燻製、16時間燻製のチーズ、燻製ソーセージ、板焼き、燻製レモンサワー、燻製すき焼きのコース6,000円。口コミ(2026年7月〜10月): 燻製すき焼き2,160円 (燻製の生卵と燻製トマトのシャーベット)、燻製ポテトサラダ690円、刺身の盛り合わせ1,480円 (燻製醤油)、瞬間燻製の和牛ヒレ2,700円、7品のコース4,000円、飲み放題1,500円と燻製ドリンク+500円、お通しは燻製たくあん、看板がない、靴を脱いでかがんで入る、QR コードで注文、塩辛い料理が多いという声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Menu in English, Chinese and Korean with photos, plus QR ordering (Tabelog; October 2026). Hard to find: no sign outside, 4th floor (2026). Adults only.

osaka_bonkuraya_dotonbori.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: okonomiyaki, yakisoba, sobameshi and tonpei-yaki are wheat-based and cooked on shared griddles. The steak teppanyaki is the only dish to ask about.
osaka_bonkuraya_dotonbori.vegan_detail: Not vegan: okonomiyaki with pork, beef tendon, seafood and egg; the Bon-chan-yaki is served with a dashi (October 2026).
osaka_bonkuraya_dotonbori.hours_raw: Mon 17:00–23:30; Tue–Sat 11:30–23:30 (last order 23:00); Sun 11:30–22:30 (last order 22:00); irregular closures (Tabelog). Reservations, including seat-only bookings at lunch (August 2026); a two-hour limit when busy (August 2026). At least one drink per person; no service or table charge (Tabelog). Courses: six dishes with 90-minute all-you-can-drink from ¥3,500; the Bonkuraya course of six dishes with 120 minutes for ¥4,500 (Tabelog; August 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 87 seats, private hire for 50–87; non-smoking (Tabelog). Up a narrow staircase to the second floor, which a September 2026 diner flags for anyone with mobility issues. Takeaway and Uber Eats (Tabelog).
osaka_bonkuraya_dotonbori.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Dotonbori, fluffy okonomiyaki above the main street] A big second-floor okonomiyaki and teppanyaki restaurant on the Dotonbori main street, up a narrow staircase, part of a small Osaka chain. The house okonomiyaki, Bonkura-yaki, is soft and fluffy; try the Akashi-yaki-style Bon-chan-yaki in dashi or the beef-tendon sobameshi, with tonpei-yaki and yakisoba on the side. Courses with all-you-can-drink start at ¥3,500, and a drink per person is required. Diners in 2026 found it reliable and easy to get into, with friendly staff, many from overseas, though several called the okonomiyaki ordinary and one found the mayonnaise heavy. Open daily to 23:30 (Mondays from 17:00, Sundays to 22:30).

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: okonomiyaki and teppanyaki in Dotonbori, famous for "fluffy and melty" okonomiyaki, featured in the media and visited by celebrities and comedians. A Bonkuraya branch in Nishinakajima is also on Tabelog. 2026 reviews note friendly staff, many from overseas.
chef_bio.specialty: Fluffy okonomiyaki (Bonkura-yaki); Bon-chan-yaki; sobameshi.

anecdotes.text: "The Mixed Bon-chan-yaki was served in a style reminiscent of Akashiyaki, pairing perfectly with the dashi infused with green onions and bonito flakes. Personally, I found it to be the most delicious!" — October 2026.
"I climbed a narrow staircase to get here (be cautious if you have mobility issues)." — September 2026, Bonkura-yaki and beef-tendon sobameshi.
"Perhaps I had set my expectations too high, as the taste was quite ordinary." — August 2026, a first family visit to Dotonbori.

cultural_comfort.note: Many overseas guests and friendly staff from overseas (August–September 2026). No English menu evidence found.

osaka_yakitori_yuu_a_la_carte_namba.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Salt-seasoned skewers and the bird sashimi platter are where to start; sauce skewers, tsukune with sauce, chicken nanban, yam fries and the paitan ramen are not.
osaka_yakitori_yuu_a_la_carte_namba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a yakitori and poultry restaurant.
osaka_yakitori_yuu_a_la_carte_namba.hours_raw: Mon–Thu, Sun and holidays 11:30–23:00 (last orders food 22:00, drinks 22:30); Fri, Sat and the day before a holiday 11:30–24:00 (last orders 23:00 and 23:30) (Tabelog). The official site still lists 17:00 openings and Sundays closed, but diners came for lunch in September 2026 and on a Sunday evening in August 2026. Happy hour until 17:00 with chuhai and highballs at ¥99 (Tabelog; September 2026). Reservations online or by phone; walk-ins on a Friday (October 2026). Courses with two-hour all-you-can-drink ¥5,500, ¥4,500 Monday–Thursday (official site); banquet courses ¥4,500 and ¥6,500 (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX); the official site also lists PayPay, while Tabelog says no QR. 50 seats: a counter on the first floor facing the grill and tables upstairs; non-smoking (Tabelog; official site). Mobile ordering (August 2026). The entrance, upstairs beside a noodle shop, is a little hard to find (September 2026). Opened 20 April 2022 (Tabelog).
osaka_yakitori_yuu_a_la_carte_namba.notes: [Yakitori · Namba, Yakitori Yuu's second shop: ostrich, duck and pheasant] The second shop of Yakitori Yuu, a popular yakitori place in Tanimachi 9-chome, a minute from Nankai Namba, with a counter facing the grill downstairs and tables upstairs. Beyond chicken skewers it serves a platter of different birds, chicken, Kawachi duck, ostrich, pheasant and pigeon, as sashimi or tataki, plus ostrich yukke, tsukune with egg yolk and creative plates such as liver pâté pastries, with a chicken paitan ramen to finish. It opens at 11:30 with a ¥99 chuhai and highball happy hour until 17:00, and stays open late. Diners in 2026 praise the variety and value; a couple found the grilling or the seseri less impressive than the creative dishes.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the second shop of the popular 焼鳥祐 in Tanimachi 9-chome, with courses at the same level as the main shop; branded and local chickens including the house brand 六角大魔王 and Nagoya Cochin; the group's other shops, listed on the site, include 鶏家 六角鶏 (Namba and Sakai-Higashi) and 麺屋 たにぐち. Per Tabelog: the main 焼鳥祐 takes no reservations; opened 20 April 2022.
chef_bio.philosophy: A space to unwind over good food and drink; the counter for dates and business dinners, tables upstairs for parties (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Mixed-bird platter; 水煙蒸し; tsukune with egg yolk.

anecdotes.text: "The yakitori was excellent, and the ostrich meat included in the assorted poultry was a rare and delicious treat. The chicken paitan ramen served at the end was exceptional." — August 2026.
"It's close to the station, but the entrance was a bit hard to find... I thought it was missing, but it's actually on the second floor of a udon shop!!" — September 2026, ¥99 happy hour.
"While the grilling technique could be better utilized to enhance the flavor, considering the location, cost, and ambiance, I believe it's a very convenient place to visit." — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (yu-alacarte.com): 焼鳥祐 アラカルト、谷町九丁目で人気の『焼鳥祐』2号店、難波駅1分、自社ブランド「六角大魔王」や名古屋コーチンなどの地鶏、名物『鳥類盛』(鶏、河内鴨、駝鳥、雉、鳩などをお造りやたたきで、その日の仕入れによって)、目の前で蒸し上げる「水煙蒸し」(六角大魔王と淡路島野菜)、おすすめユッケ、2時間飲み放題付のおまかせコース5,500円、月〜木限定の飲み放題付コース4,500円、本店同様レベル、ワインと日本酒を約20種、1Fカウンター、2Fテーブル席、難波中1-15-23 難波清覚ビル、難波駅5番出口から徒歩20秒、営業時間 月〜木17:00〜23:00・金土祝前日17:00〜24:00・日曜定休、カード・PayPay可、同じグループに鶏家 六角鶏、麺屋 たにぐちなど。食べログ (店舗会員): 焼き鳥・居酒屋・鶏料理、毎日11:30から (月〜木・日祝23:00まで、金土祝前日24:00まで)、昼は酎ハイとハイボール99円、予約可、50席、禁煙、2022年4月20日オープン。口コミ(2026年8月〜10月): 駝鳥のユッケ、鳥類盛、卵黄つくね、チキン南蛮、レバーパテ、山芋フライ、鶏白湯ラーメン、モバイルオーダー、3階まで席、入口が分かりにくい。

cultural_comfort.note: The official site has an English version; many international staff and mobile ordering (August 2026).

osaka_khao_man_gai_kitchen_nambanaka.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Steamed-chicken khao man gai comes with a ginger sauce and a chili sauce whose contents are not described; the fried chicken and anything with soy or oyster sauce may contain wheat. The shop takes custom orders where it can (Tabelog).
osaka_khao_man_gai_kitchen_nambanaka.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and the Thai chef takes custom orders where possible, but Thai dishes use fish sauce and shrimp, and the khao man gai is chicken.
osaka_khao_man_gai_kitchen_nambanaka.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–14:45 and 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:30) (Tabelog). At lunch you pay first and then sit (September 2026); lunch comes with oolong tea or coffee (October 2026); lunch reservations on weekdays only; courses need booking a day ahead; groups of 10 or more are contacted to confirm (Tabelog). Water and condiments are self-service (July and October 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), IC cards, Rakuten Edy, nanaco, WAON, iD, QUICPay and QR including Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog); no service charge (Tabelog original text). 46 table seats on the ground floor and a loft; private hire for 20–50; non-smoking with a smoking area; children welcome; English menu; takeaway and Uber delivery (Tabelog). Opened 5 September 2013 (Tabelog).
osaka_khao_man_gai_kitchen_nambanaka.notes: [Thai · Nambanaka, khao man gai since 2013] A Thai restaurant run with a Thai chef since 2013, between Namba and Nipponbashi, with tables downstairs and a loft upstairs. The name is the dish to order: khao man gai of steamed chicken on fragrant rice, or fried, or half and half (¥1,180–¥1,250), with ginger and chili sauces and a soup; there is also pad thai, gapao rice, curries and, at night, tom yum kung and stir-fries. Lunch starts at 11:30 and runs to 14:45, with a free tea or coffee. Diners in 2026 call it great value and easy to get into; some found the flavors sweet or the rice too mild, which the self-service condiments can fix. Open daily.

chef_bio.origin: Thailand (Tabelog: run by a native Thai chef)
chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: an authentic Thai restaurant in Namba run by a native Thai chef, celebrating 12 years; khao man gai with a homemade sauce is the specialty; custom spice levels and orders accommodated where possible; opened 5 September 2013.
chef_bio.philosophy: The true flavors of Thailand, even for solo diners (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Khao man gai; pad thai.

anecdotes.text: "The crispy texture of the fried chicken and the moistness of the boiled chicken were both irresistible and absolutely fantastic." — September 2026, half-and-half khao man gai, a second visit.
"I arrived around 8:30 PM on a Sunday. There were three groups, including myself." — October 2026, khao man gai ¥1,200.
"Overall, the flavors were on the sweeter side." — October 2026, a first dinner visit.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ (店舗会員): 大阪カオマンガイキッチン、タイ料理・カレー、難波中2-4-14、各線 Namba 駅から徒歩2分、毎日11:30〜14:45・17:00〜22:00 (L.O.21:30)、予約可 (ランチの予約は平日のみ、コースは前日までに)、カード・電子マネー・QR可、サービス料なし、46席 (テーブル)、2階のロフト、貸切20〜50名、禁煙 (喫煙所あり)、ベジタリアンメニュー、英語メニュー、テイクアウト、Uber などのデリバリー、2013年9月5日オープン、12周年、タイ人シェフ、名物カオマンガイと自家製ソース、辛さなどの調整に対応。口コミ(2026年7月〜10月): カオマンガイ1,200円、揚げカオマンガイ1,180円、ハーフ＆ハーフ1,250円、パッタイ1,050円、ガパオライス、トムヤムクン、ブアローイ、ランチは先払い、ウーロン茶かコーヒーつき、水と調味料はセルフ、味は甘めという声。

osaka_takoyaki_za_sennichimae.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: takoyaki, okonomiyaki and yakisoba are wheat-batter or wheat-noodle dishes.
osaka_takoyaki_za_sennichimae.vegan_detail: Not vegan: octopus balls in a dashi-rich batter (August 2026).
osaka_takoyaki_za_sennichimae.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 10:00–24:00; Sat, Sun and holidays 09:00–24:00 (Tabelog). Takeaway, or eat in (2026). Reservations; private hire up to 50 (Tabelog). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog; August 2026). 100 seats over three floors, with a tatami area (Tabelog; October 2026). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). The listed website, takoyakiza.com, did not respond in November 2026.
osaka_takoyaki_za_sennichimae.notes: [Takoyaki · Sennichimae, takoyaki across from NGK] A takoyaki shop diagonally across from Namba Grand Kagetsu, its walls covered in comedians' and celebrities' signatures, with seats on three floors including tatami, so you can sit down with a beer before or after a show. The takoyaki are small, soft and gooey in a dashi-rich batter; have them with sauce and mayo, or try salt, which one seven-time regular calls the best in the world, or a six-flavor set. Okonomiyaki, yakisoba and doteyaki too. Most 2026 diners were happy; one found the flavor not to taste and another the doteyaki small. Cash only, smoking allowed, open from morning to midnight.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: takoyaki, okonomiyaki and yakisoba diagonally in front of Namba Grand Kagetsu, with 100 seats on the second and third floors too. 2026 reviews note signatures of comedians and celebrities on the walls and friendly staff, many from overseas. No opening date is given; a September 2026 diner first came 11 years earlier.
chef_bio.specialty: Takoyaki with salt or sauce.

anecdotes.text: "The takoyaki salt at Takoyaki Za is the best in Japan, and indeed, the best in the world." — February 2025, the fifth of seven visits.
"Among the many famous takoyaki shops in the area, I chose this place because it has a tatami seating area where I could relax." — October 2026, before a rakugo show at NGK.
"Even the plain one, which has no seasoning, is delicious on its own thanks to the rich dashi flavor." — August 2026, the six-flavor set.
